jobs.description:
📍 Berlin | Bezirk Lichtenberg | 2 Tage Home Office

💻 Microsoft 365 | Azure | Automatisierung | Digitalisierung

Du möchtest als zentrale IT Ansprechperson die technische Infrastruktur eines Unternehmens gestalten, weiterentwickeln und automatisieren?

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist ein dynamisch wachsendes E Commerce Unternehmen in Berlin, das mit tausenden Produkten in verschiedenen Kategorien erfolgreich auf digitalen Marktplätzen agiert. Als einer der führenden Händler auf Amazon in Deutschland verbindet das Unternehmen datengetriebene Prozesse mit einem modernen Technologieansatz.

Für die interne IT wird eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit gesucht, die als fachlich führende IT Person die Microsoft Umgebung verantwortet, technologische Standards setzt und gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen Geschäftsprozesse automatisiert.

Aufgaben

Als fachlich führende IT Person verantwortest du die gesamte interne IT Umgebung. Da die Infrastruktur bewusst schlank gehalten ist und der Support überschaubar bleibt, liegt dein Fokus vor allem auf Architektur, Sicherheit, Automatisierung und der Weiterentwicklung der IT.

- Microsoft 365: Vollständige Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint und Teams einschließlich Conditional Access und Geräte Compliance.

- Azure: Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Azure Umgebung mit Fokus auf virtuelle Maschinen, Netzwerk, Backup und Kostenoptimierung.

- Netzwerk & Security: Verantwortung für Netzwerk, Sophos Firewall und VPN sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen und sicheren Betriebs.

- Automatisierung: Konzeption und Umsetzung von Geschäftsprozess Automatisierungen mit Power Automate und PowerShell in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen.

- Technologie & Standards: Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter Technologien, Definition technischer Standards sowie strukturierte Dokumentation der IT Umgebung.

- IT Projekte: Eigenständige Steuerung von IT Projekten sowie Koordination und fachliche Steuerung externer Dienstleister bei Bedarf.

- 3rd Level Support: Fachliche Unterstützung der Junior Kollegin, die den 1st und 2nd Level Support übernimmt, sowie Übernahme komplexer technischer Fragestellungen im 3rd Level.

- Wissensaufbau: Fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Junior Kollegin sowie Vermittlung von Wissen und Best Practices innerhalb des Unternehmens.

- KI & Digitalisierung: Weiterentwicklung des strukturellen Einsatzes von KI Lösungen und Automatisierungstechnologien zur Optimierung interner Prozesse.

- Prozessoptimierung: Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse, Identifikation von Digitalisierungspotenzialen und Entwicklung nachhaltiger technischer Lösungen.

Qualifikation

- Rund 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Systemadministration oder als Systems Engineer.

- Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Entra ID, Intune und der Microsoft 365 Administration, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, dieses Wissen weiterzugeben.

- Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, insbesondere mit virtuellen Maschinen, Netzwerken und Backups.

- Erfahrung mit Netzwerken und Firewalls, idealerweise mit Sophos.

- Sicherer Umgang mit PowerShell im Arbeitsalltag.

- Erfahrung mit Power Automate oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich in diesem Bereich weiterzuentwickeln.

- Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis und der Anspruch, Prozesse zunächst zu verstehen und anschließend sinnvoll zu automatisieren.

- Eigenständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

- Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und Kolleginnen und Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes technisches Englisch.

Benefits

- Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.

- Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.

- Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.

- Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.

- Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.

- Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.

- Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.

- Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits.

Als Senior Systems Engineer möchtest du moderne IT Strukturen nicht nur betreiben, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln und digitale Prozesse nachhaltig verbessern?

Dann sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und wir geben dir in einem kurzen, kurzen Telefonat alle weiteren Informationen zur Stelle und zum Unternehmen.

jobs.description:
What Makes a Honda, Is Who Makes a Honda

Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose

The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.

Key Accountabilities

 Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration. Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions. Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams. Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies. Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments. Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives. Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Minimum Education

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology (IT) / Networking / Electronics or a related STEM field of study, or equivalent relevant professional experience in the industry along with industry standard certifications.

Required Qualifications

 At least 8 or more years of enterprise endpoint engineering, modern desktop administration, or endpoint management experience. 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms. 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations. 2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.

Other Required Technical Skills

 Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management. Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management. Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices. Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements. Proficiency in PowerShell automation, Microsoft Graph, reporting, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.

Highly Desirables

 Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Power BI, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft endpoint management certifications.

Workstyle

This is an onsite job. One remote workday per week may be possible with prior departmental approval.

Job location options

Candidate can report onsite at either one of these AHM office locations:Marysville, OHTorrance, CA

This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.

jobs.summary: Role Summary We are seeking a highly skilled Enterprise Browser & Endpoint Engineer to design, manage, and optimize our enterprise browser ecosystem and modern endpoint platforms. In this role, you will hold global ownership of browser...
jobs.description:
Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Enterprise Browser & Endpoint Engineer to design, manage, and optimize our enterprise browser ecosystem and modern endpoint platforms. In this role, you will hold global ownership of browser infrastructure—spanning ChromeOS, Chrome Enterprise, Edge Enterprise, Citrix Enterprise Browser, and Citrix Workspace Browser—ensuring secure access, seamless user experience, and automated lifecycle management across all devices and VDI environments.

The ideal candidate is an EUC/Endpoint Engineer at heart with deep expertise in identity, network, and browser-level policies, backed by modern automation skills and SRE/DevOps disciplines for enterprise-scale operations.

Key Responsibilities

 Enterprise Browser & Endpoint ArchitectureArchitect, configure, and maintain enterprise browser policies across Chrome, Edge, ChromeOS, and Citrix Enterprise/Workspace Browsers.Manage centralized browser management platforms, including Google Admin Console, Chrome Browser Cloud Management (CBCM), Microsoft Intune, and GPO/Group Policy.Enforce security baselines, enterprise extensions, proxy/PAC configurations, PKI/browser certificates, and SSO authentication flows (SAML 2.0, OIDC, Entra ID, ADFS).Oversee browser release rings (Canary, Dev, Beta, Stable, Extended), application compatibility, cross-browser redirection, and legacy web application access. VDI & Workplace Infrastructure IntegrationManage browser profile persistence, cookie containerization, and session state performance in Citrix, VDI, and FSLogix non-persistent desktop environments.Maintain golden images, optimize image provisioning, and troubleshoot browser behavior across virtual and physical Windows/ChromeOS endpoints. Advanced Troubleshooting & ObservabilityPerform deep-dive L3/L4 technical root cause analysis (RCA) on complex browser, authentication, extension, and network connectivity issues using tools such as Procmon, Sysinternals, Chrome DevTools, HAR capture, Fiddler, and Wireshark.Diagnose and resolve complex edge cases around SSL/TLS certificate chains, CORS, web proxy routing, and identity/SAML assertions. Amazon MGM Studios Technology is looking for a Technology Operations Engineer to help drive the execution and improvement of key service delivery processes throughout the Studios organization.

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

Our TechOps teams support the Studios production personnel (cast and crew) and Studios business teams (content development, software engineering, content programming and marketing).  Job Summary

The Senior EndPoint Administrator supports the maintenance, enhancement, and security of enterprise systems, including infrastructure, applications, and access controls. This role is responsible for troubleshooting complex system issues, implementing technical solutions, and ensuring the integrity and security of system configurations. The Senior EndPoint Administrator collaborates with cross-functional teams to manage infrastructure, application environments, and system-level security, with availability for after-hours support and participation in on-call rotations.

 Essential Functions

- Administers and supports enterprise infrastructure and systems, including servers, storage, and cloud-based platforms.

- Diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues, including hardware failures, software problems, and access-related incidents.

- Maintains system documentation, configuration standards, and procedures in accordance with organizational policies.

- Implements system updates, patches, and enhancements to ensure optimal performance and security.

- Manages access controls and security roles within enterprise applications, including ERP and HCM platforms.

- Participates in system security design, access provisioning, and auditing efforts to maintain compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

- Collaborates with IT, Cybersecurity, and Identity Access Management (IAM) teams to support user access, security testing, and incident response.

- Supports automation and optimization initiatives related to system performance and user provisioning.

- Participates in rotational on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities as required.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

- Maintains regular and reliable attendance.

- Complies with all policies and standards.

Position-Specific Responsibilities

- Design, optimize, and maintain enterprise MECM infrastructure (Primary Sites, CMG, DPs, WSUS) while driving co-management strategies, workload transitions, and adoption of modern endpoint technologies.

- Establish endpoint security baselines, drift detection, and automated remediation aligned with CIS Benchmarks and NIST controls to lead vulnerability management and audit readiness.

- Develop PowerShell scripts for automated administration and build custom SQL, SSRS, and Power BI dashboards to deliver executive and compliance reporting.

- Serve as the primary escalation point for advanced infrastructure and deployment issues while providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level administrators.

Qualifications

- H.S. Diploma or GED required

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field preferred

- 4-6 years of progressive experience in systems administration supporting mid-to-large enterprise environments required

- Experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting infrastructure components (e.g., servers, storage, virtualization, networking) and enterprise applications required

- 3-5 years of experience with access and security administration in enterprise platforms (e.g., ERP, HCM, EHR) preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

- Experience administering Microsoft SCCM/MECM/InTune and in an enterprise environment.

- Strong experience with:
o Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM)

o Microsoft InTune

o Windows Server

o Windows 10/11 administration
o Active Directory
o Group Policy
o PowerShell scripting
o SQL Server reporting
o Windows deployment services
o Endpoint security technologies

- Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration.

- Strong understanding of system security, backup, and recovery procedures.

- Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

- Familiarity with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking concepts.

- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

- Strong communication and customer service skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Licenses and Certifications

- Relevant certification in systems administration, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server+, or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) preferred

- Security or access management certifications, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security certification preferred

jobs.description:
Who We Are: WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment.

 Who We Are:
WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.
 The Company

 TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

 Role Overview

The MDM Analyst will be an integral role in the MDM and Data Governance organization. This is a hands-on analyst role that supports the implementation of the MDM strategy, working closely with data stewards, business stakeholders, technology teams, and other members of the data team.

Roles and Responsibilities

Reporting to the Senior Director, Data Governance, this role combines data analysis, data quality, metadata management, documentation, governance, and program coordination. It will help identify and resolve data issues, document master data requirements and standards, maintain governance information within TKO’s data catalog, and support effective operation of the MDM program. The role will initially support master and reference data domains across TKO, which may include customers and consumers, organizations, partners, products, venues, events, and other core enterprise entities.

MDM and Data Quality

-
Perform data profiling and data quality analysis across key master data domains, identifying duplicates, completeness issues, inconsistencies and potential root causes.

-
Work with data stewards and subject-matter experts to define and document master data requirements, business rules, data quality rules, and validation criteria.

-
Support the identification of authoritative data sources and document how master data is created, maintained, distributed, and consumed across TKO.

-
Track data quality issues through identification, ownership, remediation, and closure.

-
Analyse recurring data issues, track trends, and support the identification of potential root causes and remediation opportunities.

-
Document details for MDM in the data catalog (Atlan) and own the overall day-to-day administration of the data catalog (Atlan), including user access and routine upkeep.

-
Provide recurring MDM reporting, including data quality scorecards and program metrics, and present to senior management and stakeholders.

Program and Coordination Support

-
Support the implementation of TKO's MDM strategy and data lifecycle framework, helping translate agreed principles into requirements, processes, controls and operational activities.

-
Own the MDM program trackers, task lists, and status logs.

-
Consolidate updates from team members and partners into clear summaries, ensuring all outstanding items are accurately tracked and statused.

-
Prepare materials for governance meetings and working groups, such as drafting slides, taking notes, and capturing action items. Track program status against goals and communicate where items need attention to senior team members.

Collaboration and Learning

-
Work closely with data stewards, business teams, technology teams, and SMEs across the different BUs and functions

-
Build a strong understanding of TKO’s data, MDM concepts, and governance practices, taking on growing responsibility over time.

-
Respond to routine questions about data definitions and documentation.

Qualifications

-
3-5 years of experience in a data, analytical, or administrative support role, including hands-on exposure to working with data, which is required

-
A degree in information systems, data, business, analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

-
Good understanding of core data concepts such as data quality, data structures, data definitions, metadata, and data lifecycle management. Prior Master Data Management experience is beneficial but not required.

-
Strong proficiency with Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, including organizing, maintaining, and reviewing data and records.

-
Working knowledge of SQL with the ability to carry out analysis and data quality checks.

What We’re Looking For

-
Interest in data management, data quality, and data governance, with an eagerness to expand MDM knowledge and skills across processes and systems.

-
Willingness to learn MDM and data governance tools and platforms, with training provided on the job.

-
Strong attention to detail and good organizational habits, with the ability to keep documentation and trackers accurate and tidy.

-
Clear written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to follow direction and ask questions when something is unclear.

-
A collaborative, reliable, and proactive attitude, with eagerness to learn and grow within the data governance team.

-
A careful and responsible approach to handling personal and sensitive information.

-
Experience and/or interest in media, sports, entertainment, live events, or consumer data environments.

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you'll do at Jamf :

In this role the Systems Development Engineer I at Jamf is responsible for automation and development of our backend infrastructure that powers the Jamf Cloud that our customers rely on to manage Apple devices in their organizations. This includes providing the internal infrastructure that our Software Development Engineers use to build and deploy Jamf products in the Cloud.

 You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter.

  What you can expect to do in this role :

- Develop, deploy, and maintain production environments by identifying and applying automation, tools, and techniques such as Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Serverless, and Containerization.

- Ensure security best practices are identified and integrated into system designs and configuration.

- Assist in evaluating, planning, configuration, and implementation of new software services.

- Develop custom tools and automation through programming and scripting.

- Support Software Development by maintaining and scaling our Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery environment as needed.

- Apply Data Lifecycle Management to sensitive data through backups, permissions management, and auditing.

- Participate in an on-call rotation, triaging and escalating alerts, and assisting in disaster recovery as necessary for services the team is responsible for.

- Member of an Agile Team providing code reviews, velocity estimation, planning input, and participating in other Agile Methodology workflows.

- Work and communicate effectively with Product Owners, Development teams, and Cloud and Delivery teams.

- Create and maintain technical documentation.

- Performs other duties as required and completes all job functions as per departmental policies and procedures.

- #LIRemote

What we are looking for:

- Minimum of 1 year experience in one or more of (Required):

  - Continuous Integration Tools and Techniques (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Github Actions)

  - Configuration management and deployment tools (e.g. Ansible, Chef, Puppet).

  - Systems Administration or similar role focused on performance analysis, capacity planning, and forecasting.

- Minimum of 1 year experience as a power user of various operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows, Mac) (Required).

- Minimum of 1 year experience in a current programming language (e.g. Python, Golang) (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience using Source Control Management tools (e.g. Git, Subversion) (Preferred).

- Minimum of 1 year experience using issue tracking software (e.g. JIRA) (Preferred).

- Minimum of 1 year experience developing enterprise grade software with understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (Preferred).

- Minimum of 1 year experience building and maintaining cloud native services with Amazon Web Services (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience working with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. LogicMonitor, Sumologic, ELK) (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience with containerization concepts and Kubernetes (Preferred)

- Minimum of 1 year experience working with structured databases (e.g. MySQL, DynamoDB) (Preferred)

- Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity.

- 4 year / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

- A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered.

- Certificates commonly held by those in the role include one or more of: LPIC-1, LPIC-2, LPIC-3, RHCE (RedHat Certified Engineer), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified Developer Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Associate. (Preferred)

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- This position will perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen located physically in the U.S., and therefore any employment offer will be contingent upon verification of both of these requirements. Applicants who are not U.S. citizens or who are located outside of the U.S. are strongly encouraged to apply for other positions at Jamf , which is an equal-opportunity employer.

The EndPoint Administrator supports, maintains, and administers enterprise systems, infrastructure, and application environments. This role is responsible for responding to system-related incidents, troubleshooting technical issues, and implementing effective solutions. The EndPoint Administrator ensures that systems are functioning efficiently and securely while collaborating with cross-functional teams to support technology operations across the organization.

 Essential Functions

- Supports and maintains enterprise systems, servers, applications, and related infrastructure.

- Maintains accurate documentation of system configurations, procedures, and incident resolutions.

- Build, test, and deploy Group Policy Objects (GPOs) and Intune configuration profiles/security baselines.

- Partner with Cybersecurity teams to remediate endpoint vulnerabilities and enforce PCI, CIS, and regulatory compliance standards.

- Monitor client agent health, deployment metrics, and assist in maintaining MECM distribution points, management points, and site infrastructure.

Qualifications

- H.S. Diploma or GED required

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred

- 2-4 years of experience in systems administration required

- Experience supporting a mid to large-size enterprise environment preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

o Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), preferred

o Microsoft InTune, preferred

o Windows Server, preferred

o Windows 10/11 administration, preferred
o Active Directory, preferred
o Group Policy, preferred
o PowerShell scripting, preferred
o SQL Server reporting, preferred
o Windows deployment services, preferred
o Endpoint security technologies, preferred

- Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration.

- Strong understanding of system security, backup, and recovery procedures.

- Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).

- Familiarity with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking concepts.

- Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.

- Strong communication and customer service skills.

- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Licenses and Certifications

- Relevant certification in systems administration, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server+, or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) preferred

- Security or access management certifications, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security certification preferred

CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two-component security product. One component is a “ sensor ”, which is a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network can correlate malicious behavior across multiple machines and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.

Join CrowdStrike and become a key leader in building the most innovative endpoint security solution in the world. Our sensor development team is responsible for building the endpoint sensor which deploys on multiple platforms including Windows, Mac, and Linux. As a Senior II Software Engineer , you will be expected to have ownership over major components and development projects.
You will be required to assist with architecting solutions and support in implementing our core features. Features will cross-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory and process, and networking.

Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across multiple platforms.

You need to be able to lead projects efficiently while maximizing performance and minimizing costs, making sure high standards are being followed when it comes to design, coding quality, and unit and component testing.

Detection and Response Security Software.

Collaborate with multi-functional teams in various locations.

What You'll Need:

-

-
Strong low-level OS internals in either Windows, Mac OS, or Linux.

Experience debugging memory corruptions, process contentions and system performance.

-
Experience working with teams to ship major features and releases.

OS system expertise for core concepts and subsystems such as WFP, TCP/IP, USB, file systems etc.

Knowledge in Security.

-
Strong background in scalable, light-weight and highly performing systems.

-
Familiarity and experience with Agile process.

With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Under the direction of the Director of IT Infrastructure, the Systems Administrator will provide technical assistance and guidance to build and monitor information technology assets on premise and cloud based. This role will provide administration to maintain and resolve problems associated to servers and systems for the organization. The ideal candidate for this role will be a subject matter expert in server, storage and cloud infrastructure. You will be able to efficiently build, maintain and monitor said infrastructures to allow ExactCare to meet organizational objectives. ExactCare fosters a high-performing environment driven by our Core Values and commitment to our Patient Promise.

- Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot windows server software deployments

The Junior Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and support of Windows-based information systems, cloud services, and end-user computing environments.

The Junior Systems Administrator is responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, and support of Windows-based information systems, cloud services, and end-user computing environments. Working under the guidance of senior technical staff, the Junior Systems Administrator assists with system deployments, user administration, endpoint management, patch management, vulnerability remediation, and security operations while ensuring systems remain reliable, secure, and compliant with organizational policies.

 Note, this position will begin as a part time role.

This position provides an excellent opportunity for an early-career IT professional to develop expertise in Microsoft technologies, cybersecurity, cloud administration, and enterprise IT operations.

 Primary Responsibilities

- Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows workstations, servers, and Microsoft 365 environments

- Administer user accounts in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Active Directory

- Deploy and manage Windows devices using Microsoft Intune

- Provide technical support for hardware, software, printers, mobile devices, and end users

- Perform operating system updates, patch management, and vulnerability remediation

- Monitor system performance, endpoint compliance, backups, and security alerts

- Assist with server upgrades, migrations, and technology deployments

- Maintain accurate system documentation, asset inventories, and change records

- Support cybersecurity initiatives and compliance with frameworks such as CMMC and NIST SP 800-171

- Collaborate with senior administrators to troubleshoot issues and improve IT operations

- Travel occasionally to customer sites or company locations (approximately one to two trips per year, averaging three days per trip)

 Required Qualifications

- Experience in IT systems administration, technical support, or help desk

- Working knowledge of Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365

- Familiarity with Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID

- Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP)

- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and communication skills

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail

- Due to the requirements of this position, applicants must be U.S. citizens and authorized to work in the United States.

 Technical Requirements
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to perform the following tasks with minimal supervision:

- Configure and deploy Windows 11 workstations in accordance with organizational standards

- Perform a complete Windows 11 operating system reset, reinstallation, and recovery while preserving or restoring required system functionality

- Build a Windows 11 computer from bare hardware through delivery to the end user, including:

  - Installing Windows 11

  - Applying operating system updates

  - Installing hardware drivers

  - Configuring BIOS/UEFI settings as required

  - Joining devices to Microsoft Entra ID or Active Directory

  - Enrolling devices in Microsoft Intune

  - Applying security baselines and configuration policies

  - Installing and configuring required business applications

  - Configuring Microsoft 365 applications and user profiles

  - Enabling Microsoft Defender security features

  - Verifying device compliance and operational readiness

- Troubleshoot Windows startup, operating system, hardware driver, and application issues

- Install, configure, and update desktop software and security applications

- Understand Windows file systems, user profiles, local security settings, and system configuration tools

- Utilize PowerShell and administrative utilities to perform common system administration tasks.

- Follow documented build procedures and configuration standards to ensure consistent, repeatable workstation deployments

 Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

- Experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, Windows Server, Hyper-V or VMware, and PowerShell

- Familiarity with vulnerability management and remote monitoring tools

- Experience supporting cloud environments

- Exposure to cybersecurity concepts and best practices

- Experience with ticketing systems such as Autotask, ConnectWise, or ServiceNow

- Prior military experience is highly desired

- CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+

- Microsoft Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)

- Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900)

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate

jobs.description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.

Smartsheet is scaling its India Global Capability Centre, and we're hiring a Senior Manager to lead IT End User Services, including our Security & Desktop Systems team and our IT Automation Engineering team, supporting a Mac-first environment (roughly 80% macOS, 20% Windows).

You'll lead two complementary teams that keep Smartsheet's global workforce productive and secure.

The first is our Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, a cross-functional team that pairs Service Desk support with first-line security triage and response. Employees get one team that fixes their problems and protects them. The second is our IT Automation Engineers, who build the tooling that makes that work faster and more consistent.

You'll set the operating standards, own performance against SLAs and quality targets, and shape the automation roadmap so repetitive work disappears and service quality rises.

For the right candidate, this role has a clear path to Director as we continue scaling our India GCC, with that step anticipated within 12-18 months.

You'll report to the Sr. Director of End User Systems and partner day to day with our US-based Desktop Support managers, shaping how both regions work together.

#### You Will

**Security & Desktop Systems Team**

- Lead the India-based Security & Desktop Systems Specialists, working daily with US counterparts to align priorities, coverage, and ways of working
- Own team performance against SLAs, quality standards, and service desk metrics, and drive continuous improvement
- Oversee resolution of tickets across hardware, software, network, and user access
- Own desktop administration across a Mac-first fleet (macOS and Windows), including software deployment, system configuration, user provisioning, enrollment, and hardware lifecycle management
- Step in hands-on when volumes spike, critical issues arise, or the team needs support, and coach people through the fix
- Ensure knowledge base articles and process documentation are current, high quality, and consistently maintained

**Security Operations (Tier 1)**

- Oversee the team's first-line SOC responsibilities, including alert triage, escalation, and response
- Ensure the team follows incident response playbooks, and improve them as threats and tooling evolve
- Partner with the wider security organisation so Tier 1 handoffs are fast, accurate, and well documented
- Track SOC quality and response metrics, and build the team's security capability over time
- Balance support and security workload so neither is neglected as volumes change

**IT Automation Engineering**

- Lead the IT Automation Engineers, setting priorities and owning the automation roadmap
- Identify high-volume, repetitive Tier 1 work, prioritise it by impact, and ensure it is automated and measured
- Identify where AI-augmented workflows can meaningfully reduce toil (e.g. intelligent ticket triage, SOC alert summarisation, AI-assisted knowledge base drafting) and direct the team in delivering them
- Set automation standards, review technical designs before deployment, and help debug when automations fail or stall
- Coach engineers on best practices

**People Leadership**

- Set clear direction, track progress, remove blockers, and escalate capacity constraints
- Design and lead onboarding for new team members
- Coach and mentor India-based engineers and specialists, support their career growth, and hire and develop top technical talent

#### You Have

**Experience**

- 8+ years in IT support, Service Desk, or end user services operations, with deep working knowledge of the systems and processes involved
- 4+ years leading technical support teams in matrixed or distributed organisations
- Direct experience overseeing or working in security operations, such as SOC triage, alert response, or incident response
- Experience leading or working closely with engineers who build automation or integrations, with enough technical grounding to review their work and set direction
- A track record of setting direction and delivering cross-functional projects through ambiguity
- Proven ability to step into technical problems when the team needs it, and to diagnose and resolve issues credibly

**Technical skills**

- Deep hands-on expertise in macOS endpoint management through Jamf (or a comparable Apple MDM such as Kandji or Mosyle), including zero-touch enrollment, policy and patch management, and Apple Business Manager
- Working knowledge of Windows endpoint management through Intune
- Solid understanding of identity and productivity platforms (Active Directory/Entra ID, M365)
- Working experience with Freshservice or a similar ITSM platform, including workflow design and governance
- Working knowledge of EDR platforms (including macOS coverage), firewalls, and incident response practices
- Familiarity with ITIL or equivalent frameworks

**Preferred**

- Technical background in PowerShell, Python, or shell scripting, with the ability to review and guide automation work
- Experience bringing AI/LLM capabilities into IT workflows via API or SDK, either building them or directing the engineers who do
- Experience with API integrations or workflow orchestration in an ITSM environment

**Work Style**

- Excellent English communication, strong self-motivation, and reliable follow-through
- Comfortable moving between leading the team and rolling up your sleeves, in a US-directed, India-based structure
- Flexible working hours to accommodate daily India ↔ US coordination
- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

**Get to Know Us:**

At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You’ll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you’re doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that’s magic at work. Let’s build what’s next, together.

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**

Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information.

If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

jobs.description:
Senior IT AdministratorLocation: Remote, USA About SylloSyllo is defining the Litigation AI category.

 Senior IT Administrator

 Location: Remote, USA

 About Syllo

 Syllo is defining the Litigation AI category. We are the first unified platform designed to autonomously manage the entire litigation lifecycle end to end. Founded in 2019 by a team of litigators and engineers, Syllo enables legal teams to securely harness the power of AI across any matter, regardless of complexity or scale. Our technology supports Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw 200 firms in managing their most complex litigation portfolios. Awarded ILTA Transformative Project of the Year and ALM eDiscovery Technology of the Year for 2026, we are the market leader in enterprise grade litigation AI. Backed by top tier VCs, we empower enterprise legal departments to move faster, mitigate risk, and push the boundaries of what technology can achieve.

 About the role

 Own our company-wide IT infrastructure and power AI-driven support across a fast-scaling team.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of Syllo 's corporate IT infrastructure. You will manage our hardware fleet, identity and access management, device provisioning workflows, and SaaS applications—ensuring our distributed team remains secure, productive, and supported.

You’ll also leverage modern AI capabilities to scale internal IT support, automate issue reporting, and serve as a key technical partner as our team integrates new AI workflows into our tooling stack. Working closely with Security Engineering, you’ll embed the administrative and endpoint controls necessary to maintain our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance standards.

We are looking for a hands-on IT leader who brings strong technical judgment, proactive problem-solving, and a dedication to creating a smooth, secure employee experience.

 What you will do

-
 Own the corporate IT estate: Manage identity, endpoint devices, SaaS administration, and security posture across a distributed, multi-OS workforce.

-
 Scale support with AI: Implement and manage AI-driven workflows to automate ticketing, self-service support, and issue reporting to ensure high-velocity resolution as Syllo grows.

-
 Navigate AI integrations: Partner with internal teams and vendors to resolve AI integration requirements, ensuring seamless and secure adoption across our tech stack.

-
 Drive hardware provisioning: Oversee procurement, configuration, shipping, asset tracking, and offboarding recovery so every employee has working equipment on day one.

-
 Administer identity & access: Manage identity providers (SSO, MFA, group permissions) and streamline joiner/mover/leaver access workflows.

-
 Maintain compliance controls: Collect and maintain audit evidence, access reviews, asset logs, and change records to support SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 frameworks.

-
 Optimize the SaaS suite: Oversee application inventories, admin privileges, license utilization, and vendor renewal cycles.

-
 Manage vendors & MSPs: Own relationships with managed service providers, hardware resellers, and software vendors to maximize service quality and cost efficiency.

-
 Partner with Security Engineering: Deploy endpoint and identity controls aligned with security guidelines to protect corporate data.

-
 Build clear IT documentation: Create comprehensive runbooks and documentation so IT processes are transparent, repeatable, and scalable.

 What you bring

-
 Corporate IT ownership: Proven experience as a senior or primary owner of corporate IT in a remote or distributed tech environment.

-
 AI-driven operations: Practical habits around using AI tools to streamline support, automate routine tasks, and troubleshoot software integrations.

-
 Identity & MDM depth: Hands-on experience administering identity providers (Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID) and device management platforms (Jamf, Kandji, Intune).

-
 Compliance familiarity: Experience supporting SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 audits and a clear understanding of acceptable audit evidence.

-
 High-velocity provisioning: Track record of running seamless onboarding and equipment logistics during periods of rapid hiring.

-
 Vendor management: Experience managing MSP relationships, contract renewals, and vendor budgets effectively.

-
 Service-minded judgment: Ability to solve team IT challenges quickly while maintaining strong security and compliance standards politely.

 Experience and qualifications

- 5+ years of corporate IT experience, including time as a senior or sole owner of the IT function in a fast-growing environment.

- Practical experience or strong proficiency leveraging AI tools to automate IT workflows, report issues, and support team tool integrations.

- Hands-on experience administering an identity provider (Okta, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Entra ID) and an MDM platform (Jamf, Kandji, or Intune).

- Proven experience supporting SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 compliance frameworks and audit processes.

- Experience managing IT operations for a remote-first or distributed workforce.

- Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CompTIA, Okta, Jamf, Microsoft) are a strong plus.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

 Total rewards and benefits

At Syllo , we believe in taking care of our team so they can focus on building the future of legal tech.

-
 Compensation: Competitive base salary + equity options. Range: $140k to $180k

-
 Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and voluntary insurance options. Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays. Access to benefit counselors and fitness class reimbursements.

-
 Growth: Annual learning and development budget and real career growth in a fast-scaling organization.

 Equal opportunity employer

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide a fair and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations during the application or interview stage, please let us know.

United States - Remote Pay Range

$140,000—$180,000 USD

jobs.description:
Founded in 2015, Sure is the first AI-native insurance platform.

Founded in 2015, Sure is the first AI-native insurance platform. With AI built into every layer, from underwriting guardrails to claims automation, Sure 's enterprise infrastructure powers the world's most recognized brands and carriers.

Our APIs and AI agents streamline the entire insurance lifecycle, making quoting, binding, policy servicing, and claims faster and smarter. The result: faster time to market, better customer experiences, and intelligent insurance at scale. Sure is building the technology rails transforming how insurance is distributed, underwritten, and experienced.

Why join our team?

🌐 Remote-first culture. We work from home and embrace digital collaboration

💥 Impactful work. We're transforming a trillion-dollar industry that touches everyone's lives

🏆 Award-winning growth. Named among Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. 5000, Forbes Fintech 50, and CNBC World's Top Insurtech Companies

🤝 Culture is everything. Join an incredible team of smart, passionate, collaborative and driven individuals

 We're growing!

 Sure 's IT and Infrastructure team keeps a remote company, its SaaS stack, and its cloud environment running and secure. We are hiring an IT Systems Engineer to own day-to-day IT for the whole company and to be the person our engineers, DevOps team, and security lead can count on to get things done.

You will report to our VP of IT and work closely with our DevOps engineers. The work is broad. One hour you are provisioning access for a new hire, the next you are tracking down why an endpoint is out of compliance, and later you are pulling evidence for a SOC 2 audit. You won't know every tool on day one, and that's fine. We care more about how you jump into something unfamiliar and figure it out.

What you'll be doing:

- Own the service desk. Triage and resolve IT requests from a fully remote team through Slack and our ticketing system.

- Provision, change, and remove user access across Google Workspace, Slack, AWS, and the rest of our SaaS stack. Keep onboarding and offboarding clean and fast.

- Manage our Mac fleet through MDM. Handle procurement, shipping, repair, recovery, and inventory for company equipment.

- Administer company tooling so the rest of the team doesn't have to.

- Support our security program. Triage alerts and findings from tools like Wiz, Datadog, and our endpoint protection, and route them to the right engineer with clear context.

- Collect and organize evidence for SOC 2 and PCI audits, and help fill out customer security questionnaires.

- Write down what you learn. Build runbooks and documentation so fixes happen once, not every time.

- Recommend and implement improvements to IT policies, processes, and tools. Use AI and scripting to automate repeat work.

What we're looking for:

- 5+ years of experience in IT systems administration or IT support across more than one company or environment.

- Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace and a SaaS-heavy stack, including identity and access management.

- Experience managing macOS devices with an MDM (Iru, Jamf, or similar).

- Working knowledge of AWS, including IAM basics.

- Comfort with shell scripting or Python to automate routine tasks.

- Exposure to security tooling (CSPM, EDR, SIEM, or vulnerability scanners) and a strong interest in growing on the security side.

- A service-first attitude. You are patient, clear, and friendly with non-technical teammates.

- The courage to jump into unfamiliar systems, ask how urgent a request is, and prioritize without waiting for permission.

- Clear written communication. You document your work so others can follow it.

- Nice to have: experience supporting a SOC 2 or PCI audit, experience with Wiz or Datadog, or experience working alongside software engineers in a SaaS company.

  Sure is currently hiring employees with residence in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, IL, MD, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NM, NY, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, WA

What we do for you

- Unlimited PTO, and we mean it

- Mental health support: meditation app access and a weekly wellness hour

- Remote work stipend for your setup

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision options

- Equity and 401(k)

- Generous parental leave

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust.

At Jamf , we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #One Jamf .

What you'll do at Jamf :

In this role the Systems Development Engineer II at Jamf is responsible for automation and development of our backend infrastructure that powers the Jamf Cloud that our customers rely on to manage Apple devices in their organizations. This includes providing the internal infrastructure that our Software Development Engineers use to build and deploy Jamf products in the Cloud.

 You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter.

  What you can expect to do in this role :

- Develop, deploy, and maintain production environments by identifying and applying automation, tools, and techniques such as Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Serverless, and Containerization

- Ensure security best practices are identified and integrated into system designs and configuration

- Assist in evaluating, planning, configuration, and implementation of new software services

- Develop custom tools and automation through programming and scripting.

- Support Software Development by maintaining and scaling our Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery environment as needed

- Apply Data Lifecycle Management to sensitive data through backups, permissions management, and auditing

- Participate in an on-call rotation, triaging and escalating alerts, and assisting in disaster recovery as necessary for services the team is responsible for

- Member of an Agile Team providing code reviews, velocity estimation, planning input, and participating in other Agile Methodology workflows

- Work and communicate effectively with Product Owners, Development teams, and Cloud and Delivery teams

- Create and maintain technical documentation

- Performs other duties as required and completes all job functions as per departmental policies and procedures

- #LIRemote

What we are looking for:

- Minimum of 2 year experience in one or more of (Required):

  - Continuous Integration Tools and Techniques (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Github Actions)

  - Configuration management and deployment tools (e.g. Ansible, Chef, Puppet).

  - Systems Administration or similar role focused on performance analysis, capacity planning, and forecasting.

- Minimum of 2 year experience as a power user of various operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows, Mac) (Required).

- Minimum of 2 year experience in a current programming language (e.g. Python, Golang) (Required)

- Minimum of 2 year experience using Source Control Management tools (e.g. Git, Subversion) (Required).

- Minimum of 2 year experience using issue tracking software (e.g. JIRA) (Preferred).

- Experience developing enterprise grade software with understanding of the software development life cycle (Preferred).

- Experience with infrastructure as code techniques (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation) (Preferred)

- Experience in enterprise security and hardening best practices (Preferred).

- Experience building and maintaining cloud native services (e.g. Amazon Web Services, Azure, GCP) (Preferred)

- Experience working with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. LogicMonitor, Sumologic, ELK) (Preferred)

- Experience with containerization concepts and Kubernetes (Preferred)

- Experience working with structured databases (e.g. MySQL, DynamoDB) (Preferred)

- Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity.

- 4 year / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

- A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered.

- Certificates commonly held by those in the role include one or more of: LPIC-1, LPIC-2, LPIC-3, RHCE (RedHat Certified Engineer), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified Developer Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Associate. (Preferred)

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- This position will perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen located physically in the U.S., and therefore any employment offer will be contingent upon verification of both of these requirements. Applicants who are not U.S. citizens or who are located outside of the U.S. are strongly encouraged to apply for other positions at Jamf , which is an equal-opportunity employer.

How we help you reach your best potential:

- Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News

- Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024

- Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Our developers work in agile delivery teams to produce new features, improve software components, and are the subject matter experts for our Jamf product offerings.

- You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

- We constantly push the boundaries of technology, our developers support new innovations and OS releases the moment they are made available by Apple.

- Several Jamf engineers are named in patents and with team names like CatDog, ThunderSnow and Dalek you can expect to have some fun while building cutting-edge software.

- You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect.

- We offer a clear career path that enables you to grow under supportive leadership and management

- Visit our Jamf Engineering blog to learn more about the innovative projects our team is working on and what we learn from each challenge we solve. A blog written by engineers, for engineers at medium.com/jamf-engineering

- 22 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

- Over 100,000 Jamf Nation users, the largest online IT community in the world.

 Pay Transparency

Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

Joining our team means being part of a passionate group focused on transforming how companies understand and connect with their customers.

Let’s build experiences people love—together.

 The Opportunity

The IT team at UserTesting manages company-wide systems and serves as an integration, automation, and support point for the company's technology initiatives. The Senior IT Systems Administrator, AI & Automation manages critical platforms and helps set the technical direction for how they are configured, integrated, scaled, and secured across a large and varied enterprise tool set and a mixed macOS and Windows environment.

This role can lead platform initiatives end to end, from scoping and design through implementation and handover, and is accountable for the ongoing health, security posture, and lifecycle of the systems they own. Increasingly, that work includes connecting our systems to Automation & AI tooling enabling advanced capabilities in the platforms we already run, and building the integrations and access controls that let those capabilities operate safely.

Where an IT Systems Administrator can execute with approved designs, the Senior IT Systems Administrator produces the design, decides the approach with IT management, and reviews and validates changes requested for platforms they manage. The role is the senior technical escalation point for the IT team and mentors IT Systems Administrators and IT Support Specialists in the systems and practices behind that work.

Responsibilities

 Platform Ownership, Automation, and Security

- Manage IT owned enterprise platforms including Okta, Google Workspace, and Intune covering configuration standards, release management, integration patterns, and long-term roadmap.

- Lead platform initiatives end to end: requirements, design, sequencing, rollback and validation planning, and execution to completion.

- Own change management for assigned platforms, reviewing changes proposed by IT Systems Administrators and determining what requires escalation.

- Set and enforce technical standards across IT processes and applications, including automated provisioning models, group and permission strategy, SSO and SCIM patterns, vulnerability management, and automation and integration capability.

- Design and build integrations and automations using REST APIs, Okta Workflows, and scripting in Python and Bash; own the frameworks others build on, and keep the automation ecosystem current as applications and connected endpoints change.

- Stand up and maintain the integration layer that connects internal tools and data sources to AI systems, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers scoping access, managing credentials, and troubleshooting connectivity.

- Evaluate, enable, and govern AI features within platforms we already run (for example Atlassian Rovo, Claude, ChatGPT, Google Gemini), working with vendors and internal stakeholders on configuration, rollout, and usage guardrails..

- Assist the security and development teams in enforcement across assigned platforms, including least-privilege access design, configuration hardening, and vulnerability remediation; run periodic access reviews and produce evidence for internal and external audit.

 Cross-Functional Delivery, Vendors, and Budget

- Partner with business system owners across departments to administer, integrate, and improve the tools their teams depend on, acting as technical advisor on selection and configuration.

- Improve cross-departmental processes spanning multiple systems, and maintain visibility of the application ecosystem including ownership, access patterns, integrations, and overlap.

- Improve manual processes across IT and other departments through automation.

- Assist in IT budget management through tool and license optimization, identifying underused spend, overlap, and consolidation opportunities.

- Research, evaluate, and run proof of concept work on new solutions including the fast-moving AI tooling ecosystem keeping the team's tooling current as the technology landscape changes.

 Escalation, Enablement, and Documentation

- Act as the senior technical escalation point for the IT team, owning complex ITSM failures spanning multiple systems, leading root cause analysis, and driving the corrective actions that follow.

- Mentor IT Systems Administrators and IT Support Specialists, reviewing their configuration and automation work and deliberately transferring knowledge rather than retaining it.

- Author and maintain architecture documentation, access maps, runbooks, and administrative procedures including for integrations, automated workflows, and AI-connected systems and hold the team's documentation standard.

Requirements

- Able to work Monday through Friday in the US Eastern or Central time zone.

- 5+ years of experience administering enterprise IT systems in a system administrator capacity..

- Deep administrative expertise in enterprise identity (Okta, including Okta Workflows), Google Workspace administration, and endpoint management across a mixed macOS and Windows environment (Jamf, Intune)

- Proven ability to build integrations and automations using APIs and scripting languages like Python and/or Bash not only configuring vendor-provided features, but connecting tools together to improve functionality and output.

- Familiarity with API-based integrations: managing keys, scoping permissions, reading documentation, and troubleshooting connectivity between systems.

- Hands-on exposure to AI tooling in an enterprise context enabling and governing AI features in SaaS platforms, or standing up and securing AI integrations such as MCP servers. Certifications in AI platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, Anthropic) are a plus, but demonstrated hands-on experience is valued more highly; be prepared to walk through real examples.

- Track record leading technical projects affecting the entire company, including migrations or platform replacements, and stakeholder and IT project management.

- Experience producing audit evidence and operating access controls.

- Ability to work in a Kanban-style environment, managing due dates, incoming work, and technical debt effectively.

- Demonstrated ability to work directly with other departments on their tools and processes, translating business requirements into technical solutions.

- Willingness and ability to continually learn and grow. The technology space is constantly evolving, and we must evolve with it — this is especially true of AI, where change is unavoidable.

 Don’t meet every single requirement but excited about the role? We encourage you to apply. Research shows that some candidates are less likely to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications—but you may be exactly who we’re looking for. The Mission Driver Enablement Center (MDEC) in Leidos is seeking an experienced Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Engineer.

The Mission Driver Enablement Center (MDEC) in Leidos is seeking an experienced Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Engineer. This is a fully remote position open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.

CLEARANCE REQUIREMENT:

Must have an active Public Trust with ability to obtain Secret or higher, as needed, US CITIZENSHIP REQUIRED.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The ideal candidate brings deep Nexthink expertise, having progressed beyond platform administration into engineering, automation, and enterprise integrations. They combine DEX knowledge with endpoint engineering, observability, and analytics to turn telemetry and user experience data into scalable solutions that drive measurable improvements in digital employee experience at enterprise scale.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILTIES:

  Nexthink Platform Engineering & Administration

- Engineer, administer, and optimize the Nexthink Infinity platform, including Collectors, Investigations, Dashboards, Campaigns, Alerts, Remote Actions, and role-based access controls to support enterprise Digital Employee Experience capabilities.

- Ensure the stability, scalability, performance, security, and integrity of the Nexthink environment by applying platform governance, access controls, compliance requirements, and operational standards.

- Support the ongoing evolution and adoption of Nexthink capabilities through platform upgrades, feature adoption, continuous improvement, technical documentation, training materials, operational playbooks, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

  Automation & Self-Healing Engineering

- Develop, test, and maintain Nexthink Remote Actions and automated remediation workflows, including proactive, reactive, and self-healing solutions that address endpoint health, application performance, configuration, compliance, connectivity, and Microsoft 365 experience issues.

- Identify and implement opportunities to reduce manual support effort and improve operational efficiency by developing reusable automation frameworks, engineering standards, and scalable remediation capabilities.

  Integrations & Platform Engineering

- Support the design and implementation of integrations between Nexthink and enterprise platforms, leveraging APIs, web services, and automation platforms to orchestrate workflows and automate data exchange.

- Collaborate with stakeholders to operationalize DEX insights and remediation workflows, ensuring integrations align with enterprise architecture, security standards, and governance requirements.

  Analytics, Reporting & Adoption

- Develop Nexthink dashboards, investigations, and reporting solutions using NQL and platform analytics to monitor digital experience, identify trends and root causes, uncover automation opportunities, and translate telemetry and employee experience data into actionable insights for operational and executive stakeholders.

- Design and manage Nexthink Campaigns and employee engagement initiatives to gather feedback, measure sentiment, support organizational change and digital adoption, and partner with support and engineering teams to continuously improve employee technology experiences.

- Stay current on Nexthink capabilities, automation technologies, and industry best practices.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, coupled with 4-8 years of relevant experience; equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree

- 3+ years of hands-on experience administering, engineering, and supporting the Nexthink Infinity platform

- 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure, End User Computing (EUC), workplace technology, and/or endpoint engineering environments

- Proven analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills

- Experience analyzing large datasets and converting insights into actionable improvements

- Experience working in complex enterprise environments with cross-functional engineering and operations teams

Hands-on expertise with:

- Nexthink Remote Actions, Investigations and Dashboards, Campaigns and Alerts

- Application Experience and Software Metering

- Nexthink Query Language (NQL)

Experience and Understanding with the following:

- PowerShell (required)

- Bash/Shell scripting (preferred)

- Designing and developing automated remediation and self-healing solutions

- Building integrations using APIs, web services, and automation platforms

- Integrating Nexthink with ServiceNow, Moveworks or other similar products

- Endpoint management, security, and compliance (Intune, SCCM, Jamf, etc.)

- Microsoft 365

- Active Directory / Entra ID

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Nexthink certification(s)

- Experience with Nexthink AI Drive and Adopt

- Experience with ServiceNow ITSM, ITOM, and asset management

- Familiarity with Splunk or other observability platforms

- Knowledge of DEX frameworks, employee sentiment measurement, and Experience Level Objectives (XLOs)

- Proven experience implementing and scaling Nexthink in large enterprise environments supporting 10,000+ endpoints

 ****Candidates selected for an interview should note that it will be conducted live via video, with cameras on at all times. As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, you will complete formal identity verification.****

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos , we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
