The Principal Engineer for Digital Workplace Technology is a senior technical leader within NBCUniversal’s Workplace Technology Engineering (WTE) organization, responsible for defining and delivering the next-generation digital workplace platform.

The Principal Engineer for Digital Workplace Technology is a senior technical leader within NBCUniversal ’s Workplace Technology Engineering (WTE) organization, responsible for defining and delivering the next-generation digital workplace platform. This role spans enterprise collaboration, endpoint engineering, and AI platform engineering, including Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Platform, and enterprise AI solutions. This position plays a critical role in transforming NBCU’s digital workplace into an AI-first productivity platform that powers employee communication, engagement, and innovation.

Responsibilities:

Technology Strategy & Architecture

workplace platforms across collaboration, endpoints, and AI.

- Own the end-to-end architecture for Workplace Technology Engineering, ensuring
alignment with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.

- Serve as a technical authority for complex system design, scalability, and long-term
 platform evolution.

Digital Workplace Platform Engineering

Engineering Excellence & SRE Practices

  - Improve observability and monitoring

  - Automate operations to reduce manual toil

Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence

- Experience in media, entertainment, or large global enterprise environments

- Strong architectural, analytical, and problem-solving skills

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

- Strong business acuity, including understanding and practical application of relevant market/industry trends

- Ability to thrive in an ambiguous and fast-paced environment and to manage multiple simultaneous projects requiring organization and time management.

jobs.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners , a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

 Solutions Engineer – IT Security & Compliance

We are looking for a high-performing Solutions Engineer specializing in IT Security and Compliance to join our team. Acting as the technical backbone of our sales process, you will serve as the trusted advisor for our security portfolio—delivering high-impact product demonstrations, designing layered security architectures, and guiding customers through pre-sale strategies and post-sale implementations.

 Key Responsibilities:

-

 Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the technical expert across Kaseya’s security landscape, including Email Security, Microsoft 365 Defense, SIEM/MDR, and User-Based Security (Security Awareness Training & Identity Protection).

-

 Technical Discovery & Demonstrations: Conduct deep-dive technical discoveries and deliver customized, scenario-based product demonstrations aligned with client threat profiles.

-

 Architecture & Solution Design: Partner with Account Executives to design robust, multi-layered security and compliance frameworks tailored to client environments.

-

 Compliance Advisory: Help clients align their security posture with major regulatory frameworks (HIPAA, PCI-DSS, NIST, CMMC) using Kaseya’s compliance and auditing tools.

-

 Implementation & Best Practices: Provide post-sale technical consulting, assisting with deployment strategies, threat detection configurations, and ongoing security optimization.

-

 Feedback Loop: Collaborate with Product Management to advocate for feature enhancements based on real-world threat intelligence and customer feedback.

 Requirements:

-

 Technical Experience: 5+ years of pre-sales or technical solution architecture experience in cybersecurity, email security, or managed security solutions.

-

 Core Security Expertise: Hands-on knowledge of Email Security (phishing defense, DMARC/DKIM/SPF), Microsoft 365 security management, SIEM log analysis, and MDR workflows.

-

 User-Centric Defense: Solid understanding of user-based security, including Identity and Access Management (IAM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Security Awareness Training strategies.

-

 Compliance & Governance: Strong working knowledge of security standards and frameworks, including HIPAA, PCI-DSS, NIST (800-171/800-53), and CMMC.

-

 Infrastructure & Vulnerability Management: Deep familiarity with core IT infrastructure (Active Directory, Azure/Entra ID, core networking) and vulnerability assessment tools (e.g., OpenVAS, Nessus).

-

 Channel & ITSM Knowledge: Familiarity with MSP service delivery models, Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows, and ITSM practices (ITSM/ITIL certification a plus).

-

 Communication & Sales Acumen: Proven ability to translate complex threat vectors and compliance requirements into clear business value for C-level executives, technical leads, and non-technical stakeholders alike.

 Additional information
 Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
Overview:

  Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

   Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.
  Responsibilities:
  Description

 Empower AI is seeking an Endpoint Engineer – MAC SME to engineer and sustain the MAC (macOS / iOS/ Jamf) endpoint systems and infrastructure on the NIPRNet, SIPRNet and JWICS (as available) enclaves of a Department of War agency, where the same standards of automation, hardening, and RMF compliance apply but tooling, connectivity, and handling procedures differ. The engineer operates the classified-enclave endpoint management infrastructure (e.g., Jamf), engineers and validates hardened images and Group Policy baselines, executes CAT I/II/III patching within enclave constraints, supports classified VDI and cross-domain considerations, and produces RMF evidence for the classified endpoint systems. This TS/SCI privileged-user role is the Tier III escalation point for classified endpoint incidents. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

    THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

    JOB DUTIES:

  Engineer, operate, and maintain the NIPIRNet, SIPRNet and JWICS endpoint systems and management infrastructure (macOS / iOS/ Jamf, imaging, provisioning, Group Policy) in accordance with enclave-specific security, transfer, and handling procedures.
  Plan and execute CAT I/II/III patch and software deployments on the classified enclaves within PRS timeframes, managing media transfer and disconnected/air-gapped update workflows where required.
  Engineer and validate hardened images and configuration baselines for classified endpoints against DISA STIGs and enclave authority requirements, and provide RMF control evidence and POA&M inputs in eMASS for the classified endpoint systems.
  Serve as the Tier III escalation point for classified-enclave endpoint incidents and coordinate with the enclave network, cybersecurity, and communications teams.
  Lead the engineering design, implementation, and lifecycle of the enterprise endpoint infrastructure: hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, endpoint management platform architecture (Jamf), configuration baselines, and VDI integration across all enclaves.
  Lead the evaluation, cost-benefit analysis, and phased implementation of the Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling; author the Digital Twin Evaluation and Implementation Plan; and establish the practice that every significant change is tested in the digital replica before deployment.
  Lead engineering for AI, automation, and analytics initiatives approved by the Government, including predictive analytics on service data, intelligent automation across support tiers, and integrations with the ITSM platform, and deliver Proof of Concept Reports documenting feasibility, risks, and benefits.
  Conduct market research and produce Market Research Reports and Rough Orders of Magnitude (ROMs) for emerging technologies and proposed solutions to support Government planning and IT Capability Request analysis.
  Qualifications:
  REQUIREMENTS:

  Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 8 years of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). 7 years (education/experience) overall minimum required.
  Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start.
  Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.

  Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  Minimum of 5 years of experience in systems or infrastructure engineering for enterprise MAC OS environments.
  Current Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) Badge.
  Expert knowledge of macOS / iOS/ Jamf and/or MAC architecture, Active Directory, Group Policy, and MAC automation.
  Demonstrated experience designing and leading implementation of lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments and formal test-before-deploy practices.
  Experience leading proof-of-concept evaluations, market research, and cost-benefit/ROM development for Government or enterprise decision-makers.
  Extensive experience with DISA STIGs, ACAS/Nessus, RMF control implementation, POA&Ms, and eMASS.
  Experience leading engineering teams, establishing standards, and executing changes through formal Change Management.
  Excellent technical writing, briefing, and stakeholder communication skills; ability to participate in after-hours emergency on-call response.
  Experience working on NIPRNet, SIPRNet and/or JWICS enclaves and with classified media handling procedures.

    DESIRED SKILLS:

  CISSP, CASP+ CE, or GCED; AWS or Azure architect certification.
  Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.
  Experience applying AI/ML, RPA, or AIOps to IT service management and endpoint operations, including ServiceNow integrations.
  Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Strategy and Reference Architecture, DoDAF 2.02, DoD ICAM Strategy, and Technology Business Management (TBM).
  ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional; PMP.
  Experience supporting IT Capability Request (ITCR) analysis and governance briefings.

 About Empower AI:

  All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

jobs.description:
Piper Companies is seeking a Windows Endpoint Engineer to support a growing client in the secure government services industry in the Raleigh-Durham (RTP), NC area. The Windows Endpoint Engineer role requires working in a hybrid environment with a combination of onsite and remote responsibilities. The Windows Endpoint Engineer role is ideal for an experienced infrastructure professional with expertise in enterprise Windows administration, Cloud PC technologies, endpoint security, and thin client environments supporting highly secure operations.

Responsibilities of the Windows Endpoint Engineer include:

• Administer and maintain on-premises Windows endpoint environments, ensuring systems remain secure, compliant, and operational while addressing identified vulnerabilities.

• Own the engineering and support of Cloud PC platforms, including upgrades, lifecycle management, performance optimization, and fulfillment of business and customer requests.

• Drive endpoint security initiatives by coordinating patch management activities, vulnerability remediation efforts, and platform hardening across enterprise environments.

• Partner with business stakeholders to evaluate challenges within thin client environments, gathering requirements and recommending technology solutions for users operating in SCIFs.

• Lead endpoint improvement projects and collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance user experience, operational efficiency, and overall endpoint performance.

Requirements of the Windows Endpoint Engineer include:

• 7-10 years of experience managing enterprise Windows systems in large-scale environments.

• Strong hands-on expertise with Windows administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, endpoint management, and troubleshooting.

• Experience supporting Cloud PC technologies such as Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), or comparable virtual desktop solutions.

• Proven background in endpoint security, vulnerability management, patching strategies, and compliance-driven environments.

• Ability to gather business requirements, manage technical initiatives, and work effectively with stakeholders supporting thin client solutions.

Compensation for the Windows Endpoint Engineer include:

• $110,000 - 140,000 annually

• Full Comprehensive Benefits: Health, Vision, Dental, PTO, Paid Holiday and Sick Leave if Required by Law.

• Hybrid work flexibility.

• This job opens for applications on 10/2/2026. Applications for this job will be accepted for at least 30 days from the posting date.

Keywords: Windows Endpoint Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Windows Administration, Cloud PC, Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, AVD, Thin Client, Endpoint Security, Vulnerability Management, Active Directory, Group Policy, Hybrid, RTP, Raleigh, Durham, NC

IT Endpoint AdministratorAbout The Role

The Systems & Endpoint Administrator provides end-user support, administers endpoint devices and Microsoft 365 services, and supports technology operations across the organization. The ideal candidate combines strong technical skills with a customer-focused approach and enjoys solving problems in a collaborative environment.

Who We Are

Clayton Early Learning is a leading nonprofit dedicated to providing children from birth to five with an exceptional start and empowering families for lifelong success. We directly serve approximately 500 children annually through our school, home-based programs, and community partnership sites. As a proud member of the Educare Learning Network and the Head Start community, we are deeply committed to providing high quality early childhood education through a whole-child, whole-family approach. Our unique location on a 20-acre historic campus in Denver is the foundation for our strategic vision to become a thriving neighborhood center to serve the community more fully, addressing needs including food security and health care access. Our team of over 125 dedicated professionals works in a supportive environment of collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What This Role Involves

Provide technical support for hardware, software, networking, printers, mobile devices, conferencing systems, and Microsoft 365 applications.Manage user accounts, access permissions, and endpoint devices using Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune.Deploy, maintain, update, and troubleshoot Windows workstations and related technologies.Support employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including device provisioning and access management.Maintain technology inventory records and assist with device lifecycle management.Document, prioritize, and resolve support requests while meeting service expectations.Coordinate with the MSP and vendors to resolve complex issues and support technology initiatives.Identify opportunities to improve processes, user experience, and operational efficiency.Additional Duties as assigned.

What we are looking for: Education:

Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience:

Two or more years of IT support experience.Experience supporting Microsoft Windows and Microsoft 365 environments.Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and customer service skills.Excellent communication and organizational abilities.Opportunity, but no guarantee for occasional work from home.

Preferred:

Experience with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID.Experience working with a Managed Services Provider (MSP).CompTIA, Microsoft, or related technical certifications.

Clayton Requirements:

Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, including CBI/FBI fingerprinting. Child abuse and neglect state registry, MVR and a national sex offender registry check every 5 years.Must have a valid license driver's license with evidence of active vehicle insurance.Pediatric first aid and CPR certification.Current PPD-TB testing, standard immunizations, and annual health statement, or willingness to obtain as required.Participate in training programs, workshops, and meetings related to the role.Maintains strong technology proficiency and quickly adapts to new systems, applications, and digital solutions.

Skills, Competencies & Behavioral Expectations:

Demonstrates integrity, professionalism, and commitment to the organization's mission and values.Exhibits accountability and ownership by taking responsibility for commitments, actions, and results.Creates a safe, respectful, and collaborative environment for children, families, and employees.Communicates clearly and professionally, verbally and in writing, while building strong relationships and influencing employees at all levels.Builds strong relationships through teamwork that prioritizes safety and well-being.Problem-solving with resilience, emotional intelligence, and a solution-oriented mindset.Exceptional customer service and communication skills.Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.Ability to prioritize work and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.Attention to detail and commitment to documentation.Ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.Continuous learning mindset and adaptability to changing technologies.Collaborative approach aligned with organizational values.

Technical Skills

Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID user and account management.Microsoft Intune administration and endpoint management and security.Windows workstation deployment and support.Hardware, software, networking, and peripheral troubleshooting.Microsoft Office Suite support (Teams, Outlook, Excel, Word).Knowledge of ticketing systems and incident management procedures.

Work Environment, Schedule & Physical Requirements:

Ability to work flexible hours outside of normal business hours as required.Ability to lift to 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.Ability to sit, stand, walk and move throughout the workday as required to perform job duties or with reasonable accommodation.Ability to install and move computer equipment and peripherals.Ability to travel as needed.

The perks:

16+ paid company holidaysAccrued vacation time (starting at 10 days/year, up to 30 with tenure)Paid sick timeMedical, vision, and dental insurance coverageLife and AD&D insuranceMental health support through our medical plan and EAPLong-term disability coverage401(k) with 5% employer match after 1 yearFSA plansCollege 529 investment optionsIdentity theft protection and more

Compensation:

$75,000-$82,000 Annually

Clayton's Core Values:

At Clayton Early Learning, we believe that our core values help to drive actions and create habits that allow our belief in the unlimited potential of young children to become a reality. We seek candidates who demonstrate our core values and are motivated by a value-driven environment.

Collaboration builds trust and relationships and brings new ideas, skills, and knowledge to help us do better work.Community fosters resiliency, stability, and strength.Fun reduces stress, keeps us motivated, builds connections, and models joy for our children.Growth allows us to develop as professionals and provide the best service.Stewardship enables us to have the greatest impact with the resources we have.

Clayton Early Learning is an equal opportunity employer that values workplace diversity. We strive to create a work place that embraces diverse backgrounds, life experiences, and perspectives. We prohibit discrimination of employees or applicants on the basis of race, creed, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual identity, sexual orientation, religious affiliation, disability, or any other classification considered discriminatory under applicable law.

Salary: $75000 - $82000 per year

jobs.description:
Power the Future of Innovation and Excellence Across Enterprise Applications

Georgia System Operations Corporation (GSOC) is seeking a Senior Digital Workplace Engineer to administer, support, enhance, and continuously improve the organization's Digital Workplace ecosystem across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, enterprise content management, workflow automation, document management, scanning technologies, and application platforms.

This senior technical role supports cloud-based and on-premises technologies while advancing modernization across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, document management, workflow, and enterprise application platforms.

The Senior Digital Workplace Engineer partners with business stakeholders, product owners, and technology teams to deliver secure, scalable, and modern collaboration and content management solutions.

This is an onsite position and it is not eligible for visa sponsorship

What You'll Do

As a Senior Digital Workplace Engineer, you will combine platform administration, application support, automation, content services, and infrastructure expertise to improve how employees collaborate, manage information, and get work done.

You Will

Administer, support, enhance, and continuously improve Microsoft 365 services, SharePoint Online, and legacy SharePoint environments.Administer enterprise document management, records management, content services, scanning, imaging, OCR, and document capture solutions.Monitor platform performance, storage, security, service health, user provisioning, access controls, and governance standards.Provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 support for Digital Workplace applications and business-critical solutions hosted on Windows Server and IIS.Troubleshoot application, authentication, integration, workflow, and performance issues and coordinate vendor support activities.Support software lifecycle management, including upgrades, patching, testing, deployment, backup validation, and disaster recovery activities.Design, configure, and support business solutions using Power Apps and Power Automate.Modernize legacy forms and workflows, including InfoPath and legacy SharePoint solutions.Develop PowerShell automation scripts that improve operational efficiency and platform administration.Support integrations among Microsoft 365, enterprise applications, SQL databases, and third-party platforms.Configure metadata, taxonomy, retention policies, content types, and governance controls.Support document capture, indexing, workflow routing, and content lifecycle processes.Administer Windows Server environments and manage IIS configurations, application deployments, certificates, and web application troubleshooting.Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity, and business teams to ensure secure and compliant operations.Develop and maintain operational documentation, support procedures, and knowledge articles.

What You Bring

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education, training, and directly related work experience may be considered.Ideally, 6+ years of experience with SharePoint, including on-premises and online environments, Microsoft 365, and enterprise content management.Strong experience with SharePoint Framework (SPFx), React, Angular, .NET, C#, and ASP.NET.Experience with InfoPath forms and Nintex workflows, including migration to cloud-based solutions.Hands-on expertise with Power Apps, Power Automate, and advanced PowerShell scripting.Experience managing Microsoft Teams and integrations.Experience administering Windows Server and IIS environments.Deep understanding of SharePoint and Teams architecture, governance, and security.Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and technical documentation skills.Ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives and work effectively with business stakeholders, product owners, technology teams, and third-party providers.

Preferred Qualifications

Digital Workplace Engineering

Experience engineering and supporting Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, and hybrid SharePoint environments.Experience developing SharePoint solutions using SPFx, React, Angular, .NET, C#, or ASP.NET.Experience managing Microsoft Teams integrations and developing Teams apps, bots, or Copilot and agent solutions.

Workflow Automation & Modernization

Experience designing solutions with Power Apps and Power Automate.Experience modernizing InfoPath forms, Nintex workflows, and legacy SharePoint solutions.Advanced PowerShell scripting experience for platform administration and operational automation.

Content Services & Platform Operations

Experience with enterprise document management, records management, metadata, taxonomy, retention, document capture, OCR, and content lifecycle processes.Experience with SharePoint migration tools such as ShareGate or AvePoint.Experience supporting Windows Server, IIS, SQL integrations, certificates, application deployments, patching, backup validation, and disaster recovery.

Advantages of Working at GSOC

Working at GSOC means more than just a job--it's an opportunity to contribute to work that truly matters.

Digital Workplace Leadership

Influence the reliability, usability, governance, and continued evolution of enterprise collaboration, content management, workflow, and application platforms.

Modernization & Automation

Advance Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Power Platform, workflow automation, and hybrid technology modernization initiatives.

Mission-Driven Impact

Your work helps strengthen the technology platforms and services that support critical operations across the Family of Companies.

Strong Values and Professional Standards

Work in an environment grounded in accountability, collaboration, integrity, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.

Work Environment & Benefits

GSOC offers a professional, collaborative work environment with competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for continuous professional growth.

Why Join GSOC

At GSOC, you will serve as a senior technical resource for the Digital Workplace ecosystem while helping shape secure, scalable, and modern collaboration, content management, workflow, and enterprise application capabilities.

Apply Today

If you're ready to modernize enterprise collaboration, strengthen Microsoft 365 and SharePoint platforms, and improve how people connect with information and technology, we encourage you to apply.

GSOC does not accept unsolicited resumes or candidate submissions from staffing agencies, search firms, or third-party recruiters. Any unsolicited resumes submitted without a valid, executed agreement will become the property of GSOC, and no placement fee will be paid.

Salary: $99360 - $173900 per year

Overview

Job Description:

We don’t simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you — offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham’s IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you’ll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In This Role You Will

 Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools—helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions. Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph. Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm. Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions. Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID. Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm’s core collaboration tools. Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools. Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your Impact

 Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm’s broader network of technology champions Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement Be a key contributor to developing IT’s vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors To Your Success

 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption. Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions. Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team. Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus. Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities. Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape. Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant’s skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

About Chatham Financial

Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.

It’s clear ahead.

Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.

We help guide the way—giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

jobs.description:
The Microsoft Configuration Management Administrator operates, monitors, and supports enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) while supporting the organization’s transition to Microsoft Intune and cloud-based endpoint management.

Performs day-to-day administration of application deployments, software updates, device collections, operating system deployment task sequences, configuration baselines, endpoint compliance, and vulnerability-remediation activities across enterprise Windows environments. To join our team of outstanding professionals, apply today!

This position investigates and resolves endpoint-management issues using Configuration Manager tools, reports, client logs, endpoint diagnostics, PowerShell, and established support procedures. Administrator executes approved changes, patch deployments, software releases, remediation actions, and configuration updates in accordance with change-management, cybersecurity, and operational requirements.

Works closely with senior engineers, architects, cloud teams, cybersecurity personnel, service desk teams, and system owners to sustain existing endpoint-management services and support the migration of appropriate workloads to Microsoft Intune and other cloud-based capabilities.

Administrator also maintains technical documentation, deployment records, operating procedures, and configuration information required to support service continuity, auditability, security compliance, and reliable operations.

Responsibilities

Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including application deployment, software updates, device collections, task sequences, configuration baselines, inventory, reporting, and client troubleshooting.Package, test, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot Windows applications across enterprise endpoints, including installation, detection, dependency, and removal requirements.Execute and monitor enterprise Windows patching and update deployments using software update groups, automatic deployment rules, maintenance windows, phased deployments, and compliance reporting.Support Windows operating system deployment and provisioning, including task sequences, PXE and boot media, driver management, imaging, application sequencing, and deployment troubleshooting.Create and maintain device collections, configuration items, and compliance baselines to support targeted deployments, detect configuration drift, measure compliance, and enable approved remediation.Troubleshoot endpoint-management issues using Configuration Manager logs, Event Viewer, CMPivot, console monitoring, client diagnostics, reporting tools, PowerShell, and related administrative utilities.Support Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, device registration, endpoint identity management, and related Windows device lifecycle activities.Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to remediate endpoint vulnerabilities, implement security configurations, monitor compliance, and support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and related security controls.Support Microsoft Intune and co-management capabilities, including device enrollment, application deployment, compliance policies, configuration profiles, update rings, Windows Autopilot, and the phased migration of workloads from SCCM/MECM to cloud management.Use PowerShell and related scripting tools to automate routine endpoint-administration, reporting, remediation, and support activities while maintaining required change records, procedures, and technical documentation.

Qualifications

Active Secret security clearance.Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, or a related field. Significant and relevant endpoint-management, desktop engineering, or systems-administration experience may be considered as a substitute for a bachelor’s degree. Minimum of 3 years of experience administering enterprise Windows endpoint-management services, including SCCM/MECM, Intune, or a comparable endpoint-management platform. IAT Level II certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE, or equivalent.Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or the ability to obtain the certification within 6 months of employment. Any clearance requirements for this position are established by the government contract.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate. Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert. Relevant Microsoft Azure, cybersecurity, IT service management, PowerShell, or systems-administration certifications.

2026-25998

Benefits

Regular - The company offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) and a range of other voluntary benefits. Paid Time Off (PTO) is offered to regular full-time and part-time employees.

Company Description

Work Where it Matters

Suvi, an Akima company, is not just another federal mission services contractor. As an Alaska Native Corporation (ANC), our mission and purpose extend beyond our exciting federal projects as we support our shareholder communities in Alaska.

At Suvi, the work you do every day makes a difference in the lives of our 15,000 Iñupiat shareholders, a group of Alaska natives from one of the most remote and harshest environments in the United States.

For our shareholders, Suvi provides support and employment opportunities and contributes to the survival of a culture that has thrived above the Arctic Circle for more than 10,000 years.

JOB TITLE: Identity Management Windows Engineer
**TOP 3 SKILLS:** Microsoft 365, Identity Administration, Active Directory
LOCATION: San Jose, CA
DURATION: 12 mo+
RATE RANGE: $60-70/hour

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Identity Management Windows Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, administration, and support of the company's Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms and Microsoft enterprise collaboration services. Primary responsibilities include administration of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta Identity Cloud, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), identity governance, and Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, and Microsoft Teams.
Secondary responsibilities include administration of Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure, virtual server environments, backup and recovery systems, storage infrastructure, and disaster recovery solutions. The position provides technical leadership, operational support, and on-call response to ensure the security, reliability, and availability of critical business systems.

JOB DUTIES:
Identity & Access Management (Primary)

Administer Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, and Okta Identity Cloud, including user lifecycle management, access controls, Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), identity governance, privileged access management, and authentication policies. Configure and maintain identity federation and directory integrations between Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and third-party applications using SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and SCIM. Implement and maintain identity security controls aligned with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA), cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and company policies. Monitor identity, authentication, and access-related activity; investigate incidents and implement corrective actions to strengthen the organization's security posture. Lead IAM initiatives and projects including application onboarding, access modernization, authentication enhancements, and identity lifecycle automation. Microsoft 365 Administration (Primary) Administer and support Microsoft 365 services including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Microsoft Teams, and related collaboration technologies. Manage Microsoft 365 security, compliance, mail flow, collaboration, and governance configurations. Support integration of Microsoft 365 services with Entra ID, Okta, and other enterprise applications. Monitor and optimize Microsoft 365 environments for availability, performance, security, and user experience. Azure Cloud Infrastructure Design, implement, and support Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and hybrid cloud solutions including networking, compute, storage, identity, security, and connectivity services. Monitor and optimize cloud resources for performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency. Support cloud migrations, modernization initiatives, and infrastructure automation efforts. Server, Backup, Storage & Infrastructure (Secondary) Administer and support VMware and virtual server environments. Administer, maintain, and troubleshoot Storage Area Network (SAN) infrastructure, backup systems, and recovery solutions. jobs.description:
This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline.

This position may be filled prior to the posted deadline. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply as soon as possible.

Tuknik Government Services, a Koniag Government Services company, is seeking an AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer – RPA Operations with a Secret security clearance to support TGS and our government customer. The position is remote.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, paid parental leave, life and disability insurance, flexible spending accounts, commuter benefits and tuition reimbursement.

The AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer - RPA Operations will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining the organization's Amazon Web Services (AWS) cloud infrastructure that supports Robotic Process Automation (RPA) operations, specifically in UiPath RPA software. This role serves as the technical expert for all AWS-related services utilized by RPA customers, ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available virtual infrastructure for automation workloads. The position requires deep expertise in AWS services, virtualization technologies, security management, and container orchestration. The ideal candidate will manage complex cloud environments including virtual machines, AWS Workspaces, Hardware Security Modules (HSM), and certificate management systems while maintaining strict security protocols for Non-Person Entity (NPE) credentials and unattended automation infrastructure. This role combines cloud architecture, systems administration, security management, and DevOps practices with specialization in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) and Kubernetes orchestration. The engineer will work closely with RPA development teams, security personnel, and end-users to ensure optimal performance, security, and accessibility of cloud resources that enable enterprise-wide automation capabilities. Essential Functions, Responsibilities & Duties may include, but are not limited to:

AWS Infrastructure Management & Administration:

- Design, deploy, and maintain AWS cloud infrastructure supporting RPA/UiPath customer operations

- Create and manage virtual machines (EC2 instances) optimized for unattended automation workloads

- Configure and maintain AWS Workspaces for RPA developers and automation operators

- Implement and manage AWS services including but not limited to: EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Systems Manager, and CloudTrail

- Monitor cloud resource utilization, performance metrics, and costs; optimize infrastructure for efficiency

- Implement and maintain backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions for RPA infrastructure

- Manage cloud networking configurations including VPCs, subnets, security groups, routing tables, and network ACLs

- Ensure high availability and fault tolerance of critical RPA infrastructure components

- Plan and execute infrastructure scaling activities to meet growing automation demands

- Perform system maintenance, patching, and updates across cloud environments

Security & Certificate Management:

- Manage AWS Hardware Security Module (HSM) or similar infrastructure for secure operations

- Implement and maintain digital certificate lifecycle management for RPA operations

- Configure and manage Non-Person Entity (NPE) credentials for unattended automation processes

- Establish secure credential storage, rotation, and access procedures using AWS HSM or similar and Secrets Manager

- Implement and enforce security best practices for cloud infrastructure and automation workloads

- Manage Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, roles, and permissions for RPA services

- Configure and monitor security controls including encryption at rest and in transit

- Conduct security assessments and implement remediation measures for identified vulnerabilities

- Maintain compliance with organizational cybersecurity policies and federal security standards

- Manage PKI (Public Key Infrastructure) components and certificate authorities for automation environments

- Coordinate with security teams on audits, compliance requirements, and security incidents

Systems Management & Configuration:

- Administer System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) for endpoint management and software distribution

- Deploy and manage applications, updates, and configurations across virtual infrastructure using SCCM

- Maintain SCCM infrastructure including site servers, distribution points, and management points

- Create and maintain SCCM task sequences, packages, and deployment collections

- Monitor system compliance and remediate configuration drift

- Integrate SCCM with cloud services for hybrid environment management

- Troubleshoot SCCM-related issues and optimize performance

Container Orchestration & Kubernetes Management:

- Design, deploy, and manage Kubernetes clusters

- Configure and maintain Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) or equivalent container platforms

- Develop and manage container images, pods, services, and deployments

- Implement container security best practices and vulnerability scanning

- Monitor cluster health, resource utilization, and application performance

- Troubleshoot container and orchestration issues

- Implement CI/CD pipelines for container deployments

User Support & Documentation:

- Provide technical support to RPA customers for AWS infrastructure access and usage issues

- Troubleshoot and resolve virtual infrastructure problems including connectivity, performance, and configuration issues

- Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for AWS infrastructure procedures and configurations

- Document step-by-step procedures for NPE credential acquisition and setup in AWS environments

- Develop user guides for accessing and utilizing AWS Workspaces and virtual machines

- Maintain runbooks for common administrative tasks and troubleshooting scenarios

- Conduct knowledge transfer sessions with team members and end-users

- Respond to user inquiries regarding cloud infrastructure capabilities and limitations

Required Qualifications:

Education:

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related technical field; OR

- Equivalent combination of education and professional experience in cloud infrastructure, systems engineering, or DevOps

Experience:

- Minimum 4-5 years of hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and infrastructure management

- Minimum 3 years of experience with virtual machine administration and cloud computing environments

- Demonstrated experience with System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) administration

- Minimum 2 years of experience with Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms

- Experience with security management, certificate authorities, and cryptographic systems

- Previous experience supporting enterprise automation or RPA infrastructure (preferred)

- Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and DevOps practices

Technical Skills:

 Required:

 AWS Services:

- Expert-level knowledge of AWS core services (EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, CloudWatch)

- Advanced experience with AWS Workspaces and virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI)

- Proficiency with AWS Hardware Security Module (CloudHSM or AWS Managed HSM)

- Strong understanding of AWS security services (Secrets Manager, KMS, Certificate Manager, IAM)

- Experience with AWS networking, security groups, and VPC configurations

- Familiarity with AWS automation tools (CloudFormation, Systems Manager, CLI, SDKs)

 Security & Certificate Management:

- Deep knowledge of Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) and certificate lifecycle management

- Experience with digital certificate creation, distribution, and revocation

- Understanding of cryptographic concepts and secure key management

- Experience managing Non-Person Entity (NPE) credentials and service accounts

- Knowledge of security compliance frameworks and best practices

 Systems Management:

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM)

- Experience with endpoint management, patch management, and software distribution

- Knowledge of Windows Server administration and Active Directory integration

- Familiarity with PowerShell scripting for automation and system management

 Container & Orchestration:

- Strong experience with Kubernetes architecture, deployment, and management

- Proficiency with Amazon EKS or other managed Kubernetes services

- Knowledge of Docker and container technologies

- Experience with container security scanning and vulnerability management

- Understanding of microservices architecture and cloud-native applications

 Infrastructure as Code & Automation:

- Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates)

- Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef)

- Strong scripting skills (PowerShell, Python, Bash)

- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps tools (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps)

 Monitoring & Troubleshooting:

- Experience with cloud monitoring and logging solutions (CloudWatch, CloudTrail, ELK stack)

- Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex cloud environments

- Performance tuning and optimization expertise

 Preferred:

- AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, DevOps Engineer)

- Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)

- Microsoft certifications (Azure Administrator, SCCM/MECM certification)

- UiPath infrastructure knowledge or RPA platform administration experience

- Experience with HashiCorp tools (Vault, Consul, Terraform)

- Knowledge of networking protocols, load balancers, and CDN services

- Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning

- Familiarity with compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, NIST, FISMA)

 Professional Competencies:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities for complex technical challenges

- Excellent documentation skills with attention to detail and accuracy

- Effective communication skills to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

- Customer-service oriented with a focus on user satisfaction

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple concurrent projects

- Strong organizational and time management skills

- Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud technologies

- Collaborative team player with ability to work across functional groups

- Security-conscious mindset with understanding of risk management

- Proactive approach to identifying and resolving potential issues

 Security & Clearance Requirements:

- Must be able to obtain and maintain Secret clearance

- Ability to handle sensitive information and credentials with appropriate discretion

- Understanding of and adherence to federal cybersecurity requirements

 Other Requirements:

- Availability for on-call support rotation for critical infrastructure issues

- Willingness to work outside normal business hours for maintenance windows when necessary

- Ability to support geographically dispersed user base

- Commitment to maintaining professional certifications and technical skills

- Strong ethical standards regarding system access and data security

- U.S. Citizen.

jobs.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:

The Home Depot is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to join the IT Endpoint Engineering and Security team. This role develops, maintains, and supports enterprise endpoint infrastructure, platforms, and services across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.

The Senior Systems Engineer will support technologies spanning endpoint management, patch management, software delivery, vulnerability remediation, endpoint security, configuration management, and automation. Relevant platforms may include Tanium, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune, Broadcom Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar enterprise endpoint management and software distribution technologies.

This engineer will partner with architecture, security, infrastructure, and operations teams to continuously improve and mature endpoint services through strategic initiatives, automation, and operational improvements.

Senior Systems Engineers are expected to leverage enterprise tooling, scripting, automation, telemetry, and custom applications to monitor service health, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and improve the reliability and scalability of endpoint services.

The role may participate in an on-call rotation supporting routine upgrades, platform maintenance, application support, security remediation, root cause analysis, and post-mortem reviews related to service interruptions or security incidents.

The Senior Systems Engineer is expected to operate independently while also serving as a technical mentor to other engineers. Based on their experience,

Senior Engineers will help establish engineering standards, create and improve operational processes, lead technical initiatives, and ensure engineering and operational best practices are followed.

Required Qualifications

- 3–5 years of relevant engineering experience.

- Professional experience as a Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, Endpoint Engineer, Security Engineer, or similar technical role.

- Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise endpoint management, patching, software delivery, or configuration management platforms such as Tanium, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Microsoft Intune, Broadcom Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar technologies.

- Experience deploying software, patches, configuration changes, and remediation actions across large endpoint or server environments.

- Experience monitoring and troubleshooting Windows, macOS, and/or Linux endpoints, including operating system configuration, application behavior, system performance, and connectivity.

- Experience troubleshooting endpoint-to-server and endpoint-to-cloud network communications.

- Experience supporting enterprise infrastructure and application services, including databases and supporting platform components.

- Experience with operating system command-line utilities and scripting or automation technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Bash/Shell scripting, or similar languages.

- Experience working as part of a collaborative, cross-functional engineering organization.

- Experience operating or delivering a production service and providing recommendations related to service strategy, architecture, reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement.

- Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to perform root cause analysis across complex enterprise environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, application deployment, software distribution, or endpoint configuration management at scale.

- Experience with endpoint management technologies such as Tanium, SCCM/MECM, Intune, Altiris, BigFix, Ivanti, or similar platforms.

- Experience with endpoint security technologies including Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), anti-malware, application control/allowlisting, file integrity monitoring, vulnerability management, or device management.

- Experience with endpoint security products such as CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Palo Alto Cortex, or similar technologies.

- Experience integrating vulnerability management and endpoint management platforms to automate identification and remediation of vulnerabilities.

- Experience managing physical and virtual infrastructure and troubleshooting network, systems, application, or security-related issues.

- Experience installing, upgrading, and maintaining enterprise applications, databases, or infrastructure platforms.

- Familiarity with systems architecture, environment analysis, and technical design.

- Familiarity with software troubleshooting tools, runtime analysis, application dependencies, software packaging, and software update technologies.

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or AWS.

- Experience supporting large-scale enterprise environments with thousands of endpoints or servers.

- Experience supporting highly available or 24x7 production environments, particularly retail or other distributed enterprise environments.

- Experience designing or implementing automation that reduces manual patching, software deployment, vulnerability remediation, or endpoint management processes.

Key Responsibilities:

- 100% Deliver Execution, Plans & Align, Problem Solving - Design automation workflows and capabilities in support of data collection, investigation and incident response Develop threat hunting and data analysis strategy and capabilities Identify and propose new technologies, methodologies and/or approaches to detecting malicious activity Utilize indicators to scope and respond proactively to emerging threats Design, build, configure, maintain and monitor cybersecurity threat defense capabilities and user access management

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:

- This Position typically reports to Manager or Sr. Manager

- This Position has 0 Direct Reports

Travel Requirements:

- No travel required.

Physical Requirements:

- Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions:

- Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications:

- Must be eighteen years of age or older.

- Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.

Minimum Education:

- The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.

Minimum Years of Work Experience:

- 3+

Competencies:

- Action Oriented

- Collaborates

- Communicates Effectively

- Customer Focus

- Drives Results

 For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Nevada, New York City, Ithaca (NY), Westchester County (NY), and Washington residents:
The pay range for this position is between $120,000.00 - $160,000.00

jobs.description:
We love challenges. We love to build. We love to make things happen.

We love challenges. We love to build. We love to make things happen.
At JUSTROCKET , we're assembling the brightest minds to create exceptional teams and an ecosystem of like-minded and execution-oriented experts. Since 2016, we have been the heartbeat of the tech community in Cluj-Napoca.

About the project:

The partner we are hiring for is an IT service company based in Germany. Our partner builds and runs complex IT landscapes for clients in automotive, finance, and other regulated industries. Now they are strengthening their own corporate IT team and looking for someone who keeps identity, devices and tools running smoothly from the inside.

Some more interesting project facts

💡 You own identity and access for the whole company, not just a ticket queue

💡 Real production responsibility across Okta, Workspace ONE, Atlassian and more

💡 Automation is part of the job, not a side project

💡 International / cross-border team working closely together

💡 Security and compliance thinking from day one, ISO 27001 and TISAX are close by

💡 and many more – let's talk!

Aufgaben

We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer who is ready to run and shape the corporate IT of our partner, a fast-growing IT service company with projects in automotive, finance and other regulated industries.

As part of the Corporate IT team, you will keep identity, devices and tools running smoothly for the whole company.

Your activities will include:

⏩ Own identity and access management with Okta, covering SSO, MFA and the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding

⏩ Manage device fleets across MacBook, Windows and Android through Workspace ONE UEM, including enrollment, compliance and security policies
⏩ Keep the tool landscape in shape, Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Miro and the Atlassian suite, so colleagues actually enjoy using it
⏩ Build request types, workflows, SLAs and approval processes in Jira Service Management
⏩ Automate recurring work with Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows and n8n, so tasks run without manual clicking
⏩ Track CVEs across the fleet, review audit logs and set up automated security reporting, in line with GDPR and BDSG
⏩ Apply ISO 27001 and TISAX thinking to daily work, without owning the certifications themselves
⏩ Communicate clearly across the company, from technical detail for admins to the bigger picture for management

Qualifikation

You shall bring:

✅ Several years of hands on experience in corporate IT, IT operations or IT administration, ideally in a remote first environment
✅ Solid foundation across IAM (Okta or similar), collaboration suites (Google Workspace or Microsoft 365), MDM/UEM (Workspace ONE or similar) and Atlassian
✅ Scripting as everyday work, for example JavaScript, Apps Script, Python or low code workflows
✅ Security and compliance mindset from the outset, experience with ISO 27001 or TISAX is a big plus
✅ Strong communication skills in German (C1, native) and English (B2+), for documentation and vendor tickets
✅ Analytical and structured approach, you solve causes, not symptoms
✅ Ownership mentality, you drive your topics forward independently

 Nice to have
⏩ AWS integrations (API Gateway, Lambda), Looker Studio, ITIL knowledge or relevant certifications

 In case you are interested in the tech part, the general tool stack is

🖥 Okta (IAM)

🖥 Workspace ONE UEM

🖥 Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot, Miro
🖥 Atlassian (Jira, Jira Service Management, Confluence)
🖥 Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows, n8n

🖥 AWS (API Gateway, Lambda)

Benefits

We provide

💪 Assistance in setting up the project/integrating with the team

💪 Guidance while onboarding

💪 Support in any aspect of your activities

💪 Free choice of hardware

💪 Perks like private health insurance and 7card

💪 Regular team events like a week in a mountain hut

💪 Hybrid work mode (we will empower a flexible hybrid mode forever)

💪 anything you are missing – let's talk!

Some final words

You will be joining a dynamic and cross-border project team in Cluj, working closely together with the partner in Germany.

If you have any further questions, feel free to contact us at any time!

Looking forward to meeting you for a (virtual) coffee or tea ☕️

jobs.description:
The Senior Microsoft Consultant will provide expertise across the Microsoft Modern Workplace stack of applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365 E5 productivity, security, and endpoint management capabilities.

The Senior Microsoft Consultant will provide expertise across the Microsoft Modern Workplace stack of applications, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365 E5 productivity, security, and endpoint management capabilities. This role is responsible for leading client-facing consulting engagements that span collaboration, device management, and security transformation.

This position requires the ability to architect, design, and implement Microsoft 365 solutions that balance user productivity, endpoint management, and enterprise security. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with both business and technical stakeholders while following the Coretek prescribed best practices approach to delivering projects in both commercial and CMMC environments.

Responsibilities

Design and implement Microsoft 365 E5 solutions, focusing on both productivity and security workloads according to Microsoft and Coretek best practices.

Productivity & Collaboration

- Design and implement enterprise collaboration solutions across Microsoft Teams (chat, meetings, lifecycle management, governance), SharePoint Online (Permissions, Access control, governance), OneDrive for Business (storage, sharing, lifecycle management), and Exchange Online (mail flow, protection, hybrid scenarios).

- Lead migration and modernization projects, including Exchange and file migrations to Microsoft 365 and tenant-to-tenant or hybrid transformations.

- Establish governance for collaboration, external sharing, and data lifecycle management.

- Drive improvements in user productivity, adoption, and collaboration effectiveness across client environments.

Endpoint Management & Intune

- Design and implement Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) solutions including device enrollment, provisioning, application deployment, and mobile application management.

- Configure device compliance policies, endpoint security controls, and Conditional Access integration with device state.

- Lead modern endpoint transformation initiatives including Windows Autopilot, co-management, and cloud-first device management strategies.

- Develop governance and standards for device management across enterprise clients.

Security & Compliance

- Implement Microsoft 365 E5 security solutions, including Microsoft Defender (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps) and Microsoft Purview (DLP, retention, eDiscovery, compliance management).

- Implement Zero Trust-aligned security controls and best practices across client environments.

- Develop and enhance security monitoring, policies, and automation.

- Assess client security infrastructure, identify vulnerabilities, and recommend Coretek services to address gaps.

Identity & Access Management

- Design and implement Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) solutions including Conditional Access, MFA, and identity lifecycle management.

- Implement authentication strategies and hybrid identity configurations including directory synchronization (AADC) and related components.

Delivery & Leadership

- Act as the technical lead on engagements, collaborating with architects and engineering teams on solution design and implementation.

- Establish, document, and communicate standards and best practices across M365 workloads in accordance with Coretek methodologies.

- Follow Coretek implementation plans and QC guides when working on projects, contributing feedback and continuous improvement to the process.

- Self-manage projects by escalating risks and issues while working within project scope and budget.

- Mentor junior consultants and contribute to practice development.

- Provide training and knowledge transfer to client IT staff on Microsoft technologies and best practices.

- Stay current on Microsoft 365 roadmap across productivity, endpoint management, and security domains.

- Speak with clients to identify opportunities within their organization to address pain points where additional Coretek products and services can be leveraged.

Requirements

- 7+ years working in technology infrastructure design and deployment roles with a focus on Microsoft technologies.

- 3+ years of consulting or client-facing delivery experience (required).

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 productivity workloads (Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Exchange).

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM, Autopilot, endpoint compliance).

- Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft security solutions (Defender, Purview, Entra ID).

- Experience designing and implementing enterprise M365 solutions across multiple customer environments.

- Strong understanding of identity and access management concepts and cloud security principles.

- Relevant certifications such as MS-102 (Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert), MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), SC-100 or SC-200 (Security certifications) preferred.

- Experience with compliance frameworks (CMMC, NIST, ISO, HIPAA, PCI) is a plus.

- Experience with automation tools (PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API) preferred.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with internal and external customers at all levels.

- Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

- Must be a self-starter with excellent time management skills.

Job Summary

Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?

IFF is a global leader in Flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Digital Technology Solutions: Accelerating innovation through data, technology and digital transformation, building intelligent solutions that enhance experiences and power smarter decisions.

The role is based in Chennai, India. Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

 Where You’ll Make a Difference

- Engineer and support Windows 10/11 desktop environments, ensuring optimal performance, security, and compliance.

- Lead the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of Windows devices through Microsoft Intune.

- Manage and optimize Windows 365 Cloud PCs to ensure seamless user experience and enterprise integration.

- Develop, maintain, and enhance PowerShell scripts to automate desktop management and operational tasks.

- Implement and support modern device management and Zero Trust security initiatives in collaboration with cross-functional teams.

- Provide Level 3 technical support for complex Windows, endpoint, and virtualization-related issues.

- Mentor and guide junior team members, promoting technical excellence and knowledge sharing.

- Create and maintain engineering documentation, including standards, procedures, and troubleshooting guides.

- Evaluate, recommend, and implement new technologies and best practices to improve desktop and virtual workplace services.

 What Makes You the Right Fit

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, with 5+ years of experience in Windows desktop engineering, endpoint management, and large-scale virtual desktop environments.

- Demonstrated expertise in Windows 10/11 administration, engineering, and enterprise deployment strategies.

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and Group Policy administration.

- Strong proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation, configuration, and operational efficiency.

- Experience managing Windows 365 Cloud PCs, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Windows Autopilot, and BitLocker.

- Working knowledge of Citrix Cloud, Citrix Studio, Machine Creation Services (MCS), Citrix ADC, and virtual desktop environments.

- Solid understanding of networking, identity and access management, and endpoint security best practices.

- Preferred certifications include Microsoft Certified Endpoint Administrator Associate and Microsoft Certified Azure Virtual Desktop Specialty.

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 How Would You Stand Out?

- Proven expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows 365, and modern endpoint management, with experience supporting enterprise-scale desktop environments.

- Strong hands-on experience with Citrix technologies and Windows virtualization, including deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.

- Advanced PowerShell automation skills combined with a solid understanding of Zero Trust, endpoint security, and compliance best practices.

 Why Choose Us?

- Work in a global organization that values innovation and sustainability.

- Hybrid work model offering flexibility and balance.

- Opportunities for professional growth and development.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more
