jobs.description:
¡En**Ayesa Digital** crecemos contigo!

En Ayesa Digital no esperamos al futuro, lo lideramos. A través de la tecnología y la ingeniería lo hacemos posible, convirtiendo retos en oportunidades, conceptos en soluciones y visión en impacto real. Paso a paso nos acercamos a un futuro mejor. Con tu pasión, talento y determinación, seguiremos transformando el presente y construyendo el futuro. Ayesa Digital, Making It Happen.

Si eres una persona entusiasta y buscas un nuevo reto profesional, ¡Este es tu sitio!

***Buscamos incorporar a un/a ++Ingeniero/a Senior de Sistemas Microsoft (Azure \| M365 \| Intune)++ para unirse a uno de nuestros proyectos en Gipuzkoa.***

¡Anímate a dar el salto! ¡Te estamos esperando!

***¿Qué vas a hacer?***

* Diseñar, evolucionar y administrar arquitecturas basadas en tecnologías Microsoft, garantizando la disponibilidad, rendimiento y seguridad de las infraestructuras de nuestros clientes.
* Participar en proyectos de modernización tecnológica, migración y transformación de entornos tradicionales hacia arquitecturas híbridas y cloud.
* Actuar como referente técnico tanto para clientes como para equipos internos, aportando visión técnica y participando en la toma de decisiones estratégicas.
* Diseñar y administrar entornos Windows Server (2016, 2019 y 2022), asegurando su correcta evolución y mantenimiento.
* Gestionar y optimizar servicios de infraestructura Microsoft como Active Directory, GPOs, DNS, DHCP, Microsoft 365, Intune y Azure.
* Participar en reuniones técnicas con cliente, workshops de definición y sesiones de diseño de soluciones.
* Elaborar documentación técnica, procedimientos operativos y diagramas de arquitectura.
* Resolver incidencias complejas y proporcionar soporte avanzado N2/N3 sobre plataformas críticas de infraestructura.
* Colaborar estrechamente con equipos de operaciones, cloud y ciberseguridad para garantizar la continuidad y evolución de los servicios.
* Participar en labores de preventa, diseño técnico y elaboración de propuestas para nuevos proyectos y servicios.
* Contribuir a la definición e implantación de soluciones de alta disponibilidad, recuperación ante desastres y planes de contingencia.
* Participar en servicios de guardia cuando sea necesario para garantizar la continuidad operativa de los entornos gestionados.

***¿Qué buscamos?***

* Experiencia mínima de 5 años en administración, diseño y arquitectura de entornos Wintel.
* Experiencia demostrable en la gestión y evolución de infraestructuras Microsoft en entornos empresariales.
* Conocimientos sólidos de Windows Server 2016, 2019 y 2022.
* Experiencia en administración de Active Directory, GPOs, DNS y DHCP.
* Experiencia en entornos cloud o híbridos basados en Microsoft Azure.
* Conocimientos de Microsoft 365 e Intune para la gestión de entornos modernos de puesto de trabajo y colaboración.
* Experiencia en plataformas de virtualización Hyper-V.
* Capacidad para participar en proyectos de arquitectura, modernización tecnológica y definición de soluciones.
* Experiencia en soporte avanzado N2/N3 y resolución de incidencias críticas.
* Capacidad de interlocución con clientes, liderazgo técnico y orientación a la mejora continua de los servicios.
* Nivel alto de inglés, tanto hablado como escrito, para trabajar en entornos internacionales y participar en reuniones técnicas.
* Valoraremos especialmente:
* Certificaciones Microsoft, Azure o tecnologías relacionadas.
* Experiencia en proyectos de migración, consolidación o modernización de infraestructuras.
* Conocimientos de soluciones corporativas de backup, especialmente Veeam o tecnologías equivalentes.
* Experiencia en diseño de arquitecturas de alta disponibilidad y planes de contingencia.
* Conocimientos de automatización, gestión de configuraciones o administración de entornos híbridos complejos.
* Experiencia en colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares de infraestructura, cloud y seguridad.

***¿Cuándo trabajarás?***

Lunes a Viernes- 8hs a 17hs

Formato trabajo: Híbrido, 1 día presencial en nuestras oficinas de Guipúzcoa.

***Te ofrecemos un camino lleno de aventuras:***

* ¡Llega hasta donde tú quieras! Crece con nuestros programas de desarrollo! Te ayudaremos a marcar tu itinerario de futuro anualmente participando en proyectos vanguardistas con los mejores profesionales del sector.
* Porque lo importante sois tú y los tuyos : contamos con políticas que facilitan la conciliación entre la vida profesional y personal: Flexibilidad horaria, Smart Job y jornada intensiva en verano.
* Tú decides cómo usar tu dinero: disfruta de nuestra retribución flexible, contamos con: Seguro médico, Ticket Restaurant, Guardería y Transporte.
* Plan Bienestar descuentos en viajes, tecnología, formación, deporte, belleza y ¡muchos más!
* Diviértete participando en los diferentes concursos y actividades que organizamos: ¿te gusta el deporte, escribir, la fotografía? Todo tiene cabida.
* ¡Actualízate! apostamos por un aprendizaje continuo, contamos con formación especializada, certificaciones e idiomas
* ¡Deja tu huella! Impacta con nuestros proyectos de voluntariado social.

***¡Únete a la multinacional española tecnológica referente en el mundo!***

***Atendiendo a la Ley Orgánica 3/2007, de 22 de marzo, Ayesa Digital se ha marcado como objetivo promover la defensa y aplicación efectiva del principio de igualdad entre hombres y mujeres, evitando cualquier tipo de discriminación laboral por razón de sexo, garantizando así las mismas oportunidades de ingreso. Asimismo, fomentamos la diversidad, rechazando cualquier tipo de discriminación por razones de raza, sexo, diversidad funcional, religión, orientación sexual, identidad sexual, o cualquier otra condición personal o social, apostando por construir un entorno inclusivo y enriquecedor.***

jobs.summary: ****Descripción del Puesto:**** En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones...
jobs.description:
****Descripción del Puesto:**** En TD SYNNEX estamos expandiendo la práctica de Endpoint en MCA y buscamos un Account Manager que lidere el desarrollo del negocio multimarca de Endpoint (PCs, notebooks, monitores, periféricos, impresión y otras soluciones de usuario final; excluye Advanced Solutions). Tendrás a cargo una cartera definida de partners y cuentas clave, con foco en maximizar ingresos, rentabilidad y nuevas líneas de negocio. Serás un referente para nuestros socios del canal, impulsando planificación de cuentas, generación de pipeline, gestión de licitaciones y adopción de nuestras plataformas digitales.

****Lo que harás:****

* Desarrollar y hacer crecer la cartera de partners: planificación de cuenta, mapeo de decisores, detección de oportunidades y activación de campañas.
* Ser una persona de confianza para los clientes, manteniendo relaciones estratégicas con visitas presenciales periódicas.
* Diseñar y ejecutar planes estratégicos para impulsar el negocio actual y el crecimiento incremental.
* Identificar, registrar y hacer seguimiento de oportunidades (pipeline) asegurando la calidad del funnel y el cumplimiento de metas.
* Coordinar recursos internos y liderar la interacción con Inside Sales, Operaciones de Venta y las Unidades de Negocio Especialistas (SBUs).
* Identificar oportunidades/proyectos conjuntamente con los BDM y equipos de Vendor Management.
* Relevar requerimientos del cliente y elaborar propuestas que agreguen valor, protegiendo el margen y el mix de productos/soluciones.
* Gestionar licitaciones y concursos (sector público y privado), coordinando inventario, plazos y documentación.
* Monitorear inventario y forecast, articulando con operaciones y vendors para asegurar disponibilidad y niveles de servicio.
* Detectar necesidades y problemas del cliente, resolviéndolos o escalándolos a las áreas correspondientes.
* Obtener insights mediante el perfilado y análisis de la cartera, generando acciones para maximizar oportunidades y expandir la base de partners.
* Completar en tiempo y forma el reporte y la administración en los sistemas de TD SYNNEX (CRM, reportes, profiling).
* Impulsar el uso de la plataforma de e‑commerce de TD SYNNEX (InTouch), promoviendo sus beneficios y aumentando la adopción.
* Mantener y mejorar los acuerdos de nivel de servicio (SLAs) con clientes y áreas internas.
* Operar bajo las mejores prácticas, políticas y objetivos de TD SYNNEX, asegurando el cumplimiento normativo y ético.

**Lo que buscamos**

* 3 años de experiencia relevante en ventas B2B o gestión de cuentas en la industria de tecnología (mayorista, fabricante u OEM, o reseller), preferentemente en categorías de Endpoint (computación personal, impresión, periféricos, colaboración).
* Red de relaciones y cartera activa en el canal de Argentina, con historial comprobable de desarrollo de partners y crecimiento de cuentas.
* Experiencia multimarca y trabajo con vendors/OEMs; capacidad para priorizar y balancear portafolio protegiendo margen.
* Sólida gestión de pipeline, pronóstico, negociación y cierre; dominio de CRM (ideal Salesforce) y Excel/herramientas de análisis.
* Experiencia en gestión de licitaciones y concursos, deseable con conocimiento del sector público.
* Enfoque a resultados, autonomía, capacidad de influencia sin autoridad formal y colaboración transversal.
* Habilidad para trabajo en campo con viajes frecuentes dentro del país.
* Inglés intermedio/avanzado para interactuar con equipos regionales y materiales de vendors.

**Será un plus**

* Experiencia previa en mayoristas o vendors líderes de Endpoint
* Haber impulsado adopción de plataformas de e‑commerce B2B; conocimiento previo de InTouch.

****Las condiciones de trabajo:****

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).
* Horas de trabajo no estándar, según lo requiera el negocio.

Tú qué sacas de esto?

* **Aprovecha al máximo nuestra Organización Global:**establece contactos con otros nuevos compañeros de trabajo dentro de sus primeros 30 días a través de nuestro programa de incorporación.
* **Haz crecer tu carrera:**nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles. También puedes acelerar su camino hacia el éxito con programas formales sobre liderazgo y desarrollo profesional, y muchos más cursos a pedido.
* **Trabaja con proveedores de clase mundial:**nuestros representantes de televentas actuales están trabajando con algunas de las marcas más importantes en tecnología.
* **Eleva tu bienestar personal:**aumenta tu bienestar financiero, físico y mental a través de seminarios, eventos y nuestro Programa global de asistencia para el empoderamiento de la vida (LEAP por sus siglas en Inglés).
* **Diversidad, equidad e inclusión:** no es solo una frase para nosotros; valorando cada voz es cómo tenemos éxito. Únete a nosotros para celebrar nuestra diversidad global a través de educación inclusiva, conversaciones significativas entre pares y oportunidades equitativas de crecimiento y desarrollo.

¿No cumples con todos los requisitos? Aplica de todos modos:

En TD SYNNEX, estamos orgullosos de ser reconocidos como un excelente lugar para trabajar y líder en la promoción y práctica de la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión.

Si está entusiasmado por trabajar para nuestra empresa y cree que es un buen candidato para este puesto, lo alentamos a que presente su solicitud.

¡Puedes ser exactamente la persona que estamos buscando!

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

**What's In It For You?**

* **Elective Benefits:** Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
* **Grow Your Career:**Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
* **Elevate Your Personal Well-Being:** Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
* **Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion:**It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
* **Make the Most of our Global Organization**: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
* **Connect with Your Community:** Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

**Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.**At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for!

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep expertise in data engineering, modern data architectures, distributed processing, and engineering excellence. They are accountable for engineering execution, solution quality, operational reliability, and the development of a high-performing data engineering team. "

jobs.description:
We're looking for an End User Computing Manager to build and improve the workplace technology environment across EMCD.

We're looking for an End User Computing Manager to build and improve the workplace technology environment across EMCD . We need proactive and hands-on, who can own employee devices, corporate accounts, SaaS access, IAM, asset management, onboarding/offboarding automation, and the overall digital employee experience.

You'll work closely with Security, IT, vendors, and business teams to make sure employees have secure, reliable, and convenient access to the tools they need.

 Responsibilities:

- Own and improve the end-user technology environment: laptops, mobile devices, corporate accounts, SaaS access, Google Workspace, Slack

- Manage IAM, SSO, access policies, and secure access to key SaaS applications

- Build and automate onboarding/offboarding workflows, including account provisioning and access revocation

- Manage endpoint security and device lifecycle across remote and distributed teams

- Maintain asset management processes: hardware inventory, regular reviews, lifecycle replacement

- Oversee Service Desk and support operations, ensuring fast and high-quality issue resolution

- Manage vendors, SaaS providers, licenses, and contracts to avoid unused or overlapping tools

- Standardize EUC processes across the company and drive self-service, automation, and zero-touch provisioning

 Requirements:

- 7+ years in IT, including 3–5 years in End User Computing, Workplace Technology, IT Support Management, Client Services, or Desktop Engineering

- Strong hands-on experience with Google Workspace and Slack administration

- Experience with IAM, SSO, IdP, access management

- Experience with MDM / UEM tools such as Jamf, Google Endpoint Management, Workspace ONE, or similar

- Understanding of endpoint operating systems: macOS, Windows, mobile platforms

- Experience with ITSM processes and tools: incident, asset, change management; Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar

- Ability to work with vendors and managed service providers

- Proactive approach to identify problems and improve processes

- Russian: full professional proficiency, English: B2 level or higher

 What We Offer:

- Fully remote work from anywhere in the world

- Flexible working hours focused on results

- 20 working days of vacation + 12 additional bonus days

- Paid sick leave with no bureaucracy

- Compensation for courses, certifications, and training programs

- Real ownership of workplace technology in a fast-growing crypto ecosystem

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 What you'll do at Jamf:

In this role the Systems Development Engineer II at Jamf is responsible for automation and development of our backend infrastructure that powers the Jamf Cloud that our customers rely on to manage Apple devices in their organizations. This includes providing the internal infrastructure that our Software Development Engineers use to build and deploy Jamf products in the Cloud.

  You may be required to work periodically at a Jamf office or collaborative work location with other Jamf employees in your area for certain events or moments that matter.

  What you can expect to do in this role :

- Develop, deploy, and maintain production environments by identifying and applying automation, tools, and techniques such as Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, Serverless, and Containerization

- Ensure security best practices are identified and integrated into system designs and configuration

- Assist in evaluating, planning, configuration, and implementation of new software services

- Develop custom tools and automation through programming and scripting.

- Support Software Development by maintaining and scaling our Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery environment as needed

- Apply Data Lifecycle Management to sensitive data through backups, permissions management, and auditing

- Participate in an on-call rotation, triaging and escalating alerts, and assisting in disaster recovery as necessary for services the team is responsible for

- Member of an Agile Team providing code reviews, velocity estimation, planning input, and participating in other Agile Methodology workflows

- Work and communicate effectively with Product Owners, Development teams, and Cloud and Delivery teams

- Create and maintain technical documentation

- Performs other duties as required and completes all job functions as per departmental policies and procedures

- #LIRemote

 What we are looking for:

- Minimum of 2 year experience in one or more of (Required):

  - Continuous Integration Tools and Techniques (e.g. Jenkins, Bamboo, Github Actions)

  - Configuration management and deployment tools (e.g. Ansible, Chef, Puppet).

  - Systems Administration or similar role focused on performance analysis, capacity planning, and forecasting.

- Minimum of 2 year experience as a power user of various operating systems (e.g. Linux, Windows, Mac) (Required).

- Minimum of 2 year experience in a current programming language (e.g. Python, Golang) (Required)

- Minimum of 2 year experience using Source Control Management tools (e.g. Git, Subversion) (Required).

- Minimum of 2 year experience using issue tracking software (e.g. JIRA) (Preferred).

- Experience developing enterprise grade software with understanding of the software development life cycle (Preferred).

- Experience with infrastructure as code techniques (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation) (Preferred)

- Experience in enterprise security and hardening best practices (Preferred).

- Experience building and maintaining cloud native services (e.g. Amazon Web Services, Azure, GCP) (Preferred)

- Experience working with monitoring and logging tools (e.g. LogicMonitor, Sumologic, ELK) (Preferred)

- Experience with containerization concepts and Kubernetes (Preferred)

- Experience working with structured databases (e.g. MySQL, DynamoDB) (Preferred)

- Hands-on experience with AI-driven coding assistants like GitHub Copilot, Cursor, others to enhance development productivity.

- 4 year / Bachelor's Degree (Preferred)

- A combination of relevant experience and education may be considered.

- Certificates commonly held by those in the role include one or more of: LPIC-1, LPIC-2, LPIC-3, RHCE (RedHat Certified Engineer), AWS Solutions Architect Associate, AWS Certified Developer Associate, AWS Certified SysOps Associate. (Preferred)

 SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

- Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory

- Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches

- Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf

 OTHER REQUIREMENTS

- This position will perform work that the U.S. government has specified can only be performed by a U.S. citizen located physically in the U.S., and therefore any employment offer will be contingent upon verification of both of these requirements. Applicants who are not U.S. citizens or who are located outside of the U.S. are strongly encouraged to apply for other positions at Jamf, which is an equal-opportunity employer.

 How we help you reach your best potential:

- Named a 2025 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Named a 2024 Best Technology Company to Work For by U.S. News

- Named one of Forbes Most Trusted Companies in 2024

- Named a 2024 Best Companies to Work For by U.S. News

- Our developers work in agile delivery teams to produce new features, improve software components, and are the subject matter experts for our Jamf product offerings.

- You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 75,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.

- We constantly push the boundaries of technology, our developers support new innovations and OS releases the moment they are made available by Apple.

- Several Jamf engineers are named in patents and with team names like CatDog, ThunderSnow and Dalek you can expect to have some fun while building cutting-edge software.

- You will have the opportunity to work with a small and empowered team where the culture is based on trust, ownership, and respect.

- We offer a clear career path that enables you to grow under supportive leadership and management

- Visit our Jamf Engineering blog to learn more about the innovative projects our team is working on and what we learn from each challenge we solve. A blog written by engineers, for engineers at medium.com/jamf-engineering

- 22 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

- Over 100,000 Jamf Nation users, the largest online IT community in the world.

 Pay Transparency

At Jamf, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is set within a defined range. These ranges can vary based on hiring location. Where an individual's pay falls within that range depends on several factors, including role scope, location, budget, skills, experience, and qualifications. This approach helps ensure fair, competitive pay and provides room to grow as you develop in your role.

The national pay transparency range below represents all U.S. locations and accounts for geographic differences in pay, resulting in a broader range.

National Pay Transparency Range

 $93,700 - $169,840 USD

 What it means to be a Jamf?
 We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. jobs.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.

With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai

About the Role

Waabi is seeking an Sr IT Systems Administrator to join our growing IT Operations team and provide hands-on technology support for our San Francisco, CA site while helping scale IT operations across all Waabi locations.

This is a high-ownership, onsite role focused on ensuring employees have reliable, secure, and efficient technology experiences. You will support day-to-day IT operations, manage endpoint and identity systems, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and partner with teams across the organization to deliver scalable solutions.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on problem solver who enjoys working across multiple layers of IT, from supporting users and managing endpoints to maintaining office infrastructure and improving IT processes. You will collaborate closely with the broader IT team to provide remote support to other Waabi locations and participate in the IT Support on-call rotation.

You will…

End User Support & IT Operations
Provide onsite technical support for employees at the San Francisco, CA location, including hardware, software, networking, and access issues
Serve as a trusted IT partner for local teams, providing timely troubleshooting and solutions
Support remote users and collaborate with IT team members across other Waabi locations
Participate in the IT Support on-call rotation to provide after-hours support as needed
Manage incidents and requests through Jira Service Management, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication
Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures
Endpoint Management & Device Lifecycle
Administer endpoint management platforms for Windows, macOS, and Linux devices
Support device enrollment, configuration profiles, security policies, application deployment, and compliance reporting
Assist with zero-touch deployment processes using technologies such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager/Automated Device Enrollment
Manage workstation lifecycle including provisioning, configuration, troubleshooting, replacement, and retirement
Support mobile device management and secure BYOD access workflows
Maintain accurate hardware inventory and asset management records
Identity & Access Management
Support user lifecycle management including onboarding, offboarding, account provisioning, and access changes
Manage and administer identity, access, and collaboration platforms such as Okta, Google Workspace, or similar systems
Support group management, permissions, and access policies
Assist with SSO integrations and SaaS application access management
Help implement secure access practices aligned with company security requirements
Site Infrastructure & Workplace Technology
Own day-to-day IT operations for the San Francisco office, including:
Workstations and peripherals
Printers and print services
Conference room technology and A/V systems
Network connectivity troubleshooting
Physical IT infrastructure
Support wired and wireless network troubleshooting, including switches, patch panels, and cabling
Partner with Facilities and vendors on office technology projects, expansions, and improvements
Assist with deployment and maintenance of physical technology infrastructure
Support specialized engineering and lab environments as needed
Linux Systems & Server Administration
Administer, patch, and maintain Linux servers and workstations supporting engineering, R&D, and office environments
Manage user accounts, permissions, and configuration via standard Linux tooling and scripting (Bash/Python)
Support Linux-based endpoint provisioning, imaging, and configuration management for engineering and lab users
Monitor system health, logs, and performance, and troubleshoot Linux-specific issues across compute and networked storage
Maintain security hardening, patch management, and compliance for Linux systems
Security & Compliance Support
Support implementation and maintenance of endpoint security standards and controls
Assist with device compliance monitoring, patch management, and security remediation activities
Follow established security processes and help improve operational controls
Support audits and compliance initiatives through documentation, reporting, and evidence collection
Partner with security teams to investigate and remediate endpoint-related issues
Process Improvement & IT Scaling
Identify opportunities to improve IT workflows, automation, and employee experience
Contribute to scalable processes that support Waabi’s growth
Improve documentation, knowledge sharing, and support practices across the IT organization
Qualifications
5+ years of experience in IT systems administration, desktop support, or IT operations roles
Experience supporting Windows and macOS environments in a business setting
Experience administering endpoint management tools such as Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud, Jamf, or similar platforms
Experience with identity and access management concepts, including user provisioning, permissions, and authentication
Strong troubleshooting skills across hardware, software, networking, and user-facing technologies
Experience supporting onsite office infrastructure, including networking, printers, conferencing systems, and peripherals
Ability to prioritize multiple requests while maintaining excellent customer service
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to document technical processes clearly and with a customer service mindset
Willingness to participate in an IT support on-call rotation
Ability to lift and move material up to ~50 pounds
Experience supporting a multi-site organization with both onsite and remote users
Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace, Okta, or similar identity platforms
Experience with SSO integrations using SAML and SCIM
Experience with automation and scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar)
Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or SOC 2
Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment
Bonus
Experience working in startups
Passionate about self-driving technologies, solving hard problems, and creating innovative solutions

The US yearly salary range for this role is: $115,000 - $135,000 USD in addition to competitive perks & benefits. Waabi US Inc.’s yearly salary ranges are determined based on several factors in accordance with the Company’s compensation practices. Note: The Company provides additional compensation for employees in this role, including equity incentive awards and an annual performance bonus.

Perks/Benefits:
Waabi provides a competitive benefits package that includes:
Competitive compensation and equity awards.
Health and wellness benefits encompassing Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
Paid parental, medical and family care leave.
Generous PTO Policy.
Retirement savings plans including 401(k) or RRSP options.
Health savings account contribution options.
Daily drinks, snacks, and catered meals (when in office).
Regularly scheduled team building activities and social events both on-site, off-site & virtually.
Additional benefits are offered and tailored to specific country locations.

jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, MISSION SYSTEMS

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and versatile Launch IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute, and application support needs of our launch environment. This role is critical to enabling safe, reliable, and high-cadence launch operations across multiple sites. The ideal candidate thrives in mission-critical settings, brings a strong sense of urgency balanced with operational excellence, and is comfortable operating as a technical generalist across multiple IT disciplines.

   RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design, deploy and augment IT infrastructure including networking, server, and desktop hardware that directly supports mission-critical networks across the country.

- Provide direct IT support during launch and test campaigns.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and maintenance in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Proactively monitor IT services and respond rapidly to incidents to ensure high availability and optimal systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, including systems overview, design drawings and operational procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to broader IT systems engineering and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Experience with both Linux and Windows server administration.

- Experience designing, deploying, supporting and troubleshooting enterprise networks.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc.), firewall administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identity environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge of Windows-based systems and services, including the ability to set up, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot said infrastructure.

- Ability to administer and troubleshoot Linux-based systems and services through command line.

- Experience supporting real-time systems, industrial control networks, or operational technology (OT) environments in aerospace, defense, energy, or similar high-reliability industries.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines and other DevOps concepts/tools.

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass DoD background check for launch site access.

- Willingness to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation and work extended hours or weekends as necessary.

- Willingness to travel (up to 20%, including flying to other sites worldwide) and potential time at sea supporting marine systems.

- Ability to lift 30 lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Ability to drive (active valid driver’s license).

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:

IT Systems Administrator: $95,000.00 - $120,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees accrue paid sick leave pursuant to Company policy which satisfies or exceeds the accrual, carryover, and use requirements of the law.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

- To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here .

SpaceX is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with SpaceX is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.

Applicants wishing to view a copy of SpaceX’s Affirmative Action Plan for veterans and individuals with disabilities, or applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application/interview process should reach out to EEOCompliance@spacex.com .

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We're committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that's welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.
Boeing Defense, Space, and Security (BDS), Space and Launch Division, seeks an Satellite Systems Engineer - Operations and Systems Analysis (Associate and Expert) supporting the team in Schriever, CO.
Our team develops new global military satellite communications (MILSATCOM) ground systems that manage transmission of protected tactical waveform (a type of secure, anti-jam communication) over Boeing-built Wideband Global SATCOM (WGS) satellites and terminals. Space and Launch work with proprietary customers and creates next generation technologies in space. We work all facets of engineering: technology investment, concept development, proposal writing, requirements and design, build, integration, test, and demonstration of products in their relevant environments.
The Satellite Systems Engineer is part of a high-performing team immersed in dynamic satellite operations and engineering activities. As a member of our WGS on-orbit team, you support operations and engineering for 10 on-orbit satellites.

jobs.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We're building an AI scientist for our customers. We can't do that if we haven't built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEWWe're looking for a Technology Operations Engineer to join our Technology Operations team and serve as the primary resource for our Boston office. In this role, you'll be the go-to problem solver for technology needs across the company; supporting everything from Helpdesk requests and device management to SaaS administration and onboarding; while owning the on-site experience and IT asset management for Boston.

You'll work hands-on with modern cloud and collaboration platforms like Okta, Google Workspace, Jira, Slack, and Zoom, while also partnering with teams in Workplace, Security, and Engineering to improve how we deliver TechOps services. As the local escalation path for Boston, you'll have real ownership over how technology shows up for employees in that office, and you'll partner closely with teammates in San Francisco and Zurich to support a globally distributed workforce.

This is a great opportunity for someone who's passionate about technology, loves helping others succeed, and wants to grow their career in a fast-paced, SaaS-driven environment. If you take pride in solving problems, improving systems, and finding ways to make work better for everyone - you'll fit right in here.

RESPONSIBILITIESServe as the primary on-site technology resource and local escalation path for our Boston office, partnering with TechOps teammates in San Francisco and Zurich

Provide Tier 1 Helpdesk support including software, hardware, application access, AV, and networking in our Boston Office as well as our remote, SF, and Zurich offices

Own the ITAM function for the Boston office, including inventory, procurement, stock levels, asset lifecycle and refresh, and device retirement and disposal

Monitor and maintain our Helpdesk service level agreements (SLAs) including first response and full resolution

Administer a variety of SaaS applications including but not limited to Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, Jira, Zoom, Office365

Provide occasional coverage during EMEA business hours to support our Zurich office when local coverage is unavailable

Own the local onboarding experience for Boston, including preparing and deploying systems and leading new hire orientation

Assist with, and own, TechOps projects within TechOperations and Security Engineering including identity and access management, client platform, and AV

Work closely with Workplace, Information Security, and other cross-functional teams on relevant initiatives and daily operations

Develop and maintain Technology Operations documentation

QUALIFICATIONS 3+ years experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and systems in a corporate environment supporting Mac OS and Windows

3+ years experience working in a heavily SaaS-based environment

Experience owning or meaningfully contributing to IT asset management, including inventory, procurement, and device lifecycle

Comfortable operating as the sole or primary on-site technology resource for a location, with the judgment to know when to escalate

Willingness to occasionally flex working hours to provide backup coverage for EMEA-based colleagues

Excellent communication skills and customer service attitude

Experience with IAM platforms, specifically Okta or similar

Experience with ITSM, specifically Jira Service Management or any Helpdesk ticketing system

Experience with endpoint management tools such as Jamf, Fleet, Intune, AWS Workspace, and WorkspaceONE

Experience with video conferencing and AV systems

Experience with network troubleshooting

You are motivated by helping others succeed. When things break - and they will - you are eager and able to help fix things. You like thinking of ways to improve efficiency or bring delight to the people you work with

You know that the internet is a scary place, understand security concepts, and can put them into action to protect us and our users

You are a technology enthusiast who is always excited to learn about new apps, devices, and ways to do things better. Requirements can vary depending on leveling and scope

jobs.description:
Overview

Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai .

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

 Description

Empower AI is seeking an Endpoint Engineer - Tier III Escalation to serve as the final technical escalation point for complex, enterprise-wide endpoint incidents and security events for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. When Tier I and Tier II cannot resolve an issue, this engineer performs deep diagnostic analysis of operating system, application, Group Policy, MECM client, encryption, VDI, and endpoint security behavior to identify root cause, engineers permanent fixes, and liaises with Microsoft and OEM vendors at Tier IV. The role leads endpoint After-Action Reviews and Root Cause Analyses, converts findings into Tier I/II enablement, and resolves PL1-PL4 escalations within PRS timeframes. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

 THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

 JOB DUTIES:

 Serve as the Tier III escalation authority for complex, enterprise-wide endpoint incidents and security events, performing deep log, trace, crash-dump, and behavior analysis to identify root causes not documented in the knowledge base. Engineer and validate permanent fixes (image, GPO, package, script, or configuration changes) in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment and implement them through Change Management; manage Tier IV escalation to Microsoft and OEM vendors. Lead endpoint After-Action Reviews and Root Cause Analyses for PL1/PL2 and recurring problems, deliver Problem Resolution Action Plans, and convert findings into knowledge articles and Tier I/II enablement recommendations. Resolve escalated PL1-PL4 tickets within PRS timeframes following the Customer-Confirmed Ticket Closure process and analyze escalation trends to recommend automation and configuration improvements. Lead the engineering design, implementation, and lifecycle of the enterprise endpoint infrastructure: hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, endpoint management platform architecture (MECM/SCCM, Intune), configuration baselines, and VDI integration across all enclaves. Lead the evaluation, cost-benefit analysis, and phased implementation of the Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling; author the Digital Twin Evaluation and Implementation Plan; and establish the practice that every significant change is tested in the digital replica before deployment. Lead engineering for AI, automation, and analytics initiatives approved by the Government, including predictive analytics on service data, intelligent automation across support tiers, and integrations with the ITSM platform, and deliver Proof of Concept Reports documenting feasibility, risks, and benefits. Conduct market research and produce Market Research Reports and Rough Orders of Magnitude (ROMs) for emerging technologies and proposed solutions to support Government planning and IT Capability Request analysis.

Qualifications

 Qualifications

 REQUIREMENTS :

 Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 10 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 8 years of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). Must be a U.S. Citizen. Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start. Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting. Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level III baseline certification (e.g., CASP+ CE, CISSP or Associate, CCNP Security, GCED, or GCIH). Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision. Minimum of 10 years of experience in systems or infrastructure engineering for enterprise Windows environments, including lead-engineer responsibility for endpoint or infrastructure programs at 10,000+ device scale. Expert knowledge of MECM/SCCM and/or Intune architecture, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (VMware/Hyper-V), VDI, and PowerShell automation. Demonstrated experience designing and leading implementation of lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments and formal test-before-deploy practices. Experience leading proof-of-concept evaluations, market research, and cost-benefit/ROM development for Government or enterprise decision-makers. Extensive experience with DISA STIGs, ACAS/Nessus, RMF control implementation, POA&Ms, and eMASS. Experience leading engineering teams, establishing standards, and executing changes through formal Change Management. Excellent technical writing, briefing, and stakeholder communication skills; ability to participate in after-hours emergency on-call response.

 DESIRED SKILLS:

 CISSP, CASP+ CE, or GCED; Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert; VMware VCP/VCAP; AWS or Azure architect certification. Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. Experience applying AI/ML, RPA, or AIOps to IT service management and endpoint operations, including ServiceNow integrations. Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Strategy and Reference Architecture, DoDAF 2.02, DoD ICAM Strategy, and Technology Business Management (TBM). ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional; PMP. Experience supporting IT Capability Request (ITCR) analysis and governance briefings.

Physical Requirements

The physical demands described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to do the following:

 If remote, maintain home workspace in a safe manner, free from safety hazards and in line with information security policies. Communicate verbally in person, over the phone or by video chat and clearly/succinctly in writing, primarily utilizing a keyboard. Appear on camera for meetings with co-workers and government partners via video chat and ensure the protection of proprietary company and customer information is consistent with the company’s expectation of information security. Viewing computer screens and sitting for long periods of time. Travel minimally (10%), via car or plane, which requires ability to manage luggage, laptop, and briefing materials (up to 25 pounds).

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

Job Summary
Digital Workplace, Executive Support and Audiovisual AV Support Engineer The position combines hands-on executive support with site ownership, ensuring a consistent, high-quality workplace technology experience across locations. The individual will act as a trusted partner to business leadership, owning the end-to-end support experience, driving service performance, and ensuring seamless execution during high-visibility and time-sensitive situations.

This role requires strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to operate calmly under pressure while maintaining the highest level of professionalism, discretion, and accountability.

This role supports senior leaders and enterprise meetings where reliability, security, professionalism, and discretion are essential.

You Will

Executive and End User Support

Provide high touch technology support for senior executives, including devices, collaboration tools, and audiovisual environments. Act as an escalation point for complex or high impact executive support issues. Support leadership meetings, town halls, and enterprise events, including live troubleshooting during sessions when needed.

End User Computing and Device Management

Support and troubleshoot Windows endpoints and virtual desktop solutions, including Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, AWS Workspaces, and traditional VDI platforms. Maintain hands on working knowledge of Microsoft Intune, SCCM, and Windows Autopilot. Manage executive device lifecycle activities such as provisioning, ongoing maintenance, refresh, and retirement.

Audiovisual and Collaboration Support

Provide on site and remote support for executive conference rooms, meeting spaces, and hybrid work environments. Support Microsoft Teams Rooms and associated audiovisual hardware, including cameras, microphones, displays, and room control systems. Partner with Facilities, vendors, and event stakeholders to ensure meetings are properly prepared and executed.

Security and Compliance

Ensure executive support practices align with Guardian policies, security standards, and regulatory requirements. Work closely with Security and Infrastructure teams to maintain secure configurations and protect sensitive executive data. Handle business critical and executive issues with appropriate confidentiality and professionalism.

Innovation, Automation, and AI

Maintain a working understanding of AI and GenAI technologies relevant to digital workplace operations. Identify opportunities to improve user experience through automation and process improvement. Support the adoption of modern tools and capabilities aligned with Guardian’s Digital Workplace strategy.

Collaboration and Vendor Management

Collaborate with cross functional partners including Security, Infrastructure, HR, Real Estate, and business teams. Manage relationships with AV and technology vendors and contribute to evaluations of new solutions. Document standards, procedures, and operational practices as needed.

jobs.description:
This role offers the opportunity to work alongside a senior end-user computing engineering organization delivering impactful VDI migration, engineering, and automation outcomes across a large, complex enterprise desktop estate.

  Position Overview

  This role supports the engineering, migration, and ongoing development of a large-scale enterprise virtual desktop environment. The team is migrating workloads onto Omnissa Horizon and needs engineers who can build, configure, troubleshoot, and improve Windows virtual desktop services.

  Key Responsibilities

  Engineer and support enterprise Windows virtual desktop environments using Omnissa Horizon
  Support the migration and transition of workloads from existing VDI platforms to Horizon
  Build, configure, and maintain Windows 10/11 virtual desktop images and associated desktop services
  Engineer and optimize desktop images, profiles, policies, and application configurations
  Configure and support Horizon components including Connection Servers, Horizon Agents, desktop pools, and associated infrastructure
  Troubleshoot complex VDI issues across the Windows desktop, application, profile, authentication, and infrastructure layers
  Support Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows security configuration within the virtual desktop environment
  Work with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to resolve end-to-end desktop issues
  Support application delivery, packaging, and deployment into virtual desktop environments
  Automate repeatable desktop engineering and operational activities using PowerShell or equivalent tooling
  Monitor and optimize VDI performance, stability, capacity, and end-user experience
  Produce engineering documentation, operational procedures, and implementation plans

  Required Qualifications

  Strong hands-on experience in Windows desktop engineering, particularly Windows 10/11
  Strong experience supporting and engineering an enterprise VDI environment
  Experience with at least one major VDI platform, such as Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops, Azure Virtual Desktop, or other comparable enterprise VDI technologies
  Good understanding of VDI architecture and desktop delivery concepts
  Strong knowledge of Active Directory and Group Policy
  Experience with Windows image creation, configuration, optimization, and lifecycle management
  Experience troubleshooting desktop performance, application, profile, and authentication issues
  Strong PowerShell skills and an automation-first approach to engineering
  Understanding of enterprise networking concepts relevant to VDI, including DNS, load balancing, firewalls, and remote-access connectivity

  Preferred Qualifications

  Hands-on Omnissa Horizon engineering experience
  Experience migrating from Citrix to Horizon or between other enterprise VDI platforms
  Experience with Omnissa technologies such as Workspace ONE UEM or DEX
  Experience with profile-management technologies such as FSLogix, DEM, or Citrix Profile Management
  Experience with application packaging and deployment technologies
  Knowledge of F5, authentication/SSO technologies, and enterprise remote-access architectures
  Experience with infrastructure automation, scripting, and configuration management

jobs.description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking an Endpoint Engineer to join our Enterprise Technology team. In this role, you will serve as a macOS subject matter expert in a complex, highly technical environment, helping to solve HRT-specific endpoint challenges and improve the day-to-day experience for users across the firm.

You will support a team of technicians, act as an escalation point for macOS engineering, security, and deployment issues, and design solutions that improve endpoint uptime, reliability, and productivity. This is a high-impact opportunity for someone who enjoys combining hands-on troubleshooting with long-term systems thinking in order to deliver visible improvements at scale.

Responsibilities

Create and maintain a best-in-class end user computing experienceTroubleshoot day-to-day issues with a hands-on approach. You’ll be the escalation point for macOS engineering, security, and deployment-related issues across HRTInvestigate recurring problems, provide long-term solutions to prevent them from happening again, and maintain clear documentation for future referenceResearch, test, and implement best practices for our technical stack and processesEducate technical and non-technical end users on best practices and help improve adoption of effective workflows and toolsQualifications

Deep knowledge and experience with macOSExperience provisioning, deploying, and maintaining macOS endpoints using Apple Business (AB) and Mobile Device Management (MDM) such as Jamf Pro, Workspace One, or Microsoft IntuneExperience with macOS packaging and deployment tools such as AutoPkg and MunkiProficiency with Bash or PythonFamiliarity with enterprise networking, including 802.1X, Wi-Fi, and IPv4Experience working with collaboration tools, conferencing systems, remote IT tools, and ticketing systemsA collaborative, can-do mindset and willingness to support others across the teamAbility to effectively communicate in technical and non-technical language, and translate information into comprehendible documentation and requirements company-wideAbility to empathize with the end-user and swiftly craft solutions under pressureNice to have: experience with osquery, Salt, or iOS managementThe estimated base salary range for this position is 150,000 to 225,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

 Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

jobs.description:
About The Team

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering (CPE) team delivers trusted devices at scale: secure by default, reliable by design, and effortless to use. We own platform capabilities across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, spanning endpoint posture and device trust, application delivery, onboarding, updates, telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. The team partners deeply with Security, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering groups to enable and protect OpenAI while reducing friction for the people advancing our mission.

About The Role

As an Engineering Manager for CPE, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for the strategy, delivery, and operation of OpenAI’s cross-platform client foundation. You will combine people leadership with strong technical judgment: setting direction, developing engineers, reviewing architecture and tradeoffs, and creating the operating mechanisms that turn ambiguous needs into durable platform outcomes. This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of security, reliability, developer velocity, and employee experience.

CPE is a highly technical platform engineering organization delivering first-party services, automation, observability, and safe fleet operations. We’re looking for a leader who can guide its next chapter, scaling the team and its systems, partnering across the company, and raising the bar for secure, reliable, low-friction experiences across every supported platform.

In This Role, You Will

Lead and develop a high-performing engineering team; hire thoughtfully, coach engineers, create clarity, and foster an inclusive, high-accountability culture that pushes perceived limits.Define and execute a multi-year client-platform strategy and roadmap across macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, and Linux, including how Codex and agents can reshape employee computing.Provide technical direction for endpoint posture, device trust, application delivery, device onboarding, updates, fleet telemetry, workflow orchestration, and employee-facing remediation. Lead the team to rethink the platform from first principles as Codex and agent capabilities advance: what software needs to be built, what agents can own end to end, and which employee workflows no longer need to exist.Guide architecture and engineering tradeoffs across first-party services, open-source tooling, SaaS platforms, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Decide what to build, buy, standardize, retire, or redesign as AI changes what the platform can do.Establish clear goals, ownership, planning, design reviews, and execution rhythms that let the team move quickly without sacrificing quality.Raise the bar for reliability and evidence-backed security through observability, drift detection, staged rollouts, release gates, rollback paths, incident learning, runbooks, and healthy operational ownership. Use telemetry to see friction, measure outcomes, and improve before issues become tickets.Partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, Product, and specialized engineering teams to align priorities and land company-wide changes, dogfood OpenAI products in real employee workflows, and continuously improve internal platforms.Balance strong security and compliance controls with developer velocity, employee experience, and operational simplicity. Define where agents can act, where humans approve, and how actions are evaluated, audited, and reversed.Use adoption, reliability, evidence-backed security posture, data freshness, employee experience, workflow completion, friction, agent effectiveness, and operational-load metrics to steer investment and communicate impact.Partner with IT and Security teams to compound CPE’s impact across employee experience, security posture, and operational scale.

You may be a fit for this role if you have:

Built and led teams that owned secure, reliable, mission critical services and infrastructure at scale, from strategy through production operations.Delivered internal platforms, tooling, and services that materially improved reliability, security, and employee experience.Made sound software and infrastructure engineering decisions at scale. Deep endpoint expertise is strongly preferred.Raised production readiness through direct technical review of architecture, automation, code, IaC/GitOps, CI/CD, observability, and operational tradeoffs.Operated infrastructure with material security or identity risk through staged rollouts, incidents, and decisions that balanced risk, compliance, and employee or developer experience.Committed to joining the team’s engineering on call rotation after ramp up and using firsthand operational context to improve reliability and reduce toil.Built inclusive teams that do excellent work, communicated with clarity and candor, and influenced partners across Security, IT, and Product/Engineering.

You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have

Deep experience with one or more client-platform tool ecosystems such as Jamf, Intune, Android Enterprise, FleetDM/osquery, Munki/AutoPkg, or Linux configuration management.Experience building internal platforms or services for app delivery, device posture/trust, onboarding, notifications, workflow orchestration, or fleet telemetry.Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, Terraform, Kubernetes/containers, service orchestration, and large-scale observability.Experience partnering with security, compliance, or privacy teams in high-assurance environments.Experience supporting research, developer, robotics, hardware-lab, or other specialized computing environments.A record of contributing to open-source tooling, engineering communities, or cross-company technical standards.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We offer relocation assistance to new employees.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
Onsite

 Description:

Diversified Systems is searching for a Network Infrastructure Engineer to support and advance the Information Technology's enterprise networking environment. This position plays a critical role in designing, deploying, and operating the (LDC) fabrics, networks, identity-driven access systems, and observability platforms.

The engineer will work closely with the infrastructure team to ensure the State's network services remain reliable, scalable, secure, and aligned with enterprise modernization goals. This is a hands-on engineering position that requires strong technical expertise, effective communication, and the ability to support mission-critical systems across data centers and statewide operations.

 Responsibilities:

 Cisco ACI & Data Center Networking Design, implement, and maintain Cisco Nexus platforms running ACI mode, including VRFs, Bridge Domains, EPGs/ESGs, L3Out, contracts, and fabric policies. Integrate ACI with virtualization and container platforms including Red Hat OpenShift VMM and Isovalent/Cilium. Configure and optimize RoCEv2 within the ACI fabric for high-performance, low-latency workloads. Conduct advanced troubleshooting of ACI fabric health, faults, endpoint learning, contracts, and multi-tenant segmentation. Develop and maintain fabric documentation, standards, and operational procedures. Cisco Catalyst & Software-Defined Access Deploy and support Cisco Catalyst platforms within campus environments. Design and maintain Software-Defined Access (SDA) architectures, including SDA Wired Fabric and Fabric-Enabled Wireless. Manage fabric underlay and overlay, policy mapping, authentication integrations, and assurance operations. Collaborate with wireless engineers to optimize coverage, performance, and policy enforcement across SDA. Identity-Driven Networking & Security Technologies Configure and administer Cisco Identity Services Engine (Client) for TACACS+ device administration, authentication and authorization policy sets, and endpoint profiling. Integrate Cyber Vision intelligence into profiling, segmentation, and access control workflows. Support Zero Trust efforts through identity-centric segmentation and policy integration across ACI and SDA fabrics. Visibility, Analytics & Observability Deploy and manage ThousandEyes for end-to-end visibility, routing path analysis, and performance monitoring. Implement and support Cisco Cyber Vision for OT/IoT asset visibility, device classification, and behavior analysis. Manage DNA Spaces for location analytics, telemetry ingestion, device behavior, and wireless intelligence. Provide meaningful insights to leadership using data from these observability platforms. Core Network Engineering Troubleshoot complex L2/L3 network issues across multiple environments including VLANs, OSPF, BGP, STP, and multicast. Design and implement Palo Alto Networks security solutions across enterprise environments. Create and maintain documentation including architecture diagrams, standards, runbooks, and asset inventories. Assist in modernization planning, platform upgrades, procurement processes, and statewide technology initiatives. Perform other duties as assigned.
 Requirements:

 15 years of experience working with Cisco networking required. Hands-on experience with Cisco ACI in production environments required. Deep knowledge of ACI constructs including VRF, Client, EPG, ESG, L3Out, and contracts required. Experience integrating ACI with OpenShift VMM and Cilium/Isovalent required. Proficiency with Cisco Catalyst platforms and SDA fabric technologies required. Experience administering Cisco Client including TACACS+ and policy-set-based NAC required. Strong understanding of ThousandEyes, Cyber Vision, and DNA Spaces or comparable tools required. Solid command of core TCP/IP, routing, switching, QoS, and network security fundamentals required. Ability to develop clear diagrams, documentation, and architectural artifacts required. Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to work in fast-paced, mission-critical environments required.

 Highly Desired Skills:

 Cisco certifications such as CCNP Data Center, CCNP Enterprise, CCIE, or equivalent experience highly desired. Hands-on experience with container networking and virtualization integrations highly desired. Familiarity with NIST frameworks and state-level cybersecurity requirements highly desired. Experience with network automation tools including Python, Ansible, and REST APIs highly desired. Prior work in state government or large enterprise network environments highly desired. Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA) certification highly desired. Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA) certification highly desired.

jobs.description:
Job Description

$220,000 - $320,000 + equity
\

\

My client is a Series A company building a Platform as a Service that runs inside their customers\' own cloud. Instead of asking companies to move workloads onto someone else\'s platform, they provision and operate battle-tested Kubernetes clusters directly in customer AWS, Google Cloud Platform and Azure accounts, then automate the day 2 operations. Startups get enterprise-grade reliability and scale without the DevOps overhead, and they never hit the graduation problem that forces teams off a platform as they grow.
\

\

They are looking for an Infrastructure Engineer to own and evolve the infrastructure management system behind that platform. This is a pure IC role on a flat engineering team of around 20. You will be working on some of the hardest problems in cloud infrastructure: designing systems that work seamlessly across three clouds for hundreds of customers, from seed-stage startups to post-IPO companies. You will not just set up infrastructure. You will write the software that programmatically manages and rolls out changes across every customer environment. Unlike back-office infra at a larger company, here your work is the product. You will talk to top customers directly and help broker deals worth hundreds of thousands of dollars.
\

\

What you will be doing
\
\
 Building and maintaining the software that provisions, manages and rolls out infrastructure changes across hundreds of customer cloud accounts on AWS, Google Cloud Platform and Azure\
 Designing cloud-agnostic infrastructure architecture that scales from seed-stage companies to public enterprises, without breaking the bank\
 Engineering reliable, automated systems to handle the complexity of multi-cloud Kubernetes deployments at scale\
 Collaborating directly with customers on Slack and calls to understand their infrastructure needs and turn those into platform improvements\
 Raising the bar on reliability and code quality so that any customer\'s DevOps team could look under the hood and say "there\'s no chance I\'m doing this better"\
\

\

What they are looking for
\
\
 4+ years as an infrastructure or platform engineer\
 You currently write production application code as a software engineer, rather than working as a pure DevOps or SRE specialist\
 You have built or contributed to core infrastructure at an infrastructure company (PaaS, IaaS, cloud platform or internal developer platform) or at a company with a very high engineering bar\
 Strong proficiency in Go\
 Hands-on multi-cloud experience across AWS, Google Cloud Platform or Azure\
\

\

Nice to have
\
\
 Built infrastructure at a VC-backed infrastructure startup\
 Experience with Rust\
 BS in Computer Science or an equivalent technical degree\
\

\

Logistics
\
\
 5 days per week onsite in New York City, with 30 remote days and 30 days PTO per year\
 Relocation support available\
 Process: hiring manager call, technical screen, one-day onsite with some flexibility for remote components. Feedback within 24 hours at every stage\
\
