 Integration Engineering & ArchitectureEnd-to-End Data Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain scalable batch and real-time data integration pipelines (APIs, ETL/ELT) connecting source systems (Mainframe, legacy SQL) to MDM/PIM platforms and Snowflake.Source-to-Target System Mapping: Map data lineage, JSON/REST API payloads, and complex business transformation rules across enterprise boundaries to deliver clean, synchronized master data sets.Modernization & Automation: Lead efforts to transition legacy, decentralized transformations (Alteryx, local SQL scripts) into optimized Snowflake cloud tables and automated orchestration workflows. MDM & PIM Platform ManagementSystem Integrity & Governance: Supervise and maintain structural data integrity, global taxonomy hierarchies, and attribute schemas within enterprise PIM/MDM platforms (e.g., Enter Works, Precisely or similar), enforcing automated validation rules and business logic.Data Quality Auditing: Write intermediate-to-advanced SQL queries and profiling scripts to perform automated data validation, backend regression testing, and anomaly detection across staging and production environments.Syndication & Outbound Feeds: Configure and manage outbound data syndication feeds to downstream enterprise applications, including Salesforce, e-commerce platforms, and reporting layers. Requirement Engineering & Technical SupportTechnical Scoping: Deconstruct complex business requirements, stakeholder asks, and domain rules into explicit technical specifications, system flow diagrams, and actionable Jira sprint tasks.Incident Engineering & Root Cause Analysis: Investigate and resolve high-priority data pipeline failures, sync gaps, and integration anomalies submitted via ITSM tools (Ivanti) and Jira, enforcing target SLAs.Standardization & Change Management: Evaluate downstream technical and reporting impacts prior to executing schema updates, taxonomy modifications, or API ingestion changes. Maintain detailed technical documentation, system flows, and data dictionaries in Confluence.

Qualifications & Technical Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software/Data Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent professional experience).Experience: 2–5 years of hands-on experience in data engineering, integration engineering, or systems analysis within an enterprise MDM, PIM, or cloud data warehouse environment.Technical Proficiencies:SQL & Data Querying: Strong proficiency writing complex SQL (joins, aggregations, window functions) for database validation, pipeline profiling, and schema analysis.MDM & Cloud Data Stack: Hands-on experience with enterprise MDM/PIM platforms (EnterWorks, Informatica, or similar) and cloud data platforms (Snowflake).Integration Protocols: Solid understanding of APIs (REST/GraphQL, JSON/XML), ETL/ELT pipeline mechanics, and automated data orchestration.Agile & ITSM Tools: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and service desk tools (Ivanti or similar) for managing sprint backlogs and incident tickets.Soft Skills: Strong systems thinking and analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge communications seamlessly between data engineering teams and non-technical business partners.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Endpoint Management & Security
jobs.summary: Description About the Role We are growing and expanding our Endpoint Management & Security product team and are looking for a Product Manager to join a group of PMs working together on the capabilities that power NinjaOne's approach to reducing attack...
jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

We are growing and expanding our Endpoint Management & Security product team and are looking for a Product Manager to join a group of PMs working together on the capabilities that power NinjaOne's approach to reducing attack surface, including risk analysis and remediation, across managed endpoints. This role reports to the Director of Product Management and operates as part of a highly collaborative PM team focused on building and evolving the tools IT and security teams rely on to keep endpoints secure and risk exposure low.

This role covers capabilities that sit at the intersection of IT operations and security, helping customers spot where they're exposed and take action to close those gaps before they become problems. While these capabilities are deeply technical in nature, this is a product role focused on defining the right features, workflows, and abstractions that allow IT teams and MSPs to identify, prioritize, and remediate risk across their endpoint fleet efficiently, safely, and at scale. We're looking for someone equally comfortable in IT operations and security contexts — candidates with a background in either (or both) are encouraged to apply.

You will work closely with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners to shape product direction, define roadmaps, and deliver high-impact capabilities that strengthen customers' security posture across their environments. You'll also collaborate closely with other Product Managers to ensure NinjaOne continues to lead the market in how modern endpoint management platforms are designed, used, and evolved.

If you enjoy building core product capabilities, working close to real-world IT and security use cases, and helping define what "great" looks like when IT operations and security work as one, we'd love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, *IL, KS, ME, MA, MD, NJ, NC, NY, OR, TN, TX, VA, & WA.

Onsite interviews maybe required for this role

What You’ll be Doing

Product Vision & Leadership Help define and evolve the vision for NinjaOne’s endpoint management and security capabilities, ensuring we continue to lead the market in functionality, usability, innovation and flexibility. Roadmap & Prioritization Contribute to and own key parts of the endpoint management and security roadmap. Evaluate opportunities, set priorities, and make trade-offs that deliver the most value to customers and the business. Endpoint Management Capabilities Drive product direction for features to identify security gaps, and remediate or protect against them.Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with engineering, design, support, and other stakeholders to bring new capabilities from concept to delivery, ensuring features are well-defined, usable, and solve real customer problems. Customer & Market Insight Engage with customers, MSPs, and internal teams to understand how endpoint management and security features are used in practice. Translate those insights into product improvements and new capabilities. Product Craft & Execution Write clear product requirements, define workflows and edge cases, and ensure features are delivered to a high standard. Iterate based on feedback and usage data. Platform & Ecosystem Thinking Ensure capabilities work cohesively across NinjaOne and enable other product areas to build on top of them effectively. Other duties as needed

About You

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field preferred, but not required. 5+ years of experience in IT/security or technical roles such as managing or working in an IT helpdesk, at an MSP, or in an internal IT/security team. 2+ years of Strong Product Management experience, ideally with B2B SaaS or IT management products. Solid background in operating systems or system administration, such as: Windows, macOS, or Linux administration Endpoint management, device configuration, automation, or scripting Experience in MSP, internal IT, or infrastructure-focused roles Deep understanding of how IT teams manage endpoints in real-world environments. Comfortable working closely with engineers and understanding technical concepts without needing to write production code. Proven ability to take product features from idea to delivery and iterate based on customer feedback. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Data-informed decision maker who balances customer needs, product quality, and business priorities. Able to influence and align stakeholders without formal authority. Experience working in a collaborative, multi-PM environment is a plus.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

What You’ll Love

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

Additional Information

This position is NOT eligible for Visa sponsorship.

Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate.

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage and PTO. For roles based in California, Colorado, Maryland, New Jersey or Washington the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year.

For roles based in New York, the base salary hiring range for this position is $150,000 to $200,000 per year.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

jobs.description:
Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
 About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

 What Are We Looking For?We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product , the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. ( We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).

The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:

 Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development. Usable security & agent infrastructures – e.g., installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother. What will you do? As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields. You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system. Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day). Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000). You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group. What skills & knowledge should you bring? Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of low-level programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++). Hands‑on experience and in‑depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools. Previous experience working on a production‑grade product with a wide-scale deployment. Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem‑solving and out‑of‑the‑box thinking. Attention to detail and high coding standards. An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis. Why us?Because you will work on real-world problems with risks of millions of dollars (protecting against ransomware and other threats) and make an impact by preventing our customers from appearing in global news after being attacked. You will be joining a technologically cutting‑edge project and will be able to influence the architecture, design, and building of our core platform. You will meet extraordinary challenges and work with the very BEST in the industry.
 On top of that we offer you Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role based within Italy; we provide optional membership in major coworking chains Currently for this role in Italy we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Generous employee stock plan in the form of RSUs (restricted stock units) grant not options; 4 years vesting with 1 year cliff and then quarterly, stock refresh yearly. Yearly bonus depending on the performance of the company, paid out in 2 installments. Quadro benefits – Private Medical, Life Insurance, Accident Insurance, Study funds and Healthcare benefits. Flexible time off (up to 30 paid days off per annum!). Global gender‑neutral Parental Leave (16 weeks, beyond the leave provided by the local laws) & Grandparent Leave. Volunteering paid day off & Additional paid Company holidays off (e.g., 4 days in 2022). Global Employee Assistance Program (confidential counseling related to both personal and work life matters). Udemy Business platform for Hard/Soft skills Training, internal mentoring 'MentorOne' & Support for your further educational activities/trainings. Above‑standard referral bonus. Additional Country‑specific Benefits To Italy SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Aff… (rest of EEO statement omitted for brevity).
SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.

jobs.title: Sr. Associate, Microsoft 365 Engineer
jobs.summary: SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®,...
jobs.description:
SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®, method®, Autan®, Baygon®, Mr Muscle®, Duck®, Lysoform® and more.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

The Sr Associate Microsoft 365 Engineer is a member of the End User Productivity (EUP) team. The EUP team is a global team responsible for the management and delivery of client solutions that address current and future business needs while ensuring value realization in the shortest possible timeframe, most specifically involving Microsoft 365 platforms, physical and virtual endpoints, collaboration spaces, end-user enablement, and related services.

This position is responsible for the delivery and support of productivity and collaboration services focused on the Microsoft 365 platform. This includes Teams, Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Stream, Office applications, Power Platform and related Microsoft 365 services.

The appointee will lead service improvement efforts and work with Managed Service Providers (MSPs) to deliver solutions that promote ease of use, productivity and adherence to security requirements. The incumbent will also interact with departments across SCJ to understand requirements and deliver business value. This position also includes support of related EUP projects and platforms, service operations, and day-to-day level 3 support.

This is an onsite role in Racine, WI

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Lead continuous improvement efforts for the Microsoft 365 platform and collaboration tools. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify areas for improvement in processes, systems or products. Propose and implement enhancements, including automation where appropriate, to optimize efficiency and quality.

- Use and promote practical automation and AI-enabled approaches to improve recurring operational work, troubleshooting, documentation and service delivery, using capabilities such as Azure Automation, Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio and other approved Microsoft 365 tools.

- Stay current through research and industry connections to support a progressive approach within the Microsoft and collaboration space at SC Johnson. Collaborate with the Service Owner to develop and maintain knowledge of the Microsoft ecosystem, including SharePoint, Teams, Exchange and related services.

- Ensure compliance to standards and SLAs/XLAs by Managed Service Providers. Serve as a first escalation point for MSPs for issues. Monitor and analyze product performance metrics.

- Partner with the Service Owner to implement and improve solutions for SCJ application and infrastructure owners. Assist in defining and prioritizing product and service enhancements for the Microsoft 365 platform.

- Explore and apply agentic AI capabilities, including ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot, to improve productivity and reduce repetitive work while following SCJ security, privacy and governance requirements.

- Ensure SCJ standard infrastructure management processes are being followed, identify procedural issues and lead actions to remediate and correct processing as needed (examples: change, work, problem management).

- Experience coordinating and managing escalations with vendors and service providers.

- Ability to coordinate with vendors and partners as needed for problem resolution.

- Support management of vendor and partner relationships as necessary.

- Lead and/or participate in strategic and operational projects and initiatives.

- Document processes, procedures and operational standards for maintenance and support.

- Participate in the development of team plans, service roadmaps and operational priorities.

- Provides 3rd level operational support for platforms. Off-hours support and a flexible schedule to accommodate a global team will be required.

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science or related technical discipline

- Minimum 3 years of experience with a global enterprise-level service.

- 3 years of experience with Microsoft 365 management and administration

- Must be legally authorized to work in the United States

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS

- Working with Managed Service Providers

- The ideal candidate will have a skill-set that includes a wide breadth of infrastructure related technologies.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- User-centric design thinking.

- Communicate with both technical and non-technical audiences

- Ability to troubleshoot complex problems

- Strong customer service skills, attention to detail, sense of urgency, and the ability to offer guidance and mentorship to junior team members

- Excellent interpersonal skills and a “can do” attitude in a team environment

- Self-motivated, self-directed person

- Ability to work with and support a globally dispersed team

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills – evaluates information/data to make decisions; anticipates obstacles and develops plans to resolve; creates actionable operational plans and involves others as needed

- Design Thinking

- Demonstrated interest in applying generative AI and agentic AI tools, including ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot, to business and technology workflows.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform, Azure Automation and automation/agent development tools.

- Service Strategy and Product Strategy

 JOB REQUIREMENTS

- Full-time

- Remote work is available once a week for eligible employees

- This role is not eligible for domestic relocation

 BENEFITS AND PERKS

SC Johnson’s total compensation packages are at or above industry levels. In addition to salary, total packages may include bonuses, long-term incentives, matching 401(k) contributions and profit sharing based on company profitability, job level and years of service. As a family company, we’re committed to providing benefits such as subsidized health care plans, maternity/paternity/adoption leave, flexible work arrangements, vacation purchase options, recreation and fitness centers, childcare, counseling services and more.

 Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion .

 Better Together

¿Te gustaría formar parte de un proyecto donde la gestión eficiente de la tecnología y la experiencia digital de los usuarios sean clave para el negocio?

El puesto combina trabajo en oficina con presencia en las instalaciones del cliente, manteniendo una interlocución cercana con usuarios y diferentes áreas técnicas.

This is your chance to thrive in a "Customer Success, First and Always" environment that prizes continuous learning and radical ownership. You will collaborate within an international network of expertise across 39 delivery centers worldwide, gaining exposure to complex engineering challenges that redefine industrial standards. jobs.description:
**About Us**

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team who scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ ARR and secured over $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely. We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.

**Your role**

This is not a config-and-tickets DevOps role. We're looking for someone who treats infrastructure as a programming problem: writing real software (in Go) to automate, scale, and harden the systems that run a security-critical platform.

- Own best practices for managing production infrastructure, including provisioning, application scaling, configuration management, capacity planning, and monitoring
- Build and maintain our Kubernetes infrastructure at scale, along with the Terraform-provisioned cloud resources that sit underneath it
- Write custom automation and tooling in Go to reduce manual work and eliminate entire classes of operational risk
- Build infrastructure to manage and deploy applications in secure enclaves
- Design thoughtful deployment processes that reduce the risks inherent in the software development lifecycle
- Improve operations across our infrastructure and systems, including deployment, logging, monitoring, and alerting
- Assist in scaling out a world-class engineering team

**What we're looking for**

- Strong multi-cloud infrastructure experience, AWS strongly preferred
- Real programming ability in Go. You should be comfortable writing production software, not just scripts or configuration
- Hands-on experience running Kubernetes at scale and managing infrastructure as code with Terraform
- A learning mindset and high agency. We care more about how fast you pick things up and how much ownership you take than about years of experience on paper
- An understanding of modern application architectures, with opinions on how they should be developed and deployed
- Experience working in extremely security conscious environments
- A healthy amount of paranoia :)
- People who think Web3/cryptocurrency has the potential to radically change the world for the better, and a sincere desire to help facilitate that change
- Based in the US

**Style points**

- Experience with trusted execution environments, secure enclaves, hardware security modules, or other attestable compute environments
- A deep understanding of Linux and how to reduce the surface area of applications deployed on top of it
- Expertise in threshold signing systems and a desire to stay on the cutting edge of production-grade cryptography
- Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it's going

**What We Offer**

- Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k)
- Paid parental leave
- Unlimited PTO
- $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences
- Multiple team offsites per year
- Lunch stipend

Please note that while the team is remote, we are only considering candidates who are physically based in the United States and Canada at the current time.

_Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply._

Compensation range

$200,000—$240,000 USD

jobs.title: Staff / Senior Physical Security Systems Engineer
jobs.summary: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers,...
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

Data Center Security Engineering (DCSE) secures Anthropic's data center footprint; this role covers how the sites are designed and built to be secure. Much of that footprint is designed and built with partners, so a site's security is decided early: in what Anthropic hands the people who build it, and in how rigorously the delivered systems are tested against it.

You'll design and specify the physical security systems for a site: perimeter and vehicle barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting, and the site penetrations and utility entry points that bypass them. Design firms and integrators produce the site drawings and install; you specify, review, and verify. You'll write the performance requirement and verification method behind each control, review every site design against them at each stage with redlines a design team can act on, test in the field that what was built performs as specified, and re-verify post-acceptance changes.

This is a foundational role. You'll own Anthropic's physical security reference design package (typical details, reference drawings, schedules, and test procedures) in the form partners build from, and keep it current against each site's threat basis and the sites actually being built. You'll set the technical position for a site and decide what applies where; where a requirement can't be met as written, you'll engineer the compensating control and document the deviation. You'll work with the rest of DCSE, with Anthropic's design, construction, and real estate counterparts, and directly with the vendors who build to the package. We use Claude throughout our engineering workflow and expect you to as well.

The same seat covers the team's security operations control rooms. You'll set their design and operational requirements and accept delivered systems against them, working day to day alongside the team's platform engineers, who own the software and compute that run in them.

This role involves regular travel to data center sites. These are critical services, and this role participates in an on-call rotation for them.

 Key responsibilities

-

 Produce a vendor-ready design package for perimeter barriers and hostile vehicle mitigation, intrusion detection and its zoning, video coverage, security lighting matched to camera performance, and penetration protection: performance specifications, typical details and reference drawings, and device and zone schedules, written so a design firm can build to them and a test can prove them

-

 Define the per-site engineering basis: which requirements apply to a site based on its risk profile and the threats it faces, with compensating controls and documented deviations

-

 Write the acceptance criteria and test methods: the verification method behind each requirement and the evidence a site must produce to pass acceptance

-

 Set standoff, structural hardening, and site layout criteria for new designs, tied to the threat basis they derive from

-

 Run field verification: commissioning and acceptance testing of perimeter, detection, video, and lighting against performance criteria (detection coverage tests, photometric measurements, video quality checks)

-

 Write the operational and design requirements for security operations control rooms: console layout, wall versus workstation content, supervisor placement; room network, power, backup, and resilient communications to the team's segmentation and hardening baseline

-

 Own control room acceptance: factory and site acceptance criteria written before the build, then accept or reject delivered systems (video wall, consoles, cabling, fit-out) against them

 Minimum qualifications

-

Have designed or specified physical security systems (perimeter barriers, intrusion detection, video, security lighting) for campus-scale sites: multiple buildings, a secured perimeter, many detection zones

-

Read and produce construction documents (site plans, civil and electrical drawings, device schedules, submittals) using standard design and markup tools such as AutoCAD, Revit, or Bluebeam, and find what is missing as readily as what is wrong

-

Write performance requirements that are testable: each states what must be true, how it will be verified, and what evidence shows it

-

Have run commissioning and acceptance tests against performance criteria and rejected work that did not meet them

-

Derive requirements from a threat basis rather than a product catalog: you can say which adversary a control stops and where the next weakest point is

-

Have owned an engineering domain where you set the approach, chose what applied to each site, worked directly with vendors, and answered for the result

 Preferred qualifications

-

Experience carrying a physical security design from construction documents through construction to acceptance testing

-

Experience engineering the security scope of colocation or partner-delivered facilities

-

Working knowledge of published standards for standoff, hostile vehicle mitigation, and intrusion detection zoning

-

Photometric and video quality measurement experience

-

Control room, AV, or network design experience: console layouts, video wall systems, resilient communications

-

Experience using AI-assisted tooling for drafting and review as a core part of your workflow

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

 $320,000 - $405,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR, TEST OPERATIONS (2ND SHIFT)

SpaceX is looking for a highly skilled and knowledgeable IT Systems Administrator to support the networking, compute administration, and application support needs of our test operations environment. This role will be pivotal to the enablement of safe and sustained test operations cadence, directly supporting our goals of making humanity a multiplanetary species. Candidate must be comfortable working on mission-critical systems with a sense of urgency appropriate to the responsibilities while maintaining attention to detail and operational excellence.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Augment and deploy new IT infrastructure, including networking, server, and desktop hardware directly supporting mission critical networks across the country.

- Perform periodic systems upgrades and patches in between critical operations, sometimes on weekends and evenings.

- Monitor IT services and respond aggressively to incidents to maintain systems performance.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to proactively identify and resolve potential technical issues with systems deployments.

- Author and maintain documentation for IT systems, from systems overview documents and design drawings to procedures.

- Leverage automation tools and contribute to IT systems engineering efforts.

- Ensure that systems are configured and maintained in compliance with industry and cybersecurity standards (e.g. ITAR, ISO, NIST).

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

- 3+ years of experience in IT systems administration.

- Hands-on experience with Linux or Windows server administration.

- Experience with enterprise network administration and deployment.

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Working knowledge of network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, SNMP, NTP, PTP etc), firewalls administration and cybersecurity technologies.

- Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Powershell/Python) and automation frameworks (Terraform, Ansible, Puppet).

- Familiarity with Active Directory and multi-platform authentication/identification environments.

- Experience with virtualization platforms and tools.

- Understanding of Layer 1 configuration best practices and multiplexing technologies.

- Working knowledge, including the ability to setup, configure, upgrade, manage, and troubleshoot, Windows-based systems and services (i.e. SCCM, Active Directory).

- Exposure to real-time systems and industrial telemetry networks.

- Experience with configuration management, provisioning, infrastructure as code, and other DevOps concepts and tools.

- Excellent communications skills with the ability to communicate with internal/external customers, vendors, management etc. in both formal and informal situations.

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Ability to pass Air Force background checks for Cape Canaveral and Vandenberg.

- Must have valid driver's license.

- Ability to lift up to 30lbs.

- Ability to work at heights.

- Willing to be on after-hours on-call rotation.

- Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

- Must be available for the second shift beginning at 1:30pm.

 ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

jobs.description:
GadellNet Consulting Services is a rapidly growing IT company based in the Midwest, providing technical solutions to hundreds of businesses across various markets. We are a family-friendly company and an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a creative, growth-oriented, and progressive work environment.

We believe that diverse perspectives strengthen our team and drive innovation, and we are intentional about creating an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their full selves to work.

As a Certified B Corporation, we are committed to considering the impact of our decisions on our employees, customers, suppliers, community, and environment. Join us in powering the missions of our team and our clients while making a difference in our communities. We encourage candidates to review our website to learn more about our values and company culture.

About the Position:

GadellNet is looking for skilled and motivated Technical Support Engineers to deliver outstanding customer service and technical expertise through our help desk. You’ll work closely with your PODS team, to field service requests through chat, phone calls and our ticket system to resolve technical issues and ensure an excellent client experience. We are looking for technically competent problem solvers who insist upon excellence from themselves and are great at following processes and procedures to drive efficiency.

GadellNet serves businesses in multiple markets with outsourced technical know-how. Our values -- Make an Impact, 100% Responsibility 0% Excuses, and Grow or Die -- drive every decision we make.

Responsibilities:

All System Engineers are responsible for the following tasks:

Maintain, troubleshoot, and upgrade computer, server, and network infrastructure across client environments. Provide advanced technical support and exceptional customer service to clients via phone, email, and chat (Thread). Collaborate with clients to resolve issues, fulfill service requests, and implement technical solutions. Resolve complex or escalated technical issues from Service Desk Engineers. Mentor and assist Service Desk Engineers with technical challenges and troubleshooting. Support Onsite Engineers by providing advanced technical assistance when needed. Maintain, create, and update documentation, including configurations, procedures, and knowledge base articles, to ensure accuracy and consistency. Review and manage assigned support tickets daily, ensuring progress toward resolution in alignment with GadellNet’s Manage to Zero (MTZ) concept. Accurately manage ConnectWise Calendar to reflect appointments, work time, meetings, and breaks. Complete daily time entry totaling at least 8 hours per day. Attend and participate in weekly team huddles, one-on-one meetings with your Lead, and other scheduled meetings. Participate in an on-call rotation as scheduled. Meet or exceed quarterly KPIs such as tickets closed per week, average time per ticket, and CSAT scores. Actively pursue and maintain relevant technical certifications, demonstrating commitment to GadellNet’s “Grow or Die” value. Work in a hybrid model, combining remote work with required in-office days for those located near a GadellNet office.

Requirements:

At least 3 years of experience working as a System Engineer. (MSP experience preferred) and/or degree in the field of computer science. At least 3 years of experience utilizing, troubleshooting, researching, and/or fixing the following: Desktop systems up to Windows 11Server systems up to Windows Server 2025Managing Office 365 products or supporting Google G Suite and/or Microsoft Exchange on-premises/Cloud

Microsoft 365 Admin CenterEntra/ADExchangeSharePointIntuneTeamsLicensingMicrosoft Office SuiteSupporting Azure hosting and Azure ADMicrosoft Hyper-V and VMware vSphereAndroid and iOS devicesPrinters/ScannersExperience with VoIP Systems (ex: Teams Phone, 3CX, RingCentral, Dialpad)Deploying and supporting network storage (SAN/NAS)Proficient in networking, which includes experience with a wide variety of firewalls, switches, (Meraki, Fortinet, SonicWall, Aruba) VPNs (client and site-to-site) and ISPsServer hardware and software that includes, but is not limited to, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, RAIDExcellent verbal and written communication skills with a focus on clear technical explanations, active listening, and rapport-building. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills with keen attention to detail. Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple tasks and inbound requests in a fast-paced environment. Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment. Ability to work both from a schedule and autonomously. Ability to conduct research into a wide range of computing issues. Ability to present ideas in a user-friendly, business-friendly manner.

Desirable Skills:Proficient in the use of:ConnectWiseDattoRMMITGlueAuvikThreadMacOS 13 Ventura and aboveSupporting backup and disaster recovery solutionsExperience with scripting or automationCertifications such as CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, or equivalent vendor certifications

Values:

GadellNet serves businesses in multiple markets with outsourced technical expertise. We are poised for continued growth and looking for team players excited to power missions through technology. At GadellNet, our core values guide our decision-making processes, the overall empowerment of our employees, and the assignment of responsibility within our teams.

Our team members support the values and goals of GadellNet, which fosters a one-of-a-kind service experience for our clients and establishes a culture that attracts and retains the top talent available in our markets.

At GadellNet, we live and celebrate our three core values:

Make an Impact100% Responsibility 0% ExcusesGrow or Die

Benefits:

GadellNet also offers the following benefits

Health, vision, and dental insurancePaid time off, including parental leave and volunteer time. Flexible work environment Access to mental health servicesEmployee matching donation program401k and employer matching

Eligibility to work in the US: GadellNet does not offer work visa sponsorship for this role. All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application. Employment is contingent on verification of identity and eligibility to work in the United States.

Recognized as Social Media/Influencer Agency of the Year, and as the annual partner for Forbes Top Creators List, Influential sits at the center of culture and the creator economy.

Through our platform Captiv8, the industry’s #1 ranked influencer marketing platform, we combine deep API integrations, advanced AI, and machine learning with human expertise to connect brands with a network of more than 15 million creators worldwide.

Our work powers award-winning campaigns across Meta, Snap, TikTok, YouTube, and more, partnering with Fortune 500 companies and global organizations to deliver impact across retail foot traffic, in-store sales, online conversions, and TV tune-in.

At Influential, you’ll work with a fast-moving, high-performance team solving complex problems and shaping the future of marketing. You’ll build, grow, and make an impact alongside top talent, leading brands, and the world’s most influential creators.

Ready to join us?

Overview
The Manager, Client Management is responsible for the successful activation of campaigns for a diverse portfolio of Influential's clients. The Manager plays an important role in activating Influential’s ways of working to support successful influencer marketing campaigns. Success in this role requires clear understanding of Influential’s process for campaign activation, strong organizational skills, attention to detail and client service excellence.

Growth & Collaboration
Be a critical listener in client and agency team meetings to help Identify incremental opportunities within existing accountsContribute to inputs needed for Commercial Operations to support profitability tracking and financial health of assigned accounts
Performance & Client Success
Manage campaign performance with limited creator challenges throughout the processSupport the day-to-day management of Specialist in campaign executionDeliver client satisfaction by ensuring high-quality outputs, clear communication, and consistent follow-through
Team Leadership & Development

Qualifications

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Defense, Space, and Security (BDS), Space and Launch Division, seeks an Satellite Systems Engineer - Operations and Systems Analysis (Associate and Expert) supporting the team in Schriever, CO.

Our team develops new global military satellite communications (MILSATCOM) ground systems that manage transmission of protected tactical waveform (a type of secure, anti-jam communication) over Boeing-built Wideband Global SATCOM (WGS) satellites and terminals. Space and Launch work with proprietary customers and creates next generation technologies in space. We work all facets of engineering: technology investment, concept development, proposal writing, requirements and design, build, integration, test, and demonstration of products in their relevant environments.

The Satellite Systems Engineer is part of a high-performing team immersed in dynamic satellite operations and engineering activities. As a member of our WGS on-orbit team, you support operations and engineering for 10 on-orbit satellites.

jobs.title: MDM Data Engineer
jobs.summary: About The Role You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer - configure it, connect it, and keep...
jobs.description:
About The Role

You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer - configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.

This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You'll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.

What You'll Do

Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee - ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows - exception queues, match review, and record correction.Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.Monitor MDM pipeline health - match rates, queue depth, golden record lag - and fix issues when they arise.Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.

Must-Have

3+ years with Profisee MDM - you've implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.Strong SQL and Python - you can write and debug pipeline code independently.Profisee integration experience - connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.Match/merge configuration - candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.Cloud environment experience - AWS or Azure.

Nice to Have

Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).Financial services domain knowledge - client data, advisor data, accounts.Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.

You're a Good Fit If

You can configure a Profisee match rule from scratch and explain why you set the thresholds where you did.You've debugged a golden record that wasn't writing back correctly and can walk through how you found the issue.You don't need someone to hand you an architecture diagram before you can ask good questions.

jobs.description:
About Emesent
Emesent is a Brisbane-based world leader in autonomous LiDAR mapping and drone autonomy. Our flagship product, Hovermap, delivers autonomous LiDAR mapping in GPS-denied environments for the Mining and Defence sectors. Our newly launched GX1 brings high-performance handheld LiDAR to surveying and the built environment. Behind both sits a pipeline of future hardware products and a team that takes hard engineering problems from concept to the field.

Role Description
The System Administrator reports to the Director of IT & AI and sits within a small IT team. The role is responsible for the design, operation, security, and continuous improvement of the organisation's corporate IT environment. This spans on-premises and cloud infrastructure, Microsoft and Linux platforms, identity and access management, SaaS integrations, endpoint fleet management, and internal engineering compute clusters.
The role is both hands-on and enabling, keeping day-to-day operations running reliably while helping engineering and business teams adopt new technologies, tools, and workflows safely. The successful candidate will act as a technical escalation point (L2/L3) for the service desk and will contribute to governance, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity initiatives across the business.

Key Responsibilities:
Infrastructure & Operations
Administer Windows Server environments, including Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file and certificate services.
Provide L2/L3 operational support, resolving escalations from the Service Desk and complex infrastructure incidents.
Mentor and support L1/L2 Service Desk staff, building their technical capability.
Prioritise tickets in the infrastructure queue, ensuring incidents and requests are resolved within agreed SLAs.
Administer Microsoft 365, including Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, and Intune.
Manage endpoint provisioning and lifecycle for a globally distributed workforce across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Administer VMware and Linux compute clusters and AWS environments, including capacity planning and performance management.
Maintain VPN infrastructure for remote and on-site personnel.
Administer network configuration for Brisbane HQ and remote sites (switching, routing, firewalls, wireless).
Own DR and business continuity initiatives, including backups, restore testing, and infrastructure resilience.
Enable teams to safely adopt new technologies and workflows, including internally developed tools.
Support the secure adoption and governance of AI tools and services across the business, including access controls, data protection, and integration with existing platforms.

Identity & Access Management
Maintain Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and hybrid identity sync.
Improve access management through Entra ID integrations with SaaS platforms and AWS (SAML/OIDC/SCIM), including automated provisioning and deprovisioning.
Implement least-privilege RBAC and manage the joiner/mover/leaver process; conduct periodic access reviews.

Cybersecurity
Enforce endpoint security policies across Windows, macOS, and Linux using Intune, Defender, and equivalent tooling.
Own patch management and vulnerability management across servers, endpoints, and network devices.
Maintain firewalls, email security (DMARC/DKIM/SPF), web filtering, and endpoint detection and response.
Monitor security alerts, investigate and contain incidents, and support penetration test remediation.
Harden systems against recognised baselines (CIS, Microsoft baselines, ASD Essential Eight).
Support cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance initiatives.

Governance
Maintain documentation, network topology, and the asset register.
Operate and improve change management, including risk assessment, approvals, and rollback planning.
Contribute to IT policies and standards and support audits and compliance.
Track licensing compliance, maintain the IT risk register, and contribute to DR/BC planning (RTO/RPO, DR exercises).
Contribute to and uphold the organisation’s AI policy.

Skills & Experience
5+ years in systems administration within a mixed Windows/Linux enterprise environment.
Windows Server, Active Directory, and Microsoft Entra ID, including Group Policy, DNS/DHCP, certificate services, Conditional Access, MFA, and hybrid identity.
Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Intune.
Linux administration (Ubuntu and/or RHEL-based).
VMware vSphere/ESXi and AWS, including cluster and capacity management.
Networking and network security: TCP/IP, VLANs, routing, switching, firewalls, enterprise Wi-Fi, VPN.
Scripting and automation in PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining technical issues and risks to non-technical stakeholders.
Strong documentation discipline: runbooks, network diagrams, change records.
Strong understanding of AI tools and their security, privacy, and data governance implications.

Desirable
Relevant certifications, such as Microsoft (AZ-104, SC-300), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, or RHCSA.
Experience applying security baselines (CIS, Microsoft, ASD Essential Eight) in a compliance or audit context.
Experience supporting engineering or HPC compute environments.

The Perks
9-day fortnight — every second Friday off.
Employee Share Option Plan (ESOP) — share in Emesent's success.
Genuine learning and development opportunities, including LinkedIn Learning.
Flexible working arrangements and a casual dress code.
Employee Assistance Program and Qoctor online telehealth.
A full day of leave each year for your work anniversary.

Who we are
Emesent builds LiDAR mapping and autonomy technology for the world's most challenging environments. Founded in 2018 from Australia's CSIRO, our products — Hovermap, GX1, and the Aura software platform — capture spatial data in hazardous, GPS-denied, and hard-to-reach places for mining, survey, and infrastructure customers worldwide. With multiple product lines spanning hardware, desktop, and cloud, we're at an inflection point — and this role sits at the technical heart of it.

jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Join the Growing Solutions Engineering Team!

Solutions Engineers (SEs) at Okta play a pivotal role in the customer journey, helping organizations solve complex identity challenges. We engage with customers at every stage, combining our technical curiosity with business insight to drive meaningful conversations. We’re looking for team players who can create impactful sales presentations, build compelling product demonstrations, and educate a wide audience on modern cloud security solutions.

If you have a strong background in technology, a mindset of continuous learning, and a passion for customer engagement, this role is for you.

 What You’ll be doing:

- Support customers throughout the sales journey (discovery, validation, proposal, due diligence), demonstrating the value of the Okta Platform through live demos and presentations.

- Communicate with stakeholders at all levels of the customer's organization, including CxO, security, developers, Product Managers, and IT administrators.

- Bridge the gap between business and technology for diverse audiences, from security engineers and developers to CISOs and CIOs.

- Partner with the sales team as the go-to technical counterpart, enabling customers to validate the value and potential of the Okta platform.

- Focus on our Okta Workforce Identity solutions, confidently addressing product features and in-depth technical inquiries from customers.

- Design and execute well-defined, outcome-driven Proof of Concepts (POCs).

- Develop a growing understanding of the Okta product line and the underlying technologies and protocols.

- Stay curious, and continuously grow your knowledge in Identity, Security, and more.

- Occasionally, participate in local and regional events, representing Okta as both a speaker and an attendee.

- Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to provide direct customer feedback and influence product roadmaps.

 What we’re looking for:

- 5+ years of pre-sales engineering experience or a similar customer-facing technical role (e.g., consulting, professional services).

jobs.description:
LightGrid is hiring an Endpoint Security Administrator.

Demonstrate a deep understanding of endpoint security generally (EDR, Anti-malware, GTI, etc.) and Trellix Policy orchestrator (ePO) specifically (on-site and cloud based).

• Build, configure, and maintain communication channels between different Cybersecurity technology platforms utilizing industry standards (pxGrid, APIs, SAML, Okta, ODBC, and others).

• Demonstrate intermediate Systems Administrator experience across Microsoft and Linux operating systems.

• Parse raw syslog, packet capture, and other system logging data.

• Understand network subnetting.

• Respond to incident tickets in accordance with established SLAs.

• Collaborate across AORs and business groups regarding endpoint security settings, posture, and troubleshooting.

• Participate in Incident Response activities as needed.

• Author, update, edit, and maintain documentation related to endpoint security posture within Agency.

Background and Education Required

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, or related discipline (or equivalent experience).

Must be compliant with DoD 8140 Cyber Workforce Qualification Program; preferred certifications include CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or other relevant cybersecurity certification maintained throughout the employment period.

Minimum 3 years’ experience in incident response, cybersecurity operations, or systems administration involving recovery planning, preferably for DoD or federal agencies.

Intermediate Systems Administrator experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting across both Microsoft and Linux operating systems.

• Deep understanding and practical experience with endpoint security tools (EDR, Anti-malware, GTI), with specific expertise in managing Microsoft Defender for both on-site and cloud-based environments.

• Demonstrated ability to build, configure, and maintain communication channels across diverse cybersecurity platforms using industry-standard protocols such as pxGrid, APIs, SAML, Okta, and ODBC.

• Strong capability to parse and analyze raw syslog, packet captures, and system logging data, coupled with a solid understanding of network subnetting for troubleshooting and security posture analysis.

• Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and maintaining Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools (including removable media control) and application whitelisting rules for Windows and *NIX environments.

• Experience tracking, maintaining, and reporting on endpoint security compliance to ensure adherence to DoD and Agency requirements (including STIGs, TASKORDs, and CTOs), while navigating change and exception management processes

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a cross-functional cyber response team; may coordinate activities with other analysts. · Exercise sound judgment and report/escalate issues clearly and promptly.

• Strong written and verbal communication with ability to document technical activities and procedures, brief government staff, and work with multidisciplinary teams.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a EUC Modern Workplace Engineer based in Brazil.

Your expertise will help maintain secure, reliable, and high-performing endpoint environments for users across multiple regions.
You will investigate complex incidents, automate operational processes, and contribute to continuous service improvement.
The role involves close collaboration with service desk, security, infrastructure, application, and external vendor teams.
You will also contribute to Windows 11 readiness, device lifecycle initiatives, and the ongoing modernization of the digital workplace.

Administer and maintain enterprise endpoint devices and configurations through Microsoft Intune.

Manage configuration and compliance policies, device targeting, reporting, and advanced troubleshooting.

Manage Windows Autopilot processes, including device registration, deployment profiles, pre-provisioning, and build validation.

Administer Microsoft Configuration Manager environments, including clients, deployments, collections, and content distribution.

Package, test, and deploy applications through Intune and MECM, including Win32 Apps, MSI/MSIX, and PSAppDeploy.

Develop and use PowerShell scripts for automation, remediation, reporting, and operational support.

Plan, execute, and monitor Windows and application update and patching processes.

Investigate and resolve complex incidents through advanced troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

Work within Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes aligned with ITIL practices.

Support endpoint provisioning, configuration, compliance, and security at scale.

Collaborate with Service Desk, Security, Infrastructure, Applications, and external suppliers.

Create and maintain technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge-base articles.

Contribute to endpoint automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Support device lifecycle management, Windows 11 preparation, and initiatives designed to improve the end-user experience.

Strong experience troubleshooting Windows endpoints, including operating systems, drivers, connectivity, authentication, performance, and application deployment.

Hands-on experience with Windows Autopilot and device provisioning and deployment processes.

Experience packaging and distributing applications through Intune and/or MECM.

Working knowledge of PowerShell for automation, troubleshooting, remediation, and operational support.

Experience managing Windows updates and patching processes.

Knowledge of Active Directory, Entra ID/Azure AD, Group Policy, and hybrid environments.

Knowledge of endpoint security technologies and practices, including BitLocker, security baselines, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

Experience deploying, updating, and troubleshooting Microsoft 365 Apps.

Experience working with Incident, Problem, and Change Management processes.

Ability to perform root-cause analysis and develop permanent solutions for recurring technical issues.

Strong technical documentation and runbook-writing skills.

Advanced English proficiency, with the ability to communicate effectively in a global and multicultural environment.

Microsoft certifications related to Endpoint, Modern Desktop, or related technologies are a plus.

ITIL certification or knowledge is a plus.

Familiarity with Microsoft Graph, workflow automation, APIs, Log Analytics, and KQL is advantageous.

Experience with Nexthink, CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager, or similar endpoint management and monitoring technologies is advantageous.

Experience working with Microsoft, hardware manufacturers, and third-party technology providers is a plus.

Knowledge of global endpoint lifecycle management and Windows 11 migration or preparation processes is desirable.

Flexible working hours within a 40-hour workweek.

Mobility allowance.

Professional development tracks with funding for courses and learning opportunities.

Access to a free learning platform with a wide range of self-learning courses.

Private English lessons.

Birthday day off.

Employee recognition program with opportunities to give and receive rewards.

Collaborative, respectful, and multicultural working environment.

Exposure to international projects and teams.

Opportunities for continuous learning, professional growth, and technical development.
