jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include **evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts** , depending on the regions being supported.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues.
* Support application lifecycle management and software maintenance.

**Testing \& Continuous Improvement**

* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments and testing activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation, and service optimization initiatives.

**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues and standard solutions.
* Support knowledge sharing within the Endpoint Management team.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Fluent **English**(C1 or C2)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individually tailored student mentoring
* Make valuable contacts within Drees \& Sommer and expand your professional network
* Modern workplace and equipment; Teams meetings and participation in corporate workshops
* Receive compensation that gives you financial independence during your studies

Position Overview:

We are looking for a dedicated Endpoint Engineer to join our client's technology team as an embedded, full-time engineering resource. * Ability to work independently as an embedded team member

jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is where millions of people hang out every day - 90% of them play games, spending over 5 billion hours across thousands of titles each month. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our Client Platform Data Science team, where you’ll help make sure that Discord just works. You’ll partner with the teams that design, build, and support Discord - improving app performance, enhancing the user experience, and driving growth. Your work will span strategic analyses, experimentation, and dashboarding. Specifically, we’re looking for someone who can help us take Discord’s mobile and desktop reliability to the next level through better metrics, monitoring, and automation.

If you’re passionate about data and want to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

 What you'll be doing

- Partner with teams throughout Discord through the full analytics lifecycle - from exploratory analyses to dashboards, reports, and A/B testing

- Define KPIs and diagnostic metrics that improve the user experience, and build dashboards to make them timely and actionable

- Build custom datasets to monitor novel product features and processes

- Share insights with technical and non-technical audiences, and iterate based on feedback

- Champion A/B testing best practices - helping teams design, analyze, and interpret experiments correctly

- Collaborate with data and engineering teams to design scalable and future-proof instrumentation and self-serve tooling

 What you should have

- 2+ years of hands-on analytics experience turning ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable insights

- Experience designing, analyzing, and interpreting A/B tests at scale

- Strong SQL skills and experience building clean, performant dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar)

- Clear communication skills, with the ability to make complex findings easy to understand

- Curiosity, a collaborative attitude, and a drive to solve hard problems

 Bonus Points

- Passion for Discord or online communities

- Experience with performance/reliability analytics for online services

- Familiarity with social or subscription products (social graphs, LTV, funnel analysis)

- Production ETL or BigQuery experience

- Experience using AI in data science work

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $160,000 to $200,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

 Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

### **About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Professional Services Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will work closely with clients to understand their unique technical requirements, diagnose issues, and provide effective solutions. Your ability to dive into log files, troubleshoot complex problems, and debug issues will be essential in delivering exceptional consulting services. By leveraging your technical expertise and industry knowledge, you will ensure successful implementation, configuration, and integration of our product, while providing training and support to enable clients to maximize the value of our solution.

### **What You'll Do**

- Take charge of the implementation and configuration process, ensuring the seamless integration and successful deployment of Cyberhaven’s solution within clients’ existing environments.

- Foster close collaboration with clients to gain a deep understanding of their technical requirements, diagnose issues, and create customized dataset and policy solutions.

- Utilize log file analysis, debugging techniques, and advanced troubleshooting to identify underlying causes of complex technical problems and coordinate effective resolutions with our Support, Engineering, and Operations teams.

- Work in close partnership with cross-functional teams, including developers, project managers, and support staff, to deliver high-quality solutions that adhere to timelines.

- Deliver technical training to end users, empowering them with the necessary knowledge and skills to maximize the utilization of Cyberhaven to optimize their workflows and expedite ROI.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, offering strategic guidance, best practices, and insights to help them derive the maximum value from our product.

- Conduct regular progress updates, status meetings, and post-implementation reviews with clients to ensure their satisfaction or identify areas for improvement, serving as the internal and external point of contact for client escalations.

- Collaborate with the development and support teams, promptly escalating and resolving technical issues or system discrepancies to maintain smooth operations for clients.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in our product offerings, continuously enhancing your technical expertise to provide valuable insights and guidance to clients.

### **Who You Are**

- 3+ years of Solutions Engineer, Delivery Manager, or Professional Services with Endpoint Security experience required in the Cybersecurity and DLP Space:

  - Proven track record of delivering complex technical solutions, preferably in a Professional Services or Consulting role, specifically with endpoint security products.

  - Previous experience with other DLP solutions such as Forcepoint, Symantec, McAfee DLP, Fortra (Digital Guardian), Trend Micro, Check Point, Next DLP, or Proofpoint.

  - Understanding of data classification methodologies and techniques to effectively identify sensitive data types and define appropriate DLP policies.
- Project Management: Ability to manage and deliver against strict timelines, requiring constant prioritization and mitigation strategy-building.

- Deep technical background, with hands-on experience in supporting and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.

  - Software debugging skills

  - Knowledge of web technologies, APIs, and data integration techniques.

  - Solid understanding of system architecture, network protocols, and Google Cloud Platform.

  - Practical knowledge of the MacOS (e.g., MDM, app management, basic terminal skills) and Windows (SCCM, GPO, Intune, registry configuration, understanding PowerShell scripts, etc.) ecosystems.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, allowing one to easily convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders and build relationships cross-functionally.

- Knowledge of system software design (services, drivers, agents).

- Education and Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent advanced industry certifications, or 3+ years of experience in a similar role.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.

Collins Aerospace is a leader in technologically advanced, intelligent solutions that help redefine the aerospace and defense industry. With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

The System Solutions team is seeking a Senior Principal Systems Engineer to lead the definition, development and evolution of complex aerospace systems through strong systems engineering and architectural expertise. This role will own system architecture decisions, establish technical direction and provide technical leadership across engineering teams to enable the successful implementation and adoption of system solutions.

The ideal candidate will bring deep systems engineering expertise and hands-on experience across system architecture, requirements management, engineering automation, verification, validation and aerospace certification processes. The candidate will translate complex technical and business needs into scalable system architectures, establish engineering approaches and best practices, and provide technical guidance across multiple stakeholders and engineering disciplines.

Experience with DevSecOps frameworks, aerospace development standards such as ARP4754, Digital Engineering and Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) is highly desirable. Experience applying these practices to modernize and automate systems engineering processes is especially valuable.

If you are passionate about advancing systems engineering through automation, collaboration and innovative technologies, we encourage you to apply.

This is a hybrid position based in Cedar Rapids, Iowa.

What You Will Do:

MBSE Strategy and Development:

Lead the systems engineering team through all phases of system product development including stakeholder’s requirements capture, behavioral analysis, system architecture design, system verification, system validation and life-cycle product support.Lead the definition, development, and execution of the System Solutions strategy and roadmap for System Solutions.Provide technical leadership and guidance to engineering teams to enable effective adoption, continuous improvement and support to programs across different business units.

Collaboration and Coordination:

Support coordination with System Method Representatives and System Discipline Boards by providing technical inputs, aligning priorities, and ensuring system engineering needs are represented.Support external stakeholder collaboration, such as with the Digital Product Lifecycle (DPLC) Technical Advisory Board, through alignment and dependency meetings and collaboration on System capabilities and initiatives.Work closely with System Solutions teams and the System Program Manager to coordinate dependencies, enable knowledge transfer across teams. Provide technical inputs, status, risks and recommendations.

Additional Responsibilities:

Support proposal and business development activities leveraging System engineering methodologies and automation practices.Mentor and train junior systems engineers, ensuring the long-term growth of expertise within System Solutions team. Travel up to 15% as needed to support program and collaboration efforts.

Qualifications You Must Have:

Typically requires a degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics (STEM) and minimum 10 years prior relevant experience or an Advanced Degree in a related field and minimum 7 years of experienceExperience in multiple areas of the systems engineering lifecycle, including requirements development, design, integration, verification, validation, and technical documentation. Ideal candidate will have experience across the full development lifecycle for civil certification programs.Hands-on experience applying ARP4754 throughout the system development lifecycle.Experience with requirements management tools (Jama, Polarion, DOORS)Experience/Interest in Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) principles and tools such as Cameo/MagicDraw/Teamwork Cloud and SysML modeling.Experience or familiarity with emerging technologies, including computer vision, machine learning and/or optical character recognition.Experience or familiarity with DevSecOps framework.Experience or familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.Experience with Git or other version control systems.Experience working in aerospace or another highly regulated engineering environment.Experience working in a configuration-controlled environment, including problem reports and change requests.Ability to work within Eastern Time Zone core and global teams, including India Standard Time.
Qualifications We Prefer:

Experience developing automation with scripting languages (Python, Bash, PowerShell) and thoroughly test implementations.Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work through complex technical issues.Strong communication skills, with the ability to work with internal teams, external suppliers and stakeholders.Practical project management capability, including the ability to manage complex projects, multiple stakeholders and the definition of common technical processes.Ability to collaborate across teams.

•Teladoc Medical Experts, second opinion program

• And more!

Eligible for relocation

Learn More & Apply Now!

Job Summary

As a Level 3 SCCM OSD Imaging Engineer, you will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-wide Operating System Deployment (OSD) solutions using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM). You will be responsible for advanced troubleshooting, automation, and integration with modern endpoint management platforms such as Intune and Autopilot.

OSD & Imaging:

 Design and maintain SCCM task sequences for Windows 10/11 deployments. Manage PXE boot, WDS, MDT, and driver packages. Create and maintain gold images using DISM and MDT. Automate imaging workflows using PowerShell and other scripting tools.

Infrastructure Management

 Maintain SCCM infrastructure: site servers, distribution points, boundaries. Monitor and optimize SCCM health and performance. Implement and manage compliance baselines and application deployments.

Modern Endpoint Integration

 Support co-management scenarios with Intune and Autopilot. Ensure seamless integration between SCCM and cloud-based endpoint solutions.

Security & Compliance

 Ensure all images and deployments meet security and compliance standards. Collaborate with security teams to implement CIS benchmarks and patching policies.

Documentation & Collaboration

 Maintain detailed documentation of imaging processes and SCCM configurations. Provide mentorship and technical guidance to Level 1 and Level 2 engineers. Collaborate with desktop support, networking, and security teams.

Required Qualifications

 6+ years of experience with SCCM/MECM in enterprise environments. Expert-level knowledge of OSD, PXE, MDT, WDS, DISM, and driver management. Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, VBScript, and Batch. Experience with Windows Autopilot and Intune. Experience in Windows 11 Migration Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills. Strong communication and documentation abilities.

 Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate Compulsory SCCM certifications Desired ITIL v3

 Excellent communication and conversation skills (Verbal and Written) Good documentation skills

The New York office of a law firm is seeking a Cloud Delivery Engineer to lead the design, implementation, and ongoing delivery of Cloud services with Microsoft Intune, Exchange Online, Entra ID. This role owns the design, implementation, and ongoing optimization of Intune MDM/MAM, Exchange Online, Entra ID Conditional Access, and mobile security controls. Willkie is an elite international law firm of approximately 1,300 lawyers located in 16 offices in six countries.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the design and implementation of Intune policies tied to MAM and MDM for BYOD and Corporate Devices

• Design, implement, and manage Microsoft Intune for iOS/iPadOS and Android Enterprise

• Define and enforce mobile data protection controls through Intune App Protection Policies and Devices Restrictions

o Manage data sharing access between managed apps

• Implement and maintain device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines aligned to the firm’s security and regulatory requirements.

• Act as the escalation point for Mobile Intune Applications, MAM, and Conditional Access issues, Exchange Online

• Must be comfortable with other Azure services that directly affect Mobile devices Authentication, Authorization, Application Deployment and Exchange Online Connectivity

o Conditional Access Policies

o Azure App Proxy

o Azure VPN for iOS and Android

o Entra Sign-in Logs

o Define and troubleshoot Entra Conditional Access Policies

o Multifactor Authentication and Certificate Base Authentication

o Entra application registrations

• Have a solid understanding of Exchange Online, including mail flow, security, and coexistence with any on-premises or legacy systems

o On-premises to Exchange Online Migration

• High level of comfort with Entra ID (Azure AD) identity services, including MFA, SSO, application registrations, access governance, and privileged identity management.

• Work closely with Information Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to ensure Microsoft 365 and Azure services support client obligations, including confidentiality and data residency.

• Comfortable with Microsoft Defender solutions (Endpoint, Office 365) as part of the firm’s security posture.

• Lead or act as senior engineer on global projects involving Microsoft 365, Intune, and related infrastructure.

• Develop and maintain technical standards, documentation, diagrams, and runbooks for operational teams.

• Provide escalation support for complex incidents and problems related to Microsoft 365, Intune, and Azure services.

• Mentor junior engineers and service desk analysts, sharing knowledge and best practices.

• Monitor platform health, performance, and capacity; recommend and implement improvements for availability, resilience, and cost optimization.

• Stay current with the Microsoft roadmap; assess new features and changes and lead their adoption within the firm where appropriate.

• Perform additional tasks as needed.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or equivalent field required.

• 5 - 7 years of experience required.

• Microsoft certifications are highly desirable.

• Extensive hands-on experience administering large enterprise Microsoft 365 tenants, including Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint/OneDrive, and Entra ID (Azure AD).

• Proven experience building and managing Intune-based endpoint management at scale, including Autopilot, app deployment, and cross-platform device management.

• Strong expertise in Conditional Access, App Protection Policies, and compliance policies for secure hybrid/BYOD access.

• Solid understanding of security and compliance features in Microsoft Defender solutions.

• Proficient in PowerShell scripting and automation for Microsoft 365 and Azure.

• Experience working in a law firm or similarly regulated environment strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical projects, manage stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a global organization.

APPLY NOW!

Job Type & LocationThis is a Permanent position based out of New York, NY.

Pay and BenefitsThe pay range for this position is $150000.00 - $180000.00/yr.

 Individual compensation offered for this position within this range will depend on many factors, including qualifications, skills, relevant experience, job knowledge, geographic location, internal equity, and other pertinent job-related factors.

Health Insurance, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off, 401k, Company Defined Contribution

jobs.description:
Job Description

 Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

 The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

 Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance. Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management. Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems. Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues. Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party. Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team. Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

 Identity resolution and matching

 Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches. Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization. Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

 Golden record and survivorship

 Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage. Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production. Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

 Party and relationship data modeling

 Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data. Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid. Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

 Data quality and stewardship

 Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication. Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient. Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

 Integration and pipelines

 Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems. Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency. Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

 Cloud data platform

 Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold. Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

 Graph engineering

 Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier. Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

 Programming and platforms

 Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services. Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product. Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

 Security, governance, and regulatory

 Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship. Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately. Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed. Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background. Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept. Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity. Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity. Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination. AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master. Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo). A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

 Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

 MDM platforms

 Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials. Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner). Ataccama ONE certification. Profisee certification, particularly for teams on the Microsoft and Azure stack.

 Cloud, data platform, and graph

 Microsoft Azure: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert, given our Azure-preferred stack. Databricks or Snowflake certification where the client stacks calls for it. Neo4j Certified Professional, or an equivalent graph credential, for the relationship graph work.

 Governance and adjacent

 Data governance or quality credentials such as Collibra Ranger, or the DAMA CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional). A recognized cloud security or privacy certification is a plus given the regulated setting.

jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

In this high-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline.

This is a high-leverage "build-the-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

Your ImpactDefine the Platform Architecture: Architect a high-performance, modular core for networking, crypto, configuration, and telemetry that sibling products configure rather than rebuild.Establish Secure Seams & Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms.Systemic Quality & Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least-privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates.Pioneer AI-Native Workflows & Supportability: Integrate AI-driven software analysis, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines while driving unified crash analytics and product telemetry to maintain a world-class Crash-Free SLO across millions of active enterprise endpoints.Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners.

Qualifications

Minimum QualificationsSeasoned and accomplished leadership in Endpoint systems development`, core networking, and/or OS-level software development.Cross-Product Impact: Track record of defining cross-team architecture that was successfully adopted across multiple product groups.Deep OS Internals: Expert hands-on knowledge in at least two target platforms:Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture.macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code-signing, notarization.Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling.Legacy Refactoring: Proven experience decomposing complex C/C++ codebases into modular, testable components using incremental, safe refactoring patterns.Technical Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to align senior engineers and executives behind complex architectural shifts.Preferred QualificationsHands-on experience with VPN, ZTNA, or SASE client technologies (IPsec/IKEv2, TLS/DTLS, QUIC/MASQUE, split tunneling, posture assessment).Experience shipping multi-platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry-backed observability.Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows (code review, test generation, defect triage).

Job Title: Endpoint Engineer - InTune

Job Category: Information Technology

Time Type: Full time

Minimum Clearance Required to Start: None

Employee Type: Regular

Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%

Type of Travel: Local

* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI seeks an experienced Endpoint Engineer - InTune for a critical role supporting the United States Secret Service (USSS) contract within the Department of Homeland Security. This position strengthens federal IT infrastructure by leading modern endpoint management, cloud integration, and security automation across enterprise systems serving national security missions.

You will be part of a dynamic team of Systems and Desktop Engineers and security specialists, driving the administration and evolution of Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Azure-based endpoint solutions. As a technical leader, you'll bridge on-premises and cloud environments, implementing hybrid identity solutions, automating deployments, and ensuring compliance with federal security standards while maintaining operational excellence.

This role combines hands-on technical engineering (Intune policy management, application deployment, device compliance, scripting automation) with strategic leadership (designing cloud-native solutions, mentoring junior engineers, driving adoption of emerging technologies). Working across endpoint management and server operations teams, you'll ensure adherence to customer SLAs, accelerate deployment cycles through automation, and reduce operational workload by implementing modern cloud-based management solutions.

Responsibilities:

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management -

- Lead Microsoft Intune administration and engineering, including policy creation and management, application deployment, device compliance, and conditional access configurations

- Implement and manage Microsoft Endpoint Manager (Intune + SCCM) for comprehensive endpoint management

- Manage device enrollment, policy management, application deployment, compliance enforcement, and conditional access across the enterprise

- Administer InTune AutoPilot for modern device provisioning and deployment

Hybrid Cloud & Identity Solutions -

- Design and implement hybrid cloud solutions leveraging Azure AD and on-premises Active Directory for seamless identity management

- Utilize Azure Automation and Intune to manage and secure cloud-based and on-premises Windows workstations and servers, ensuring they are patched to correct levels

- Develop and maintain Azure-based system templates and images for rapid deployment

Systems Administration & Engineering -

- Manage and maintain Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 systems and Windows 11 PC images in both Azure and on-premises environments

- Identify, analyze, and resolve system problems with both short-term workarounds and long-term cloud-based solutions

- Perform expertise in MDT and SCCM including capturing images (.WIM), creating packages, advertisements, task sequences, operating system deployment (OSD), and queries

- Support SCCM software packaging and patching across the enterprise

Automation & Scripting -

- Write advanced PowerShell scripts and leverage Azure Functions to automate systems administration tasks across cloud and on-premises environments

- Develop automation solutions to customize configurations and streamline operational tasking

Security & Compliance -

- Design and implement Azure-based security solutions, including Azure Security Center and Azure Sentinel

- Execute IAVA process including CYBERCOM release process, testing, approval, and deployment processes

- Manage Active Directory Security Groups, OUs, DNS, and GPO management to enforce security policies

- Implement and maintain certificate-based authentication and VPN solutions

Leadership & Collaboration -

- Provide guidance and work leadership to less-experienced cloud and systems engineers

- Collaborate across endpoint management and server operations teams to drive automation and cloud-native solutions

- Test and evaluate new/emerging technologies to deliver faster deployments and decreased workload

Qualifications:

Required:

- Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance

- Bachelor's degree + 13 years of applicable experience (equivalencies: 19 years no degree, AA + 15 years, MA + 10 years)

- Minimum 5+ years SCCM experience supporting software packaging and patching

- Minimum 5+ years InTune AutoPilot administration experience

- Strong working knowledge of SCCM and Intune including device enrollment, policy management, application deployment, compliance enforcement, and conditional access

- Solid understanding of VMware vCenter virtualization platform

- Functional understanding of Microsoft SQL Server and Active Directory

- Expertise in MDT and SCCM: capturing images (.WIM), creating packages, advertisements, task sequences, operating system deployment (OSD), and queries

- Solid knowledge of PowerShell scripting to automate tasking and customize configurations

- Expertise with IAVA process including CYBERCOM release process, testing, approval, and deployment processes

- Solid knowledge of Active Directory Security Groups, OUs, DNS, and GPO management

- Solid Windows troubleshooting skills across server and desktop environments

- Strong understanding of networking concepts including VPN and certificate-based authentication

- Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification

- SCCM Certified

Desired:

- ITIL v4 certification

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Manager Specialist

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate

- Additional Autopilot experience beyond baseline requirements

- Cloud services familiarity, particularly Microsoft Azure platform and services

What You Can Expect:

 A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you'll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer's missions and driven by a higher purpose - to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You'll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground - in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. jobs.description:
About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.

Location: Redstone Arsenal, Alabama

Work Type: Full-Time, On-Site

Clearance Requirement: Active DoD Secret clearance required to start

Certification Requirement: DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE)

Position Summary:

The Endpoint Systems Administrator serves as the technical liaison between the Enterprise Patch Management team and Customer Support Technicians. This hands-on technical role drives the identification, tracking, and remediation of Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS) vulnerability findings while supporting endpoint version control and software compliance efforts.

The successful candidate will bridge patching strategy and frontline execution to ensure vulnerabilities are communicated, addressed, documented, and closed efficiently across the enterprise environment. This is an IAT-track technical position, not an IAM role.

 Key Responsibilities

Hunt, triage, and drive remediation of ACAS vulnerability findings across managed endpoints.

Coordinate with the Enterprise Patch Management team to align remediation timelines with established patch cycles.

Serve as the primary liaison between the Patch Management team and Customer Support Technicians for findings requiring local or hands-on action.

Support endpoint version control and software compliance using Tanium or equivalent endpoint-management tools.

Troubleshoot and resolve one-off, nonstandard endpoint issues outside routine patching and vulnerability-remediation workflows.

Track vulnerability status, document remediation actions, and report aging or at-risk findings.

Communicate directly with customers and support technicians to clarify findings, gather system context, and confirm remediation.

Escalate systemic patching, configuration, or compliance gaps to leadership with supporting data.

Support continuous improvement of endpoint vulnerability-management and patch-compliance processes.

Required Qualifications

Two to four years of experience in endpoint systems administration, vulnerability management, or a related information technology role.

Active DoD Secret security clearance.

DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II certification, such as CompTIA Security+ CE.

Working knowledge of vulnerability-scanning and remediation workflows, including ACAS, Nessus, or similar tools.

Solid understanding of patch management concepts, endpoint configuration, and compliance practices.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work directly with customers and technical support personnel.

Ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams with differing priorities and responsibilities.

Ability to work on-site at Redstone Arsenal, Alabama.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Tanium, including Comply, Deploy, Patch, or Connect modules.

Demonstrated ability to independently troubleshoot complex, nonrepeatable endpoint issues rather than relying solely on documented remediation playbooks.

Familiarity with DoD or federal compliance frameworks, including Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and ACAS reporting standards.

Experience supporting customers in a matrixed, enterprise, or customer-facing IT environment.

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.

What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.

Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
Honest - Be Trustworthy. Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
Humble - Be Grounded. Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
Hungry - Be Eager. Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
Hustle - Be Driven. Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

PowerShell (required) Bash/Shell scripting (preferred) Designing and developing automated remediation and self-healing solutionsBuilding integrations using APIs, web services, and automation platforms Integrating Nexthink with ServiceNow, Moveworks or other similar productsEndpoint management, security, and compliance (Intune, SCCM, Jamf, etc.) Microsoft 365 Active Directory / Entra ID

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

As part of our identity verification process, a photo will be taken during the interview to confirm your identity and help protect against fraud. At hire, you will complete formal identity verification.****

Securing Your Data

jobs.description:
Remote with occasional travel in West Midlands: In the Security Engineer role, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) is secure and protected against cyber threats.

Remote with occasional travel in West Midlands:

In the Security Engineer role, you will play a crucial role in ensuring our Operational Technology (OT) and Information Technology (IT) is secure and protected against cyber threats. Your expertise will help identify potential risks and vulnerabilities specific to OT and IT environments and develop effective mitigation strategies. By providing guidance and support, you will contribute to our vision of being a world-leading Information Technology and Digital function in the energy sector.

Key Responsibilities

 What you'll do
As an employee in the Security Engineer role, your key roles and responsibilities will include:

- Administer and maintain the End Point Security platform(s) (Tanium & Sentinel One) across enterprise environments.

- Deploy, configure, and manage End Point Security including Tanium modules including Asset, Patch, Deploy, Threat Response, and Comply.

- Monitor system performance and ensure high availability and reliability of End Point security services.

- Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and queries to support IT operations and security teams.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate End Point security services with other security and IT tools.

- Perform regular audits and ensure compliance with internal and external security standards.

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to endpoint visibility, patching, and software deployment.

- Provide training and support to internal teams on End Point security services usage and best practices.

- Stay current with Tanium/Sentinel One updates, features, and industry trends.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

-
 Tanium Certified Administrator (TCA) certification is preferable .

- Proven experience administering Tanium and other End Point security products in a medium to large enterprise environment.

- Strong understanding of endpoint management, cybersecurity principles, and IT operations.

- Experience with scripting languages (e.g., PowerShell, Python) for automation and reporting.

- Familiarity with Windows, Linux, and MacOS operating systems.

- Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Benefits

We have a high-performance culture which is balanced evenly with world-class well-being initiatives and benefits:

- Flexible Working: Balance your work and personal life with our flexible working options.

- Generous Holiday Allowance: Enjoy 25 days of holiday, plus bank holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days of annual leave.

- Medicash & Critical Illness Scheme

- Financial & Investment Benefits: Enjoy peace of mind with our Pension, Life Assurance, and Share Save Scheme.

- Community & Volunteering Programmes: Make a difference in your community with our volunteering opportunities.

- Green Car Scheme: Drive green and save money with our eco-friendly car scheme.

- Cycle Scheme: Stay fit and healthy with our cycle-to-work scheme.

- Special Time Off: Take time off for those big moments in life, like getting married/entering into a civil partnership, becoming a grandparent, and welcoming home a new pet.

- Family Planning: Benefit from our generous maternity and paternity leave, as well as time off and support for those undergoing fertility treatments.

jobs.description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human** Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

#### **The Senior Systems Engineer Opportunity**

As a Senior Systems Engineer at Okta, you will be at the heart of how our global workforce communicates, collaborates, and creates. You won’t just be "keeping the lights on"; you will be responsible for architecting workflows, securing our ecosystem, and ensuring that our stack - from Google Workspace to Slack and Gemini - works seamlessly for every employee, everywhere.

#### **What You’ll Be Doing**

- Infrastructure Management: Administer and optimize our core productivity suite, including Google Workspace, Gemini, Slack, Asana, Smartsheet, and other tools.
- AI Integration & Strategy: Lead the deployment, management, and troubleshooting of enterprise AI tools (specifically Gemini), ensuring they are integrated safely and effectively into daily workflows.
- Enablement: Create technical documentation and partner with cross-functional teams to drive adoption and best practices for productivity tools through effective training and support.
- Global Support: Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex technical issues, supporting a fast-paced, 24/7 global environment from one of our US hubs.
- Lifecycle Management: Responsible for the complete lifecycle management of multiple enterprise SaaS applications.
- Governance & Standards: Define and enforce global standards for tool usage, security permissions, and data governance.
- Problem Solving & Innovation: Consistently look for root-cause trends while solving platform problems, devising solutions based on limited information and adapting existing approaches to resolve unusual SaaS circumstances.
- Process Automation: Identify manual bottlenecks and use APIs or scripting to automate repetitive administrative tasks.
- Data Insights & Goal Delivery: Independently draw out meaningful insights from system data to own and deliver quarterly goals on time with a high standard of quality.

#### **What You’ll Bring to the Role**

- Technical Expertise: Proven deep experience managing enterprise-level Google Workspace (DNS, mail routing, Vault, DLP) and administrative experience with tools such as Slack, Asana, Jira, ServiceNow, and Smartsheet.
- AI Proficiency: Practical experience managing and deploying Gemini and other AI-driven productivity interfaces within a corporate framework.
- SaaS Architecture & Security: Possess complete knowledge of SaaS principles, API integrations, and RBAC security best practices, acting as the fully qualified professional to resolve complex issues creatively.
- Operational Agility: Experience working in a fast-paced environment supporting a distributed, global company.
- Governance Mindset: A track record of implementing "least privilege" access models and driving standards in usage and best practices.
- Automation and Scripting Skills: Proficiency in Apps Script, Python, or Bash to manage large-scale migrations or system integrations.
- Communication: Excellent verbal and written skills to lead training and influence standard usage across the org.
- Stakeholder Alignment: Enhance networks with senior internal partners who may be unfamiliar with SaaS technicalities and use persuasion to align stakeholders on new processes.
- Leadership & Peer Support: Assist leadership with forming teams that have a diverse mix of perspectives, provide specific, actionable, and timely feedback to peers, and demonstrate resilience under pressure.
- Education & Experience: Requires 5+ years of related experience in a professional role.

### **The TDI Client Platform Engineering Team**

The **Technology, Data, and Insights (TDI)** team is on a mission to accelerate Okta’s scale. We are a group of innovative engineers who prioritize automation, testing, and performance tuning. We touch every part of the business, and we are obsessed with creating a seamless, secure end-user experience for every Okta employee.

### **The Senior Client Platform Engineer Opportunity**

As a **Senior Client Platform Engineer**, you will be the subject matter expert for Okta’s macOS and iOS fleet. While your primary focus is the Apple ecosystem, you will also play a key role in our broader endpoint strategy, contributing to our **Windows and Linux** management workflows as needed. This is an ideal path for an engineer who wants to maintain deep Apple expertise while expanding their influence across the entire OS landscape.

We are looking for a versatile engineer who thinks **automation-first**. You will combine Jamf Pro expertise with open-source tools like Munki and Santa, while helping to bridge the gap between platforms using unified tools like FleetDM.

**What makes this role unique:** You are **Customer Zero**. Because we build identity and device management products, you will work directly with Okta’s own Product and Engineering teams to validate new capabilities across platforms, surface real-world feedback, and help shape the roadmap for tools used by millions of people globally.

_This role reports to the Senior Manager of Client Platform Engineering._

### **What You’ll Be Doing**

- **Apple Fleet Management:** Own the global macOS and iOS fleet using Jamf Pro, overseeing enrollment, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
- **Cross-Platform Support:** Contribute to the management and security of Windows (via Intune/Autopilot) and Linux endpoints as the program evolves, ensuring a consistent security posture across all OS types.

This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

- Global Support: Act as a Tier 3 escalation point for complex technical issues, supporting a fast-paced, 24/7 global environment from one of our US hubs.

- Governance & Standards: Define and enforce global standards for tool usage, security permissions, and data governance.

- Problem Solving & Innovation: Consistently look for root-cause trends while solving platform problems, devising solutions based on limited information and adapting existing approaches to resolve unusual SaaS circumstances.

- Process Automation: Identify manual bottlenecks and use APIs or scripting to automate repetitive administrative tasks.

jobs.description:
#### _Our Story_

Be a part of something bigger...

Radar Healthcare is dedicated to improving patient safety by bringing together the expertise of healthcare professionals and the power of intuitive software. Our innovative platform has been developed in partnership with industry experts to ensure organisations always meet regulatory standards – making it easier than ever for healthcare providers to deliver top-quality care to their patients.

We’re on a mission to become a world-leading health-tech pioneer, and we know that we can only achieve this with the help of talented individuals like you. If you’re passionate about improving healthcare outcomes and want to work in a team of like-minded individuals, we invite you to join us on our journey.

So if you’re up for an exciting challenge and want to be part of a team that’s making a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

#### _Our Values_

At Radar Healthcare, we are all proud of our values-led, open, supportive and inclusive culture. It's just as important that anyone joining our friendly team share the same values as us, to ensure we're all on the same page from day one, so we're looking for people who feel aligned to the following:

**🤝🏽 Customer focused** with a **partnership** approach

**📖 Open, honest** and **transparent**

**🧠 Innovative**

**🫶🏼 Ethical, trustworthy** and **caring**

**_Our People & Culture_**

At Radar Healthcare, we understand and celebrate the fact that our people are our best assets! We are proud to showcase our diverse and passionate talent that encapsulates our vision, purpose and values in our shared mission of innovation in healthcare. We’re an ambitious but caring team, and so supporting our colleagues and partners is always a top priority. Not to mention, we’re not all work and no play – we love getting together to celebrate our achievements together in various settings, whether it be our winter and summer socials, our people-led full company days, team get togethers or simply just interacting and supporting one another over coffee breaks either remotely or in person at our amazing Leeds office.

"We're also super proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified, based on outstanding feedback directly from our team earlier this year, with 91% of the team agreeing that they "would strongly endorse my company to friends and family as a great place to work" Not to mention Radar Healthcare has been named one of the UK’s Top 100 Companies to Work For 2025, one of the Top 20 Tech Companies to Work For, and has received a Two Star Accreditation from Best Companies, recognising _‘Outstanding’_ levels of workplace engagement."" **🫶🏼**

**The Opportunity**

#### _Radar Healthcare's new ⭐_ Microsoft 365 Tenant Integration & Migration Consultant _⭐_

**Contract UK Remote Outside IR35 Considered**

Radar Healthcare is seeking an experienced **Microsoft 365 Tenant Integration & Migration Consultant** to lead the integration of a newly acquired business into the Radar technology environment.

This is a hands-on engagement covering the entire migration lifecycle, from discovery and target-state design through to Microsoft 365 migration, domain cutover, device transition, hypercare, and source-tenant decommissioning.

#### What you'll be responsible for

- Assessing and documenting the source Microsoft 365 environment

- Designing coexistence and target-state architecture

- Migrating Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and Microsoft Teams

- Assessing and transitioning Slack channels, workflows and integrations

- Migrating Entra ID applications, SSO, SCIM and automation platforms

- Coordinating Intune and Windows Autopilot device transitions

- Managing domain, DNS and mail-flow cutover activities

- Delivering hypercare, stabilisation and operational handover

- Producing migration runbooks, validation reports and governance documentation

#### We're looking for someone with experience in:

✅ Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations

✅ Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive & Teams migrations

✅ Entra ID, SSO, Enterprise Applications & SCIM

✅ ShareGate or equivalent migration tooling

✅ Microsoft Intune & Windows Autopilot

✅ Power Platform, PowerShell & automation remediation

✅ Slack migration and collaboration platform transitions

✅ DNS, domain transfer, SPF, DKIM & DMARC cutovers

✅ Technical project governance and stakeholder management

#### About you

- Proven track record delivering complex M365 migration programmes

- Comfortable working at both strategic and hands-on technical levels

- Strong documentation, planning and stakeholder engagement skills

- Able to identify risks, dependencies and remediation requirements

- UK-based and available to support workshops and key migration activities

#### _The Bigger Picture_

Whilst we value professional experiences and qualifications, we’re committed to maintaining a culture of growth and development here at Radar Healthcare. We take into account each candidates demonstrable skillset, drive and ethos so even if you don’t feel 100% qualified for the role – we welcome you to connect with us. We’d love to hear from passionate candidates from all backgrounds that align themselves with our company values and are excited to make a difference in healthcare!

What we offer in return...

**💰 A competitive day rate** dependent on experience

Accessibility

If you require any special considerations or adjustments to our application and interviewing process, please don't hesitate to let us know. We understand and celebrate the fact that every person that we connect with is different and therefore requires different starting points on their journey with us. If you have a medical condition or disability we are committed to ensuring that our process is inclusive and accessible for all, let us know how we can best support you.

Connect with us!

We'd love to hear from you! If this role isn't quite right for you but you feel like Radar Healthcare could be, click the **Connect** button on our careers site and we'll keep you in the loop of new opportunities as they arise. You can also find out more about our mission, values and culture by checking out our various channels:

🎧 **Listen** to Our [**What the HealthTech**](https://radarhealthcare.com/what-the-healthtech/) podcast

🔗 **Connect** with us on [**Linkedin**](https://uk.linkedin.com/company/radarhealthcare)

💚 **Discover** why Radar Healthcare is a fantastic place to work from our very own people on [**Glassdoor**](https://www.glassdoor.co.uk/Reviews/Radar-Healthcare-Reviews-E3242273.htm)!

**_Connect with us on our journey and get to know the people who make us shine!_**

jobs.description:
Contexte et positionnement du poste

Afin de renforcer notre équipe Operations, nous recherchons un profil senior spécialisé dans les services Microsoft 365 Collaboration et Power Platform. Le poste combine un rôle de référent L3 sur Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive avec la responsabilité du support technique Power Platform sur nos contrats de Managed Services.

 Positionnement du poste

Il s’agit d’un rôle orienté Run et support avancé. Le collaborateur ne porte pas de projets de déploiement ou de développement de nouvelles solutions. Il intervient sur les environnements existants, leur stabilité, leur support, leur gouvernance opérationnelle et leur amélioration continue.

Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

Microsoft 365 Collaboration – L3 Operations

 n Assurer le support de niveau 3 et le troubleshooting avancé sur les environnements Microsoft 365 de nos clients.

 n Être le référent technique de l’équipe Operations pour Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive for Business.

 n Prendre en charge les incidents complexes, problèmes et escalades provenant des équipes L1/L2.

 n Analyser les dégradations de service, problèmes de configuration, droits d’accès, synchronisation, partage et intégrations.

 n Intervenir sur Microsoft 365 Groups et sur les dépendances Entra ID liées aux services collaboratifs.

 n Piloter les escalades techniques auprès de Microsoft ou de fournisseurs tiers lorsque nécessaire.

 n Réaliser des analyses de cause racine et contribuer au Problem Management.

 n Identifier les incidents récurrents et proposer des améliorations techniques ou opérationnelles.

 n Maintenir la documentation technique, les procédures d’exploitation et les articles de connaissance.

 n Assurer le transfert de compétences et l’accompagnement technique des équipes L1/L2.

Power Platform – Référent technique L3

 n Être le point de référence technique pour le support Power Platform sur les contrats MSP pris en charge par Sword.

 n Assurer le support avancé de Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, environnements Power Platform, connecteurs et gateways.

 n Diagnostiquer les erreurs d’applications et de flows, problèmes de connecteurs, authentification, permissions et dépendances de plateforme.

 n Prendre en charge les incidents sur les solutions existantes sans responsabilité de développement de nouvelles applications.

 n Contribuer à l’administration des environnements et à la gouvernance opérationnelle de la Power Platform.

 n Coordonner avec les propriétaires d’applications, développeurs ou équipes projet lorsqu’une correction applicative ou une évolution sort du périmètre Run.

 n Construire et maintenir les procédures de support et standards opérationnels Power Platform.

Managed Services Operations

 n Gérer les incidents, problèmes et demandes de service dans nos outils ITSM, en respectant les priorités et SLA contractuels.

 n Participer aux échanges techniques avec les Service Delivery Managers et les équipes IT de nos clients.

 n Contribuer aux revues opérationnelles lorsque son expertise technique est requise.

 n Collaborer avec les spécialistes Azure, Workplace, Identity, Security et Business Applications.

 n Participer aux démarches d’amélioration continue et de capitalisation au sein de l’équipe Operations.

 n Participer au service d’astreinte lorsque le périmètre du contrat le nécessite.

Votre profil

 n Minimum 5 ans d’expérience dans des environnements Microsoft, avec une expérience significative en support L2/L3 ou Managed Services.

 n Expérience solide et opérationnelle des services Microsoft 365 Collaboration.

 n Expérience concrète de l’administration et du support Microsoft Power Platform.

 n Expérience comme technical lead, référent senior, expert d’escalade ou technical advisor.

 n Capacité à diagnostiquer des problèmes complexes impliquant plusieurs services Microsoft et à identifier rapidement la cause racine.

 n Autonomie, sens du service et capacité à proposer des solutions pragmatiques.

 n Aisance dans un environnement Managed Services avec engagement de service, priorisation et relation client.

 n Rigueur, organisation, esprit d’équipe et bonne communication.

 n Capacité à documenter clairement les sujets techniques et à transférer ses connaissances aux autres ingénieurs.

Compétences techniques

 Microsoft 365 Collaboration

 Power Platform

Microsoft Teams

Power Apps

SharePoint Online

Power Automate

OneDrive for Business

Dataverse

Microsoft 365

Connectors & integrations

Microsoft Entra ID

On-premises Data Gateway

PowerShell

Power Platform Admin Center

Compétences complémentaires appréciées

 n Microsoft Purview

 n Exchange Online

 n Microsoft Graph

 n Azure

 n Intune

 n Power Platform ALM / Solutions

 n CI/CD principles for Power Platform

Langues

 n Anglais professionnel obligatoire : niveau B2 minimum, C1 souhaité.

 n Français professionnel fortement souhaité.

 n Une autre langue européenne constitue un atout.

Ce qui caractérise le poste

 n Un rôle senior d’expertise technique centré sur le Run, le troubleshooting et la responsabilité opérationnelle.

 n Le point d’escalade L3 de référence pour Teams, SharePoint Online et OneDrive au sein de la BU Operations.

 n Le référent L3 Power Platform pour les contrats de Managed Services opérés par Sword.

Pourquoi rejoindre Sword ?

Organisé selon un modèle de centres de compétence spécialisés, Sword a développé une expertise forte sur les technologies Cloud Microsoft et les Managed Services.

Vous rejoignez une organisation où les équipes Operations, Collaboration, Business Applications, Workplace, Identity et Security travaillent ensemble sur des environnements clients exigeants et variés. Le poste offre un haut niveau d’autonomie et une responsabilité technique claire sur le périmètre Run.

Responsibilities

Job Description:

Peraton is seeking an experienced systems Virtual Desktop Engineer to join our national intelligence program that delivers engineering, application development, deployment, operations, upgrades and sustainment of products and services to achieve our client's global missions.

The Virtual Desktop Engineer will have an emphasis on User Profiles.

Responsibilities:

 Manage user accounts, permissions, licenses, and monitoring of system performance to proactively resolve technical issues.

 Analyze and interpret data to improve infrastructure performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement solutions, to include monitoring system performance and troubleshooting issues to ensure compliance with performance standards.

 Ensure data security and compliance with industry standards and regulations.

 Maintain smooth operation of multi-user computer systems, including coordination with network engineers.

 Monitor and manage enterprise system resources, including CPU usage, disk usage, and response times to maintain operating efficiency.

 Assess and remediate the enterprise design and implementation to mitigate performance and cybersecurity risks.

 Perform systems security administration functions, including creating user profiles and accounts.

 Provide Tier 1 and Tier 2 problem identification, diagnosis, and resolution of problems.

 Configure operating systems and support enterprise servers.

 Install and configure database and application software.

 Perform database backups and system restoration, monitor database performance, and perform troubleshooting.

This role ensures that endpoints remain secure, up to date, and aligned with company IT policies, while offering end-users reliable access to the tools they need to perform their work. Apply standard configurations and policies through endpoint management tools (e.g., Intune, SCCM, JAMF, NinjaOne). Support onboarding of new users with device setup and configuration. Strong problem-solving skills and customer service orientation. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Preferred Qualifications: CompTIA A+, Network+, or equivalent certification. Experience in a help desk or IT support environment. Knowledge of ITIL practices for incident and request management.
