jobs.description: Overview Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai. Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees. Responsibilities Description Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers. THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED. JOB DUTIES: - Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting. - Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates. - Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans. - Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M. - Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves. - Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment. - Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation. - Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval. Qualifications REQUIREMENTS: - Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree). - Must be a U.S. Citizen. - Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position. - Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs. - Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting. - Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security). - Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision. - Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment. - Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting. - Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management. - Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection. - Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions. - Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation. DESIRED SKILLS: - CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP. - Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. - Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling. - Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs. - Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy. - Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation. - ITIL 4 Foundation certification. PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS: This position requires the ability to perform the below essential functions: - Sitting for long periods - Standing for long periods - Ambulate throughout an office - Ambulate between several buildings About Empower AI All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

Customers include Cursor, Vercel, Bumble, Plaid, Glean, Apollo, Replit, and Mercor, and Iru partners with industry leaders such as ServiceNow and AWS. jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

In this high-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline.

This is a high-leverage "build-the-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

Your ImpactDefine the Platform Architecture: Architect a high-performance, modular core for networking, crypto, configuration, and telemetry that sibling products configure rather than rebuild.Establish Secure Seams & Extensions: Create localized plugin models so that new auth methods, protocol extensions, or tunnel types land once and become immediately available across all platforms.Systemic Quality & Reliability by Design: Own the endpoint architecture standardizing peer identity, least-privilege decomposition, resilient error handling, and memory safety directly into type systems and CI/CD gates.Pioneer AI-Native Workflows & Supportability: Integrate AI-driven software analysis, automated crash triage, and automated regression verification into standard build pipelines while driving unified crash analytics and product telemetry to maintain a world-class Crash-Free SLO across millions of active enterprise endpoints.Drive Technical Excellence: Set engineering standards, author key Architectural Decision Records (ADRs), mentor principal and senior talent, and represent our technical strategy with customers and engineering partners.

Qualifications

Minimum QualificationsSeasoned and accomplished leadership in Endpoint systems development`, core networking, and/or OS-level software development.Cross-Product Impact: Track record of defining cross-team architecture that was successfully adopted across multiple product groups.Deep OS Internals: Expert hands-on knowledge in at least two target platforms:Windows: Kernel/driver models, WFP, services, OS process architecture.macOS: XPC, System/Network Extensions, IOKit, code-signing, notarization.Linux: Netlink, routing, network namespaces, DNS handling.Legacy Refactoring: Proven experience decomposing complex C/C++ codebases into modular, testable components using incremental, safe refactoring patterns.Technical Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to align senior engineers and executives behind complex architectural shifts.Preferred QualificationsHands-on experience with VPN, ZTNA, or SASE client technologies (IPsec/IKEv2, TLS/DTLS, QUIC/MASQUE, split tunneling, posture assessment).Experience shipping multi-platform agents at scale (millions of active endpoints) with staged rollouts and telemetry-backed observability.Background integrating AI/ML models into software engineering workflows (code review, test generation, defect triage).

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

jobs.description:
Vice President Product Manager: Client Platform Multi-Factor Authentication

Purchase, NY

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities, investment management, and wealth management services to clients worldwide. Digital Client Experience & Platforms is building secure, scalable, and intuitive client-facing capabilities that help protect clients, enable digital adoption, and support trusted engagement across web and mobile channels.

We are seeking a Vice President, Product Manager to own the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for client platform Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). This leader will serve as a builder-operator for a critical identity and security platform, delivering secure-by-design authentication capabilities that protect clients while preserving a seamless digital experience. The role requires strong product judgment, execution discipline, and the ability to align engineering, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, legal, compliance, design, operations, and channel stakeholders around a measurable roadmap.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Strategy & Platform OwnershipOwn the MFA product vision, multi-year roadmap, and quarterly delivery plans across web, mobile, and shared client platform capabilities.

Define reusable authentication capabilities, adoption patterns, and integration standards that can scale across multiple client journeys and channel teams.

Translate security, fraud, regulatory, and client experience objectives into clear product outcomes, prioritized features, and measurable success criteria.

Develop the target-state roadmap for enrollment, step-up authentication, trusted devices, device binding, recovery, factor management, and channel migration.

Delivery, Execution & Operating DisciplineLead cross-functional delivery with engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, operations, design, and channel product teams from discovery through production launch.

Convert product strategy into epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, release plans, and launch readiness artifacts.

Manage dependencies across identity, session management, device intelligence, fraud decisioning, client servicing, contact center tooling, and digital channels.

Drive disciplined product rituals including prioritization, backlog grooming, stakeholder reviews, delivery governance, testing, release readiness, and post-launch validation.

Risk, Controls, Privacy & GovernancePartner with Technology, Cybersecurity, Fraud Operations, Chief Data Office/Risk, Legal, Compliance, and Internal Audit to ensure MFA capabilities meet internal control standards and external regulatory expectations.

Own product documentation and governance artifacts, including risk assessments, control mappings, audit evidence, exception handling, change approvals, and operational readiness materials.

Embed privacy, consent, data minimization, resiliency, and auditability considerations into product design and delivery decisions.

Client Experience, Adoption & Operational ExcellenceOptimize MFA experiences to reduce friction while maintaining strong protection, including prompt frequency, factor choice, enrollment completion, recovery flows, accessibility, and servicing escalation paths.

Partner with UX research, design, analytics, and servicing teams to validate journeys, identify drop-off drivers, and improve client and advisor outcomes.

Define production health expectations, including observability, incident readiness, defect prioritization, operational playbooks, and post-launch performance reviews.

Coordinate rollout, communications, training, and change management with digital channels, field/service organizations, and support teams.

Metrics & Continuous ImprovementDefine and track product, risk, and operational KPIs including MFA enrollment rate, challenge success rate, authentication latency, factor adoption, step-up frequency, fraud loss reduction, account takeover indicators, recovery completion, contact drivers, and defect trends.

Use data, client feedback, incident learnings, and control findings to continuously improve the roadmap and quantify risk reduction, resiliency, and experience gains.

Required Qualifications5-7 years of product management experience, including ownership of platform capabilities used by multiple applications, channels, or teams.

Demonstrated experience delivering authentication, identity, security, fraud, risk, or client protection products in a regulated environment; financial services experience strongly preferred.

Strong understanding of MFA methods and tradeoffs, including push, OTP, authenticator apps, device binding, trusted devices, account recovery, biometric-enabled flows, FIDO2/WebAuthn, and risk-based or adaptive authentication.

Proven ability to influence and execute across engineering, architecture, cybersecurity, fraud, risk, compliance, legal, design, analytics, operations, and senior business stakeholders.

Experience defining product metrics, analyzing performance data, and using evidence to prioritize roadmap investments and operational improvements.

Excellent written, verbal, and executive communication skills, with comfort presenting roadmap decisions, delivery progress, risks, tradeoffs, and funding needs to senior stakeholders.

Preferred QualificationsExperience with identity standards and protocols such as OAuth/OIDC and SAML, and familiarity with modern web and mobile authentication patterns.

Experience with device intelligence, fraud decisioning, risk scoring, account takeover prevention, or AI-enabled risk signal integration.

Experience improving account recovery, identity proofing, client support tooling, and operational workflows for identity-related issues.

Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, agile delivery practices, governance forums, and product financials or investment planning.

Core CompetenciesPlatform-first product strategy and roadmap ownership

Security-by-design mindset balanced with client experience outcomes

Structured execution, delivery governance, and operational discipline

Risk, controls, privacy, and compliance fluency

Data-driven decision-making, measurement, and continuous improvement

Executive communication, stakeholder influence, and cross-functional leadership

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what’s best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.

To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

the commencement of employment. However, base pay if hired will be determined on an individualized basis and is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Morgan Stanley sponsored benefit programs.

Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

jobs.title: Senior IT Security Engineer, Space
jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Space team is dedicated to expanding our AI-powered capabilities into the final frontier, enhancing Space Domain Awareness, Space Control, and Command and Control for U.S. military and allied partners. We're developing fully integrated hardware and software systems, including Lattice for Space Missions and modular payloads, to address growing threats in space and ensure our Guardians maintain a decisive advantage in this contested warfighting domain.

 ABOUT THE JOB

We are seeking a Senior IT Security Engineer to architect, build, and own classified infrastructure for Anduril's Space team from the ground up. This is a foundational role — you won't be inheriting an existing environment, you'll be designing and standing up the systems, standards, and processes that the team will rely on as it scales. That means making decisions about architecture, tooling, and automation frameworks, then implementing and hardening them to full compliance. You'll work at the intersection of security, infrastructure, and engineering to ensure our classified environments are built right from day one and remain resilient, compliant, and mission-ready.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design and build classified infrastructure from scratch, including server environments, virtual platforms, networking, and enterprise services — establishing the architecture and hardened baselines the Space team will operate on

- Define and implement STIG compliance strategies across Windows, RHEL, and VMware, using SCAP, SCC, and manual validation; stand up repeatable processes for ongoing compliance scanning and remediation

- Architect and deploy virtual infrastructure (primarily VMware vSphere, and potentially vSAN and Horizon/VDI), making foundational decisions on topology, resource allocation, and scalability

- Build out enterprise services from the ground up, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, WSUS/patch repositories, and repository servers

- Develop automation frameworks using Ansible, scripting (PowerShell, Bash, Python), and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure environments are reproducible, consistent, and minimally dependent on manual intervention

- Establish monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes for system health, performance, and security posture

- Lead vulnerability remediation efforts, driving technical implementation for CAT I/II/III findings and partnering with ISSO/ISSM stakeholders to meet required timelines

- Design and implement backup and disaster recovery strategies, defining RPO/RTO targets and validating them through regular testing

- Guide environments through the ATO process, producing documentation, compliance evidence, and technical demonstrations for security assessments

- Create comprehensive runbooks, architecture documentation, and knowledge transfer materials to enable the team to scale beyond a single point of ownership

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 7+ years administering and hardening Windows Server and Linux (RHEL) in classified or regulated environments

- Demonstrated experience building infrastructure from scratch, not just maintaining existing environments

- Deep knowledge of STIG application and validation using SCAP/SCC tools, with the ability to design compliance programs, not just execute checklists

- Strong VMware vSphere experience, including architecture decisions, provisioning, and patching

- Experience standing up and managing Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise patch management in new environments

- Advanced scripting and automation skills (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) with hands-on Ansible experience

- Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience architecting VMware vSAN and Horizon/VDI environments

- Familiarity with engineering applications such as Siemens NX, Teamcenter, or other CAD/CAM/CAE software

- Track record of leading environments through the full ATO lifecycle

- Experience mentoring junior administrators or leading small infrastructure teams

- Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Security+, RHCSA, RHCE, VCP, or CISSP

US Salary Range

 $166,000 - $220,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Principal Client Platform Engineer
jobs.summary: Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and...
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Roblox is seeking a Principal Client Platform Engineer to serve as the technical architect of our global endpoint ecosystem. Reporting to the Client Services Manager, you will define the long-term strategy for how our fleet scales, secures, and evolves. This role goes beyond day-to-day management — you will establish architectural standards, drive automation-first platform design, and ensure thousands of builders have secure, reliable tools to do their best work. From strengthening our security posture in a complex hybrid environment to mentoring senior engineers, you will shape the technical foundation that powers innovation at Roblox.

 You Will:

- Standardize the global security and management strategy for our entire fleet of macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and ChromeOS devices to ensure peak performance and ironclad compliance.

- Evolve of our deployment pipeline, driving the automated rollout of patches, OS upgrades, and complex certificate lifecycles for all endpoints.

- Lead the hardening of our endpoint security posture, partnering with InfoSec to architect automated remediation workflows and deploying advanced observability tools like CrowdStrike, and Kolide.

- Design and scale internally owned systems within our hybrid environment.

- Lead complex platform initiatives from architecture through global deployment and operational maturity.

- Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders across Corporate Engineering, Security, Engineering, and People Ops to align technical roadmaps with broader company goals.

- Navigate and resolve high-level ambiguity, transforming vague technical requirements into scalable engineering solutions.

- Serve as a technical escalation point, diagnosing deep-level architectural failures in hardware, software, and enterprise networking.

- Participate in the team’s on-call rotation, providing senior-level response for critical system availability and high-priority security incidents.

 You Have:

- 10+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, systems architecture, or infrastructure engineering.

- Proven experience securing and managing global fleets of 5,000+ devices.

- Deep expertise with endpoint management platforms such as Jamf Pro, Workspace ONE, Google Endpoint Management, Fleet, or Microsoft Intune.

- Strong programming ability in Python, Bash, Go, or Ruby with a focus on automation and systems integration.

- Experience implementing Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps-based configuration management.

- Advanced knowledge of Identity and Access Management and Zero Trust architecture across Okta, Google Workspace, and Entra ID.

- Strong understanding of PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and enterprise networking security.

- Demonstrated ability to lead large technical initiatives and influence cross-functional stakeholders.

 You Are:

- A security-focused architect passionate about solving complex endpoint challenges at scale.

- Comfortable working through ambiguity, with the ability to provide technical clarity and direction in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

- Heavily metrics-driven and customer-centric, using data to validate the effectiveness of security controls and improve the Builder experience.

- A collaborative engineer who builds strong relationships with cross-functional partners and mentors junior & senior team members.

For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page .

Annual Salary Range

 $230,980 - $267,390 USD

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.

For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.summary: **Job Description** Objetivo del puesto Apoyar la operación y monitoreo de controles de **Endpoint Security** , contribuyendo a la protección de equipos corporativos, detección de amenazas y atención inicial de eventos e incidentes de seguridad...
jobs.description:
**Job Description** Objetivo del puesto

Apoyar la operación y monitoreo de controles de **Endpoint Security** , contribuyendo a la protección de equipos corporativos, detección de amenazas y atención inicial de eventos e incidentes de seguridad relacionados con endpoints.

Responsabilidades

* Monitorear y analizar alertas de seguridad generadas en endpoints.
* Apoyar la operación de herramientas de Endpoint Protection, EDR/XDR y antivirus.
* Realizar análisis inicial de eventos relacionados con malware, actividad sospechosa y amenazas en dispositivos.
* Apoyar la investigación y seguimiento de incidentes de seguridad relacionados con endpoints.
* Participar en actividades de aislamiento, contención y remediación de dispositivos afectados, siguiendo procedimientos establecidos.
* Apoyar el seguimiento de vulnerabilidades, parches y configuraciones de seguridad en endpoints.
* Validar el estado y funcionamiento de agentes y controles de seguridad instalados en los dispositivos.
* Apoyar la aplicación y revisión de políticas de seguridad y hardening de endpoints.
* Documentar alertas, incidentes, hallazgos y acciones de remediación.
* Colaborar con equipos de Ciberseguridad, Infraestructura y Soporte en la resolución de incidentes.

Perfil

* 0--2 años de experiencia en Ciberseguridad, Endpoint Security, Security Operations, Infraestructura o áreas relacionadas.
* Conocimientos básicos de Endpoint Security, EDR/XDR y protección contra malware.
* Conocimientos básicos de Windows Security y deseable Linux.
* Conocimiento básico de vulnerability management, patching y hardening.
* Capacidad para realizar troubleshooting y análisis inicial de alertas de seguridad.
* Conocimientos fundamentales de redes: TCP/IP, DNS, puertos y protocolos.

jobs.description:
Wir sind SBIT – ein modernes Systemhaus mit rund 60 klugen Köpfen und Fokus auf Managed & Professional Services.

Wir sind SBIT – ein modernes Systemhaus mit rund 60 klugen Köpfen und Fokus auf Managed & Professional Services. Wir bauen Cloud-Lösungen, Netzwerke und Firewalls, die messbar Business-Wert stiften. Für dich heißt das im Cloud-Bereich: Design, Build & Run auf Basis von Microsoft 365 und Azure. Du bekommst Verantwortung, echte Remote-Arbeit, Mentoring durch Seniors, Zertifizierungen und Projekte, die dich fachlich fordern. Wenig Reiserei, viel Wirkung im Professional-Services-Kontext.

Aufgaben

-
 Cloud gestalten statt nur verwalten : Du planst, migrierst und betreibst moderne Microsoft 365- und Azure-Umgebungen – von Identity mit Entra ID/AAD über Teams- und SharePoint-Integration bis hin zu Zero-Trust-Policies und dem Security/Compliance Center.

-
 Migrationen meistern : Ob Exchange 2010/2016 nach Exchange Online, hybride Szenarien oder Coexistence und Cutover – du entwickelst die passenden Migrationspfade und begleitest die Umsetzung.

-
 Device Management vorantreiben : Mit Intune, Autopilot und BYOD-Policies sorgst du für moderne, standardisierte und automatisierte Client-Umgebungen – unterstützt durch smarte PowerShell-Skripte.

-
 Security by Design leben : Von MFA-Rollouts über Baseline-Härtung bis hin zu Compliance-Kontrollen (SBIT.CCM) – du stellst sicher, dass Sicherheit und kontinuierliche Verbesserung Hand in Hand gehen.

-
 Beraten & tief eintauchen : In Assessments, Architektur-Workshops und PoCs arbeitest du eng mit Sales und Key Accounts zusammen – und wenn es kritisch wird, übernimmst du als 3rd-Level-Support die Root-Cause-Analyse, Post-Mortems und Fixes.

Qualifikation

- Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder Studium und mindestens drei Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Cloud Engineering (Azure/M365).

- Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Identity, Security & Compliance, Exchange-Migrationen, Intune/Autopilot; PowerShell als Werkzeug zur Automatisierung.

- Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau (z. B. für Workshops & Kundendialoge) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Azure Landing Zones, IaC-/Automation-Mindset und EDR/XDR/SIEM-Know-how

Benefits

-
 Remote-First & geringer Reiseanteil: Homeoffice ist Teil unserer DNA. Außerdem hast du durch die Gleitzeit Freiraum für private Termine, deine Familie oder die morgendliche Sportroutine. Auch Kundentermine sind planbar.

-
 Weiterentwicklung & Zertifizierungen: Herstellertrainings (z. B. von Microsoft, Dell, HP, Lenovo), Technologie-Zertifizierungen (z. B. Azure, Microsoft, Fortinet, Sophos etc.) sowie Mentoring durch Seniors in der Praxis. Du wählst, was du brauchst.

-
 Gesundheit & Fitness: Jobrad und Egym/Wellpass für Sportler. Laufband zum Fitbleiben während der Arbeit. Darts, Konsole oder Tischkicker für abwechslungsreiche Pausen.

-
 Teamspirit: Das 60-köpfige Team plus Bürohunde ist unser Wohlfühlzentrum. Teamwork & Respekt gehören zu unserem Werte-Kodex. Gemeinsame Mittagessen wie Pizza oder BBQ gibt es bei uns regelmäßig**.**

-
 Ausstattung & Flex: Freue dich auf moderne Hardware, Homeoffice-Setup sowie top ausgestattete Küche und Klimaanlage im Office.

Neugierig geworden?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung. Wenn Du Lust hast, schreibe uns auch Deine Big Five for Life! Wir stehen auf sowas!
Du bist Dir unsicher, ob Du alle Eigenschaften erfüllst? Bewirb Dich trotzdem! Bei uns zählen Deine Motivation und Deine Leidenschaft!

Bewerbungsprozess und Kontakt:

Ansprechpartner:

Janik Sohn

 Bewerbungsprozess:
Sobald dein Lebenslauf bei uns eingeht, melden wir uns innerhalb von drei Tagen bei dir zurück. Im besten Fall laden wir dich direkt zu einem kurzen Video-Interview (ca. 20–30 Minuten) ein. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, folgt ein Fachinterview. Und wenn auch das Match stimmt, erhältst du dein Angebot – ganz ohne langen Bewerbungs-Marathon.

jobs.summary: Location : Dallas, TX Day one onsite (Relocation will work) Client : Cetera Financial Exp level : 10+ Years About the Role You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on...
jobs.description:
Location : Dallas, TX Day one onsite (Relocation will work)

 Client : Cetera Financial

 Exp level : 10+ Years

 About the Role

 You'll be the hands-on MDM engineer on a data modernization program for a large financial services client. The platform is built on Databricks and Delta Lake; your job is to own the Profisee MDM layer - configure it, connect it, and keep golden records flowing cleanly into the downstream warehouse.

 This is an implementation role, not an advisory one. You'll write code, configure match rules, and debug pipeline failures.

 What You'll Do

    Configure and tune Profisee match and survivorship rules for Client and Advisor entities (probabilistic + deterministic matching, confidence thresholds, conflict resolution).

    Build and maintain the integration between Databricks Delta Lake and Profisee - ingestion of staging records into Profisee, and write-back of golden records to the Lakehouse.

    Set up the Profisee stewardship portal for data steward workflows - exception queues, match review, and record correction.

    Work with upstream pipeline engineers to ensure records are correctly partitioned and flagged before they hit the MDM layer.

    Monitor MDM pipeline health - match rates, queue depth, golden record lag - and fix issues when they arise.

    Document match rules, survivorship decisions, and integration patterns for the team.

 Must-Have

  3+ years with Profisee MDM - you've implemented it, not just administered it. You know match rules, survivorship policies, and Profisee Connect.

    Strong SQL and Python - you can write and debug pipeline code independently.

  Profisee integration experience - connecting Profisee to an external data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, SQL Server, or equivalent) via API or connector.

  Match/merge configuration - candidate generation, scoring, threshold tuning, and survivorship.

  Cloud environment experience - AWS or Azure.

 Nice to Have

    Databricks / Delta Lake experience (DLT, MERGE, Change Data Feed).

    Financial services domain knowledge - client data, advisor data, accounts.

    Experience with other MDM tools (Reltio, Informatica, Semarchy).

    Kafka / event-driven pipeline experience.

 You're a Good Fit If

    You can configure a Profisee match rule from scratch and explain why you set the thresholds where you did.

    You've debugged a golden record that wasn't writing back correctly and can walk through how you found the issue.

    You don't need someone to hand you an architecture diagram before you can ask good questions.

jobs.title: Master Data Management (MDM) Technical Lead
jobs.summary: Job Description SummaryGEV is building Master Data Management capabilities across Customer, Supplier, and Legal Entity first and then continue to expand to other domains that provides business impact. The MDM Technical Lead is the hands-on owner for all...
jobs.description:
Job Description SummaryGEV is building Master Data Management capabilities across Customer, Supplier, and Legal Entity first and then continue to expand to other domains that provides business impact. The MDM Technical Lead is the hands-on owner for all the technical components, designing and building platform capabilities and leading technical execution while evolving the architecture. This is a role that leads by doing, sets the technical standard, and translates an ambitious Lean Roadmap into working, measurable deliverables.

MDM Context: Customer and Supplier are managed today in separate onboarding systems (each the authoritative master for its domain), with a command center (work-in-progress) serving data-quality dashboards and unified view. The near-term strategy is first to master each domain in place, explore impactful operational data domains (to master) while building the governance and data-quality foundation. Second, make an MDM platform decision at a deliberate subsequent gate. The Technical Lead is central to both.

This role will own the architecture evolution from Registry → Consolidation → Coexistence → Centralized, bring a deep, current understanding of AI-enabled and AI-centric MDM platforms, and operate in a dynamic and evolving ecosystem, providing technical leadership updates and driving technical alignment across business functions, segments and Digital Technology teams.

Job DescriptionIn this role, you will:

Leadership & Influence

Serve as the hands-on technical owner for the MDM program. Influence and drive alignment across teams (business, DT, procurement, and domain teams). Mentor engineers and data stewards; raise the technical bar across the program. Provide the governance council and data owners with technical options, trade-offs, and feasibility input to shape decisions. Lead the technical build-vs-buy evaluation and vendor/ proof-of-concept assessment, guiding leadership to a make the right decision.
Strategy & Prioritization

Own the MDM reference architecture and its multi-year evolution — Registry → Consolidation → Coexistence → Centralized, with explicit entry/exit criteria for each stage. Sequence the roadmap for incremental value: master-in-place now, platform decision at a deliberate gate, integrating with downstream systems. Prioritize domains and capabilities: Legal Entity backbone and high value domains Customer, Supplier and Operations. Define the canonical/logical data models, golden-record survivorship strategy, and cross-domain resolution for Legal Entity, Customer, and Supplier. Maintain deep, current knowledge of AI-enabled / AI-centric MDM platform architecture; shape where AI augments mastering, with guardrails for explainability, human-in-the-loop review, and auditability. Set non-functional requirements such as scale, performance, availability, security, lineage, and data privacy. Adoption & Enablement

Lead adoption steward tooling, technical documentation, and hands-on training and enablement. Win stakeholder buy-in with working prototypes and demos. Push data quality checks into the onboarding systems (validation at entry) so best practice is built into daily workflows. Build prescriptive remediation that makes stewards effective, identifying the specific defect and rule, recommending the fix, and routing the task. Automate survivorship, remediation routing, and orchestration to cut manual effort and rework. Adopt scalable architecture, match-and-merge engines, pipelines, and AI agent integrations.
Customer Engagement & Experience

Engage the business consumers of master data (Customer, Supplier, and Legal Entity stakeholders) to capture requirements and to ensure that the golden record is used consistently. Integrate the command center with the existing Customer and Supplier onboarding systems to improve the onboarding experience and reduce cycle time. Deliver trusted Customer 360 and Supplier records that improve downstream experiences across CRM/sales, procurement, service, and compliance. Partner with domain owners and stewards as internal customers, iterating on data products based on their feedback.
Measurement & Insights

Design and build the DQ engine, profiling, rule authoring and execution, scoring, and dashboarding on top of the existing metrics. Establish baselines, targets, and owners across the six DQ dimensions (completeness, uniqueness, validity, accuracy, consistency, timeliness). jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

About SSO

The ServiceNow Security Organization (SSO) delivers world-class, innovative security solutions to reduce risk and protect the company and our customers. We enable our customers to migrate their most sensitive data and workloads to the cloud, accelerating our business so that we are the most trusted SaaS provider. We create an environment where our employees are proud to work and can make a positive impact.

Team

This position reports to the Director, Endpoint Security Engineering (ESE) and anchors the AI Security Governance Program - a board-visible, auditor-facing program spanning five control pillars (AI visibility & inventory, prompt & response protection, agent architecture & control, shadow AI & access control, and compliance & audit) and the enterprise AI risks reported to the Audit Committee. The team builds state-of-the-art controls that reduce risk to the company's most sensitive AI-connected assets with the least possible impact on operations, and shifts the perception of security from blocker to enabler.

Role

As Principal Engineer for AI Security Governance, you will own the technical strategy, architecture, and hands-on delivery of the program end to end. You will set direction across two governance tracks - enterprise-wide AI traffic and ServiceNow platform AI - and personally build and mature the controls that enforce it.

This is a senior individual-contributor role: you will lead through technical authority, architecture, and mentorship rather than direct-report management, and you will be a driving force in ServiceNow's internal AI transformation, moving the security function from manual effort toward AI-automated operations.

What you get to do in this role:

 Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the AI Security Governance Program across all five control pillars
 Architect controls across both the enterprise-AI and platform-AI tracks, keeping the two governance paths distinct and defensible
 Deploy, configure, and mature security controls hands-on - including AI detection and response, data security posture management (DSPM/AISPM), and data-path controls for unmanaged access
 Drive the shift from manual security operations to AI-automated workflows, building automation into every control rather than staffing around it
 Close the highest-severity gaps in AI data protection, agent permissions, and shadow AI
 Author and sustain the risk narrative and technical materials for CISO, board, and Audit Committee audiences to a standard of precision that never overclaims
 Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers and cross-functional partners, and bring data to every decision

Qualifications

In order to be successful in this role, we need someone who has:

 Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
 15+ years of relevant experience in security and software engineering, including hands-on technical leadership, or similar experience with education
 Deep, current expertise in AI security - LLM and generative-AI threats, agentic-AI risk, prompt and response protection, AI/ML supply chain, and AI governance frameworks
 Strong architecture and engineering skills across cloud and SaaS environments, and the ability to build and operate controls directly, not only design them
 Experience with data security tooling (DSPM/AISPM, DLP, CASB) and identity/entitlement controls
 A track record of translating complex technical risk into executive-, board-, and auditor-ready narratives
 Strong problem-solving across security and software engineering, and the ability to apply data for diagnostics and to make the case for new solutions
 Working knowledge of compliance and regulatory standards, and experience in Agile practices
 Ability to build trusted relationships with security and engineering teams across the company
 You must be eligible for adjudication to access our US regulated market environments. Permanent residency or citizenship is required.

Senior End User Computing (EUC) Engineer – Microsoft 365 & Intune

Location: Onsite — Irvine, California

Duration: Long-term

Rate: $ 50- 55/hr

What We’re Looking For

• 3+ years of hands-on desktop and application support experience in a Windows enterprise environment

• Demonstrated proficiency administering a Microsoft 365 tenant, including E5-tier workloads (Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Identity, Purview, Entra ID P2)

jobs.description:
With 1,700 employees and 14 factories across 3 continents, STERIMED is the world's leading manufacturer of materials and packaging systems for the sterilization of medical devices. Sterimed develops, produces, converts, and markets various solutions such as bacterial barrier substrates and preformed sterilization packaging, serving both hospitals and medical device manufacturers.

Sterimed stands out with its strong entrepreneurial DNA and has been pursuing a highly dynamic external growth policy for several years. Since its founding in 2016, the group's size has quadrupled, and 10 acquisitions have been completed since 2017.

To support this growth, we are looking for a Sales Manager M/F for our MDM business unit covering Costa Rica and Mexico.

Reporting to the MDM Sales Team Leader Americas, the Sales Manager is responsible for managing, developing, and closing profitable new business across Costa Rica and parts of Mexico, primarily the surrounding areas of Mexico City. The primary focus of this role is selling medical packaging solutions to medical device manufacturers while also managing and growing an existing portfolio of customers. This is a remote role based in in Costa Rica.

This position requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent prospecting skills, and the ability to convert business opportunities into sustainable and profitable orders. The Sales Manager will work closely with customers, internal technical teams, and key stakeholders to support product validation, strengthen customer relationships, and drive order intake and market growth.

The ideal candidate will be a collaborative and transparent team player who can operate successfully in a multicultural, cross-border environment. This role also requires strong project management skills, the ability to build annual sales forecasts and budgets, and a commitment to delivering results in a dynamic, international business setting.

The position involves frequent travel throughout the assigned territory, including surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica and France for company seminars and business meetings.

**Responsibilities and Duties**

• Grow sales within the assigned territory of surrounding areas of Mexico City and Costa Rica

• Develop new business opportunities with medical device manufacturers.

• Manage and expand an existing customer portfolio.

• Prospect actively to identify and convert new commercial opportunities.

• Support product validation projects in coordination with customers and the technical department.

• Act as the link between customers and internal stakeholders to ensure effective communication and follow-up.

• Turn business opportunities into profitable orders.

• Build annual sales budgets based on customer forecasts and new business opportunities.

• Maintain accurate reporting and CRM updates.

• Apply company marketing and commercial policies consistently.

• Travel regularly within the territory and occasionally internationally as required.

**Qualifications**

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, International Trade, Business Negotiation, Packaging En-gineering, or a related field.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an export sales or B2B sales position.

• Experience in medical sterile packaging is preferred; experience in general packaging or food packaging will also be considered.

• Strong understanding of sales processes, customer development, and account management.

• Experience working with technical or project-based sales cycles is an asset.

**Skills and Competencies**

• Strong prospecting and business development skills.

• Excellent negotiation and communication skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer projects simultaneously.

• Strong reporting, planning, and forecasting capabilities.

• Proficiency in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and CRM tools.

• Knowledge of Incoterms is preferred.

• Able to work effectively in an international and multicultural environment.

• Customer-focused, proactive, self-driven, and results-oriented.

• Strong relationship-building and problem-solving abilities.

• Adaptable and eager to learn about a new industry or market segment.

**Language Requirement**

• Bilingual in English and Spanish is required.

**Travel Requirement**

• Travel approximately 50% to 70% of the time within the assigned territory.

• Occasional travel outside of territory but within the Americas and France for company seminars or business meetings.

*Sterimed is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible work environment. Feel free to let us know about any accommodations you may need to participate in the recruitment process.*

jobs.description:
JOB TITLE: Endpoint Security Engineer

LOCATION: Media, PA (4 days/week ONSITE)

Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Endpoint Security Engineer to lead the technical execution of a large-scale migration from Trellix to SentinelOne across more than 20,000 endpoints. This environment includes Windows point-of-sale (POS) devices, in-store and back-office Windows servers, as well as embedded and kiosk-class systems.

The consultant will be responsible for the end-to-end engineering effort, including designing the migration strategy, building the automation required to execute it, validating functionality through testing, and supporting deployment through stabilization.

This is a highly hands-on engineering role, not an advisory position. The ideal candidate will have experience writing deployment and remediation scripts, troubleshooting complex endpoint issues, supporting pilot deployments, and driving large-scale enterprise rollouts. The environment consists of business-critical systems that operate continuously, requiring strong operational discipline and attention to deployment quality, rollback procedures, and automated reporting.

Key Responsibilities

Assess the existing Trellix environment and design the migration approach for various endpoint types while minimizing security exposure during the transition to SentinelOne.Configure and administer SentinelOne, including site and group structure, policies, detection and mitigation settings, update rings, connectivity requirements, and application exclusions.Develop automation using PowerShell and Bash for silent installs, uninstalls, validation, cleanup, logging, remediation, rollback procedures, and reboot management.Package and deploy software through enterprise endpoint management platforms such as MECM/SCCM, Microsoft Intune, and Ivanti, including detection logic, dependencies, retry behavior, and deployment scheduling.Build and maintain a representative test environment and develop automated validation procedures to confirm successful Trellix removal, SentinelOne installation, policy assignment, application compatibility, performance, and rollback functionality.Support testing efforts by identifying and troubleshooting deployment issues, documenting findings, and providing feedback to the project team throughout the validation process.Plan and execute pilot deployments, followed by phased enterprise-wide rollout activities, including real-time monitoring and remediation of deployment issues.Act as the senior technical escalation resource during deployment and hypercare phases while partnering with vendor support teams as needed.Participate in project planning, design reviews, risk assessments, status meetings, documentation efforts, and knowledge transfer activities.

Required Experience:

8+ years of experience in Endpoint Engineering, Security Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.Experience supporting at least one enterprise-scale endpoint security platform migration.Strong hands-on experience with Trellix ENS and ePO, including policies, exclusions, agent communication, uninstall procedures, tamper protection, and cleanup activities.Strong hands-on experience administering SentinelOne Singularity, including agents, policies, sites/groups, exclusions, detection and mitigation settings, rollback capabilities, and platform upgrades.Advanced PowerShell scripting experience focused on automated deployment, validation, remediation, logging, and rollback processes.Working knowledge of Bash scripting.Expert-level Windows endpoint administration across Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows IoT/LTSC, and Windows Server environments.Strong troubleshooting experience involving endpoint security products, application conflicts, service and driver issues, networking, DNS, certificates, proxies, and TLS communications.Experience deploying software at enterprise scale through MECM/SCCM, Microsoft Intune, and/or Ivanti.Experience operating within formal change management and release management processes, including testing, QA, UAT, pilot deployments, and production rollouts.Experience supporting large distributed environments such as retail, restaurant, hospitality, branch-based, or multi-site enterprise organizations where endpoints are remotely managed and business critical.Ability to support occasional after-hours and weekend deployment activities as project phases require.

Must-Have Skills:

SentinelOneTrellix / McAfee ePOENSPowerShellSCCM / MECMIntuneIvantiWindows Endpoint EngineeringEnterprise Software DeploymentEndpoint Security Migration

Ideal Background:

Large-scale endpoint migrationsEnterprise device managementRetail, restaurant, branch, or distributed environments10,000+ endpoint deploymentsStrong scripting and automation experienceHands-on engineering rather than project management or architecture-only backgrounds

jobs.description:
Company Description

WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy.

As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in.

We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide.

This isn’t theoretical work. It’s real systems, at real scale, people solving some of the hardest challenges in technology today.

We’re looking for people who want to build, solve, and operate at that level.

Join us and let’s shape the future of data.

Job Description

Position Overview

WD is seeking a Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic partner and operational advisor jointly supporting the VP of Business Applications and the VP of Digital Employee Experience. This role sits at the intersection of two complementary IT organizations, connecting strategy to execution across both portfolios and ensuring the combined leadership team operates with shared clarity, alignment, and accountability.

The Chief of Staff works alongside both VP leaders to drive organizational priorities forward, maintain operational rhythm, and represent IT interests across cross-functional forums. Given the dual scope of this role, the ability to hold context across multiple domains, balance competing priorities thoughtfully, and build trust with two distinct leadership teams is essential. This is a high-visibility, high-trust role that requires sound judgment, executive presence, strong communication instincts, and the ability to operate effectively across a complex, matrixed global technology organization.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Strategic Enablement & Organizational Leadership

Partner with both the VP of Business Applications and the VP of Digital Employee Experience to develop, refine, and communicate IT strategic priorities across their respective organizations and to shared stakeholders

Translate strategy across both IT portfolios into actionable roadmaps, plans, and organizational commitments

Serve as a thought partner to both VP leaders on organizational decisions, planning trade-offs, and priority setting

Help identify opportunities for alignment, synergy, and shared execution across the Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience organizations

Represent both VP leadership interests in cross-functional forums, planning sessions, and executive reviews as appropriate

Help shape and steward the IT organizational narrative across both domains, ensuring consistent messaging for internal and external audiences

Operational Execution & Cadence

Own the operating cadence across both IT organizations, including leadership team rhythms, QBRs, strategic planning cycles, and technology reviews

Drive accountability across both leadership teams for key commitments, deliverables, and milestones

Proactively identify and resolve operational blockers, escalating or connecting stakeholders where needed

Maintain visibility into initiative portfolios across both organizations, surfacing risks, dependencies, and progress for leadership review

Identify and improve operational processes that span or connect the two IT organizations to increase overall efficiency and effectiveness

Decision Support & Executive Communications

Synthesize complex information from across both IT organizations and the broader business to inform leadership decisions and recommendations

Lead development of executive presentations, strategic briefings, and business updates on behalf of both VP leaders

Translate technical and operational content into clear, compelling narratives for business and executive audiences

Prepare both VP leaders for high-stakes meetings, technology reviews, and partner forums

Manage strategic communications flowing from both IT organizations to internal teams and business partners

Financial & Resource Planning Partnership

Partner with Finance to ensure budget planning, forecasting, and expense management processes across both IT organizations are well-coordinated and accurately represented to leadership

Maintain leadership-level visibility into headcount, resource allocation, and workforce planning across both portfolios in partnership with HR

Support both VP leaders in making informed resource prioritization decisions aligned with organizational strategy and demand

Track and flag material variances in budget or resource plans across either organization with appropriate context and recommended actions

Performance Visibility & Insights

Oversee tracking and reporting of key performance indicators spanning both the Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience portfolios

Ensure both VP leaders have timely, accurate, and actionable visibility into organizational performance through consolidated dashboards and scorecards

Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across both organizations and bring them forward with context and perspective

Drive consistent, high-quality reporting practices across both IT organizations

Cross-Functional Coordination & Stakeholder Alignment

Serve as a primary coordination point bridging Business Applications, Digital Employee Experience, and other IT domains including Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Architecture

Build and maintain strong working relationships with key business partner organizations including Finance, HR, Supply Chain, and Operations

Facilitate alignment across shared IT priorities, service commitments, and technology roadmaps that span both VP organizations

Help navigate organizational complexity and resolve cross-functional friction points on behalf of both VP leaders

Organizational Health & Culture

Contribute to a healthy, high-performing culture across both IT organizations by modeling clarity, accountability, and inclusion in day-to-day operations

Support both VP leaders in communication efforts that keep their respective organizations informed, engaged, and connected to strategy

Help identify and address organizational gaps, team dynamics, and structural issues that may affect effectiveness across either portfolio

Champion continuous improvement across IT ways of working, team collaboration, and shared organizational practices

Special Projects & Strategic Initiatives

Lead or co-lead high-priority special projects on behalf of either or both VP leaders

Support transformation and modernization initiatives across both IT portfolios through research, analysis, coordination, and stakeholder engagement

Take end-to-end ownership of defined strategic workstreams from scoping through delivery

Provide analytical and strategic support for emerging priorities and leadership agenda items across both organizations

Scope & Impact

Operates as a direct extension of two IT VP leaders across strategic and operational matters spanning Business Applications and Digital Employee Experience

Regular engagement with VP and C-suite-level stakeholders across IT and the broader business

Cross-functional reach spanning multiple IT domains and major business partner organizations

Meaningful influence over how two distinct but complementary IT organizations operate, communicate, and deliver on shared and individual commitments across the enterprise

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business, Computer Science, Finance, or a related field

8 or more years of progressive experience in IT strategy, IT operations, business operations, chief of staff, or senior program leadership roles

Demonstrated ability to operate effectively at the VP or executive level in a complex, matrixed organization

Proven ability to manage and balance competing priorities across multiple stakeholders and organizational contexts simultaneously

Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a track record of executive-level storytelling and presentation development

Strong analytical capability with experience synthesizing data into strategic recommendations

Sound judgment, discretion, and the ability to handle sensitive organizational information with care

Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities with composure and clarity in a fast-paced environment

Preferred

Experience in a formal Chief of Staff, Senior Director of Strategy, or equivalent advisory role within an enterprise IT organization

Background in technology, manufacturing, semiconductor, or related industries

Familiarity with IT financial management, portfolio planning, and vendor management practices

Experience supporting multiple VP or C-suite leaders concurrently within a global organization

Exposure to IT strategic planning, digital transformation, and organizational change management

Knowledge of ITIL, Agile, or related IT service and delivery frameworks

MBA or advanced degree strongly preferred

* Proven experience managing **Microsoft Intune** in large enterprise environments.
* Strong knowledge of **Windows Autopilot** , **Microsoft Entra ID** , and **Windows 10/11** endpoint management.
* Experience with **PowerShell** automation and scripting.
* Ability to work autonomously in international environments.

⭐ Nice to Have

**Responsabilidades**

* Ejecutar las tareas de operación y mantenimiento diario de los controles de seguridad de endpoints (incluyendo EDR, Antimalware, FIM, DLP de Endpoint, etc.) en ambientes on-premise y cloud, para asegurar la protección continua de los activos críticos y la información de la organización.

* Colaborar con equipos técnicos (SOC, Ingeniería de Detección, infraestructura, cloud, DevOps, aplicaciones) para configurar y optimizar los controles de seguridad de endpoints, asegurando la alineación con los objetivos de seguridad.

**Perfil Deseado**

* Enfoque Operativo: El área se dedica a la operación técnica diaria, brindando seguridad y soporte directo a los puntos finales (endpoints).
* Experiencia con: Controles de Endpoints: Consolas de gestión de EDR, Antimalware, FIM (Monitoreo de Integridad de Archivos) y DLP de Endpoint.
* CrowdStrike (EDR principal): Se requiere como mínimo un año de experiencia en su implementación u operación
