jobs.description:
**Descripción Del Puesto** El **Client Executive Endpoint** apoya a los socios en sus iniciativas a nivel nacional y global, identificando, desarrollando y gestionando relaciones con clientes de múltiples marcas a nivel directivo corporativo. Su objetivo es posicionar el valor global de TD SYNNEX, al tiempo que brinda a la dirección local orientación estratégica y acompañamiento en la ejecución de planes orientados a maximizar la participación de mercado.

¡Lleva tu carrera al siguiente nivel como **Client Executive !** **Lo Que Harás**

* Diseña, estructura y gestiona el plan de negocio y el modelo de precios para los clientes, incluyendo:
* La definición de la propuesta de valor y el portafolio de soluciones del socio.
* El diseño del mapa de cobertura geográfica para maximizar alcance y penetración de mercado.
* El desarrollo de un plan de marketing integral que abarque nuevos clientes, la base instalada y el negocio recurrente (renovaciones y cuotas anuales).
* El establecimiento de objetivos de ventas trimestrales y anuales, así como el seguimiento, análisis y reporte de resultados frente a dichos objetivos.
* La planificación del calendario de participación en programas de formación, certificación y adopción de Solutions Path.
* La realización de revisiones mensuales de desempeño comercial, definiendo planes de acción correctivos y de mejora.
* La ejecución de revisiones trimestrales de negocio junto con la dirección de la unidad de negocio y los equipos de proveedores correspondientes.
* Disponibilidad para viajar hasta un 75 % del tiempo
* Amplía la cobertura de cuentas para fortalecer relaciones estratégicas y acelerar el crecimiento del negocio, mediante:
* Desarrollo de relaciones a nivel directivo con clientes, socios estratégicos e ISVs.
* Incremento de la cuota de mercado a través de nuevas líneas de negocio y una mejor experiencia del cliente con TD SYNNEX, apoyada en servicios y soluciones de valor.
* Identificación de oportunidades comerciales a nivel corporativo y liderazgo de planes para posicionar las capacidades de TD SYNNEX ante la alta dirección del cliente.
* Comunicación proactiva con clientes para detectar problemas de satisfacción, analizar causas raíz y prevenir incidencias.
* Diseño y coordinación de planes de acción correctivos con los equipos internos correspondientes (incluyendo Services).
* Gestión de la estrategia global del cliente.
* Promoción del trabajo colaborativo entre áreas para maximizar el valor de TD SYNNEX y apoyar los objetivos del cliente.

**Lo Que Estamos Buscando**

* Nivel académico requerido: Profesional en Ingenieria de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o afines
* 3+ años de experiencia en roles como Product Manager o Business Development Manager.
* Conocimientos técnicos requeridos: en el sector de Tecnología
* Conocimientos o habilidades: Comerciales; Proyección presupuestal; Desarrollo de Negocios; Responsabilidad de Cuota; Conocimientos en soluciones Endpoint
* Competencias: Orientación a los resultados - Comunicación - Impacto e influencia comercial - Proactividad Capacidad de organización, Estructuración.
* Desarrolla soluciones a problemas complejos donde el análisis de situaciones o datos requiere una evaluación profunda de variables.
* Determina el mejor método para lograr resultados y puede hacer sugerencias para mejorar las políticas y los procedimientos.
* El trabajo se realiza sin una dirección apreciable usando criterio y discreción independientes. Ejerce una libertad considerable para determinar los objetivos y enfoques de las asignaciones. El trabajo puede ser revisado a un alto nivel.
* Representa a la organización como contacto principal en proyectos o contratos. Interactúa con frecuencia con los profesionales senior y la gerencia y, a menudo, tiene que coordinar el trabajo entre departamentos u organizaciones.
* Las acciones impactan en la organización. La falta de cumplimiento del trabajo o las decisiones erróneas darán como resultado la incapacidad de alcanzar objetivos organizacionales cruciales y pueden tener un efecto prolongado, además de resultar en el gasto de recursos sustanciales.

**Otra Educación / Certificaciones**

* Especialización o Maestría en Negocios, Mercadeo (Deseable)
* Certificaciones en la industria (Deseable)
* Competente en inglés (nivel B2 o superior) Deseable

**Las Condiciones De Trabajo**

* Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido).

Tú qué sacas de esto?

* Haz crecer tu carrera: nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles. También puedes acelerar su camino hacia el éxito con programas formales sobre liderazgo y desarrollo profesional, y muchos más cursos a pedido.
* Trabaja con proveedores de clase mundial: nuestros representantes de televentas actuales están trabajando con algunas de las marcas más importantes en tecnología.
* Eleva tu bienestar personal: aumenta tu bienestar financiero, físico y mental a través de seminarios, eventos y nuestro Programa global de asistencia para el empoderamiento de la vida (LEAP por sus siglas en Inglés).
* Diversidad, equidad e inclusión: no es solo una frase para nosotros; valorando cada voz es cómo tenemos éxito. Únete a nosotros para celebrar nuestra diversidad global a través de educación inclusiva, conversaciones significativas entre pares y oportunidades equitativas de crecimiento y desarrollo.

¿No cumples con todos los requisitos? Aplica de todos modos:

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

jobs.description:
With 75 years of experience, our focus is on helping the most vulnerable children overcome poverty and experience fullness of life. We help children of all backgrounds, even in the most dangerous places, inspired by our Christian faith.

Come join our 31,000+ staff working in nearly 100 countries and share the joy of transforming vulnerable children's life stories!

**Key Responsibilities** IMPORTANT INFORMATION:

* All CVs should be submitted in English.
* This position is open to candidates based in countries where World Vision International is legally registered to operate.

As an**Endpoint Engineer,** you will play a critical role in maintaining, monitoring, and supporting global IT systems and infrastructure. You will lead multiple projects, providing technical guidance to Endpoint and Systems Administrators, while ensuring the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise computing platforms.

You will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing the systems operating environment---including servers, storage, and backup solutions---to meet evolving business needs. Your expertise will span across technologies such as Windows, Linux, VMware, Active Directory, DNS, and DHCP. You will also manage access controls, security applications, and system backups, ensuring a secure and highly available environment. This role demands strong troubleshooting skills for complex hardware, software, and basic network issues. You will analyze system failures, respond to incidents, and execute contingency plans to maintain operational continuity. Additionally, you will support 24/7 operations, lead disaster recovery efforts, and manage off-site storage processes.

Success in this role requires excellent communication and collaboration skills. You will work closely with system users, technical teams, and vendors, providing expert support and training as needed. A strong customer service orientation and a proactive approach to problem-solving are essential.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field
* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise-level servers and IT infrastructure.
* At least 5+ years of experience designing, configuring, deploying, and optimizing server hardware and operating environments.
* 5-7 years of progressive experience in information technology, with a focus on endpoint systems and enterprise computing platforms.

**Continuation Of Major Responsibilities** **PROJECT PLANNING:**

* Leads or consults short- and long-term project planning efforts with team members, clients and other IT groups.
* Develops cost/time estimates.
* Documents discussion and agreements.

**TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:** Works with systems engineers to understand technical requirements.

**DESIGN/DEVELOP:** Integrates solutions with other applications and platforms outside the framework.

**Maintenance**

* Performs routine maintenance tasks for infrastructure systems such as backups, patch management and hot fixes.
* Develops strategies to manage the frequency of appropriate support package/patch application.
* Monitors health of systems and provides appropriate recommendations, when required.

**Administration**

* Coordinates and validates activities.
* Manages user access to, systems, servers, and files.
* Administers the setup of new profiles, creates and updates access permissions and maintains user accounts.
* Installs, configures and maintains system hardware and software components.
* Maintains tracking and configuration documentation and plans.
* Supervising the installation of system upgrades and service packs.
* Determines if inactive accounts should be deleted.
* Administers Storage Area Network (SAN).

**Performance Monitoring**

* Supervises the monitoring procedures and evaluates problems identified by team members.
* Ensures that capacity workload modeling and availability analysis is performed.
* Monitors system-operating capacity in terms of disk space, tape storage, memory and CPU utilization.
* Reviews performance and control reports.
* Recommends settings changes to the operating system to improve performance and reliability.
* Develops, maintains, recommends, documents and supports tools and backend utilities to provide capacity planning management.

**Testing**

* Leads or provides technical direction for the planning, designing, and execution of testing efforts.
* Ensures that tests evaluate all possible impacts on the current infrastructure or application.

**Continuous Improvements**

* Recommends performance metrics.
* Analyzes and reports on operational metrics to understand performance and to ensure success in process improvements.

**System Job Scheduling**

* Translates business and technical requirements to develop automation specifications that span more than one business area.
* Updates job schedule based on current priorities and special handling requests.
* Ensures reliability and availability of platforms.
* Schedules maintenance and repairs.

**Computer Operations**

* Coordinates production job processing.
* Ensures that maintenance procedures are executed.
* Updates job schedule based on current priorities and special handling requests.
* Operates computer hardware systems and related peripheral equipment.
* Monitors systems on a 24x7 schedule.
* Performs maintenance procedures.
* Validates input and output data for completeness and accuracy.
* Analyzes job processes and recommends improvements.
* Reviews historical data for trend analysis.

**Production Support**

* Coordinates problem resolution among team members.
* Documents, monitors, reports, and manages the resolution of systemic issues.
* Works with Systems Engineers and Architects when issues appear systemic or cannot be resolved.
* Recommends procedures and controls for problem resolution or creates temporary solutions until permanent solutions can be implemented.
* Documents problem status and resolution.
* Develops checklists and scripts for resolving routine problems.

**Security**

* Works with IT Security, where needed, in investigations and/or audits of systems.
* Analyzes audit trails to detect systematic security violations.
* Reports security issues when appropriate.
* Ensures security requirements are adhered to.

**Business Continuity**

* Administers archival activities such as installing, upgrading, configuring, and scheduling and monitoring, jobs.
* Performs data image archiving.
* Performs off-site storage procedures.
* Verifies that system backups run successfully.

**POLICIES, PROCEDURES, AND STANDARDS:** Ensures compliance with policies, procedures and standards.

**SERVICE LEVEL AGREEMENTS (SLAs):** Monitors production, outputs, and services to ensure that SLA's, and other quality metrics, are being met.

**Documentation/User Guides**

* Writes, reviews and/or maintains technical documentation for product environments.
* Ensures documentation is developed and maintained.

**COMMUNICATIONS/CONSULTATION:** Supports and participates in the formal reporting of project status.

**COACHING/MENTORING:** Provides coaching and guidance to team members.

**RESEARCH/EVALUATION:** Evaluates future technologies and makes recommendations.

**Applicant Types Accepted** Local Applicants Only

*World Vision is a Christian humanitarian organisation with a mission centred on following Jesus Christ in service to the world´s most vulnerable children. Therefore, in all locations to the fullest extent legally permissible, the successful applicant will affirm our core documents, observe conduct compatible with Christian principles, serve at a high level of professional ethics and strive to act in accordance with cultural sensitivities. Furthermore, regular attendance with team and office devotions, chapel and prayer gatherings are expected in line with policies in the World Vision host location and its departments.*

jobs.description:
_At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying. Want to learn more about life at Klaviyo? Visit [klaviyo.com/careers](http://klaviyo.com/careers) to see how we empower creators to own their own destiny._

At Klaviyo, we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives each Klaviyo (we call ourselves Klaviyos) brings to our workplace each and every day. We believe everyone deserves a fair shot at success and appreciate the experiences each person brings beyond the traditional job requirements. If you’re a close but not exact match with the description, we hope you’ll still consider applying.

#### **About the team:**

Klaviyo’s global corporate Information Technology (IT) team is responsible for providing technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos around the world. Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo’s continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment.

The IT Systems team is primarily responsible for SaaS systems administration and end-to-end lifecycle management, building automation, and engineering solutions for both other internal teams and the business. The IT Systems team is highly collaborative, working closely with the IT Searchbar team, our end-user support team as well as with our Security, Risk, and Trust teams and the broader Engineering department.

#### **About the role:**

As a Senior IT Systems Engineer on the IT Systems team, you own the design, implementation, and long-term health of the enterprise systems Klaviyo runs on identity, endpoint management, and the SaaS platforms every Klaviyo touches. You will lead projects end to end, from SSO/SCIM rollouts to complex multi-tool integrations and automations, and you will be trusted to take an ambiguous business problem, define the problem statement yourself, and deliver a solution that scales. You will partner with operations, engineering, Security, and the IT Searchbar team, and act as a technical escalation point when systems break.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will use AI fluently in your own work and help design AI-assisted workflows into the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a senior individual contributor role: no direct reports, high autonomy, and real ownership. We are looking for someone who has already run systems at scale, holds opinions grounded in experience, and can be handed a domain and trusted to run it.

#### **How you’ll have an impact**

- Own systems, not tickets. You will take a domain identity, endpoint, or a set of core SaaS platforms and be accountable for its reliability, security, and roadmap, raising the decisions that need to go higher and driving everything else yourself.
- Lead projects end to end at pace: scope the work, design the solution, plan the rollout and the rollback, communicate the change, and land it without skipping testing, peer review, or documentation to hit a date.
- Turn ambiguous business needs into clear problem statements and systems that hold up, so Klaviyos spend their time on their work instead of fighting their tools.
- Set the technical bar: clean configuration, least-privilege access by default, automation over manual toil, and runbooks the rest of the team can operate from without you in the room.
- Define what success looks like before you build, then prove it with data tickets deflected, provisioning time saved, coverage and compliance gaps closed.
- Raise the people around you: review others’ work, mentor engineers earlier in their careers, and give and receive direct, useful feedback.
- Act as a technical escalation point for complex system issues, drive root cause rather than symptoms, and feed what you learn back into the platform so the same incident does not happen twice.

#### **Requirements:**

- 4+ years of hands-on experience as a systems engineer or systems administrator, with a track record of owning enterprise systems in production not just operating them, but deciding how they should work.
- You define problem statements yourself. You can take a vague or contested business need, scope it, drive alignment with stakeholders, and deliver with minimal direction without losing the thread when priorities shift.
- Deep working knowledge across a wide range of IT systems, including enterprise device management, identity and access management, and endpoint security.

#### **About the team:**

Klaviyo’s global corporate Information Technology (IT) team is responsible for providing technology systems, administration, and support to Klaviyos around the world. Our main goal is to ensure that Klaviyos everywhere have a strong technology foundation to do great work. The IT Team solves problems using technology and provides Klaviyo’s continued scalability and sustainable employee growth in a rapidly evolving environment.

The IT Systems team is primarily responsible for SaaS systems administration and end-to-end lifecycle management, building automation, and engineering solutions for both other internal teams and the business. The IT Systems team is highly collaborative, working closely with the IT Searchbar team, our end-user support team as well as with our Security, Networking, AI, Risk, and Trust teams, and the broader Engineering department.

#### **About the role:**

As an IT Systems Engineer on the IT Systems team, you will help design, implement, and maintain the enterprise systems every Klaviyo depends on identity, endpoint management, and the SaaS platforms that run the company. You’ll contribute to projects that range from SSO/SCIM implementations to multi-tool integrations and automations, with a focus on scalability and efficiency. You’ll work closely with operations, engineering, and the IT Searchbar team to keep systems healthy and help work through technical escalations.

Klaviyo is building an AI-first future, and IT is where a lot of that gets real. You will be expected to use AI in your day-to-day work to research, script, document, and troubleshoot faster, and to help bring AI-assisted workflows to the systems we run for the rest of the company. This is a hands-on, high-learning role for someone early in their systems career who wants to build depth quickly alongside senior engineers.

- Interest in learning how to automate workflows and repetitive tasks.

- Understanding of the importance of clean, concise controls and easily editable security functionality within tools, and a willingness to support access reviews and audit evidence requests for SOC 2 and SOX.
- AI proficiency: you already use AI as part of how you work. You are comfortable using LLM assistants and agents such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Glean to research, draft and debug scripts, write documentation, and cut down repetitive work, and you can explain where AI accelerated you and where you applied your own judgment to verify its output. You are curious about applying AI to IT problems.
- Foundational scripting skills with an interest in further developing these skills. Experience with Bash, PowerShell, or Python is a plus.
- Familiarity with the identity lifecycle onboarding, role changes, and offboarding and why timely, accurate access matters.
- Comfort reading API documentation and working with REST and JSON to connect systems together, or a clear appetite to learn.
- A disciplined approach to change: you test before you deploy, document what you changed, and communicate clearly with the people it affects.
- Strong written communication and a habit of documenting your work.
- Participation in an after-hours on-call rotation with the IT Systems team is required for site-specific or business-blocking issues.

- Familiarity with SSO and automation solutions such as Workato, Okta Workflows, n8n, or similar.
- Basic understanding of enterprise-scale networking topics including routing, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and corporate Wi-Fi.
- Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth IT environment is preferred.
- Interest in developing skills to build applications and tools that utilize APIs.
- Familiarity with AWS and GCP concepts such as VPC, EC2, Security Groups, ACLs, and IAM is a plus.
- Experience building with AI beyond the chat window prompt and context engineering, connecting an LLM to systems via APIs or MCP, or standing up an AI-assisted workflow or agent that saved real time.
- Experience administering an ITSM or ticketing platform such as Freshservice or Jira Service Management, including forms, workflows, and reporting.
- Relevant certifications such as Jamf 100/200, Okta Certified Professional, CompTIA A+, Network+, or Security+, or AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud fundamentals.

jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

 Our philosophy:

- We believe in relentless automation of repetitive tasks.

- We have the curiosity and drive to dig deep and find creative solutions.

- We believe our goal is to find the right solution rather than always being right.

- We provide exceptional customer service to our teams and trading desks.

- We care more that the right thing is done than about rigid job descriptions or boundaries.

 What you’ll do:

- Administer core Microsoft services: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, Exchange (on-premise, Online, hybrid).

- Deploy, maintain and support Windows Server environments (2016–2025).

- Support Microsoft cloud services (Entra ID, OneDrive, Copilot, Microsoft 365 services).

- Configure single sign on and federation (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM).

- Triage and resolve tickets from the operations queue; respond to critical production incidents.

- Implement planned and ad hoc changes in accordance with firmwide change management processes.

- Maintain clear system documentation and capture specialized configurations as repeatable runbooks.

- Participate in a global support team with on call rotation and occasional weekend maintenance.

 Your background:

- Experience managing Windows Server infrastructure in high visibility, mission critical environments.

- Experience administering Windows Server services: Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, Failover Clustering.

- Experience with Entra ID, Exchange (Server/Online/Hybrid) and MECM (SCCM) is preferred.

- You can use scripts (e.g. PowerShell, Python) to automate routine administrative tasks.

- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, server hardware and VM deployments.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills. You can work across teams and have evidence-based discussions on technical and operational topics.

- You are eager to learn, collaborate, and find solutions under interesting constraints.

 Bonus points if you have:

- Experience with Splunk, Grafana, Alertmanager, Prometheus.

- Familiarity with DevOps/CI CD and IaC practices, containerization and Kubernetes.

- Prior experience in the trading or financial services industry.

The annual base salary range for this position is $120,000 to $160,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

 For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice .

  California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice .

jobs.description:
Who We Are

DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best-in-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com.

About The Role

Role Overview

This is a platform-ownership seat, not a support-ticket seat. Reporting to the Manager, Corporate IT in our NYC Global HQ, the Sr. Corporate Systems Engineer owns end-to-end administration and governance of DoubleVerify's core collaboration stack — Google Workspace and Slack — across roughly 300–400 users and ~100 applications, for a C-suite-heavy headquarters (our CEO, COO, and CFO are in-office regularly).

Beyond the collaboration stack, this role also covers conference room AV, MDM/endpoint management, ticketing/ITSM automation, and white-glove technical support for our NYC HQ leadership team (our CEO, COO, and CFO are in-office regularly). We're looking for someone technical, curious, and comfortable figuring things out — not someone who has already done every single thing on this list at another company.

Key Responsibilities

Administer Google Workspace and Slack — guest access, security and compliance settings, groups, org units, and rules — with sound day-to-day fluency across both platforms.Build integrations connecting Slack and Google Workspace to other internal systems, using APIs, webhooks, and app frameworks.Design, build, and ship Slack bots and workflows — including AI-powered bots (e.g., LLM-backed automation, smart triage, intelligent routing) — that solve real problems for end users, not just configure existing apps.Provide backend engineering support for end-user-facing automations, with genuine insight into what's happening underneath the hood.Exercise sound risk judgment before making changes to groups, org units, and permission rules that affect access or security — thinking through blast radius, testing, and rollback.Own conference room AV and collaboration technology across the NYC HQ footprint (Crestron, Neat, Zoom Rooms, WebEx, Logitech, DisplayLink) — from hardware rollouts through day-to-day reliability.Manage MDM/endpoint administration across ~100 applications and 300–400 users, using tools such as Jamf and Workspace ONE.Own the Corporate Systems ticketing queue — triaging, prioritizing, and resolving within SLA, and building automations that measurably reduce recurring ticket volume or support time.Provide direct, white-glove technical support to C-level executives and leadership.Build and maintain internal documentation — SOPs, troubleshooting guides, and self-service resources.

About You

You'll bring solid, real-world Google Workspace and Slack administration experience — but what we're really looking for is someone who can go further: build integrations, ship Slack bots and workflows (including AI-powered ones), and provide the backend engineering support that makes end-user automation possible. You'll also exercise good judgment on risk when making changes to groups, org units, and permission rules that affect access and security across the company.

Required Experience & Skills

Solid, hands-on experience administering Google Workspace and Slack — you don't need to have been the sole owner of the entire platform at a prior company, but you should be comfortable and fluent with day-to-day admin work (delegation, security settings, groups and rules).Real experience building something on top of Slack and/or Google Workspace — an integration, a bot, or an automation — using APIs, webhooks, or app frameworks. Preferred Experience & Skills

Okta or other identity/SSO experience beyond basic app assignment (provisioning rules, SCIM, group-based access).Experience with GAM or Google Admin console scripting for bulk user/group management.Experience with enterprise conferencing platforms (Google Meet, Zoom, MS Teams).Experience with IT onboarding processes and hardware logistics.

This position is full-time and located in our New York City headquarters offices offering a hybrid work model from office and remote.

jobs.title: Associate Manager, Modern Endpoint Engineer
jobs.summary: SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®,...
jobs.description:
SC Johnson has been leading with purpose for 140 years, building high-quality products and iconic brands found in homes, schools and businesses in virtually every country worldwide – including OFF!®, Raid®, Glade®, Windex®, Scrubbing Bubbles®, Ziploc®, Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day®, method®, Autan®, Baygon®, Mr Muscle®, Duck®, Lysoform® and more.

The 13,000 people of our global, fifth-generation family company are committed to making the world a better place today and for future generations.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Associate Manager, Modern Endpoint Engineer, you will drive modernization and technical direction for a highly visible endpoint platform, ensuring solutions meet business needs while balancing security, supportability, and end-user experience. This role also owns key architecture deliverables within the Endpoint space.

The role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with accountability for architecture governance, operating model discipline, and design quality—ensuring solutions are scalable, aligned to standards, and consistently executed.

You will partner closely with the Endpoint Manager and engineering team to drive roadmap alignment, solution design, and execution across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.

This role works cross-functionally—particularly with InfoSec (GIS)—to integrate modern deployment solutions and cloud-first strategies, supporting project delivery, M&A activity, and ongoing operational needs.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

-
Lead endpoint solutioning across Windows, macOS, and mobile, combining hands-on engineering expertise with conceptual and logical architecture design

-
Define and enforce endpoint architecture governance, including standards, templates, checklists, policies, and quality frameworks

-
Define and manage endpoint roadmap, including feature prioritization, vendor insights, roadmap cadence, and improvement of project submission and resource estimation quality

-
Partner with engineering teams to validate feasibility, guide PoCs, and ensure solutions align with architecture standards and enterprise design expectations

-
Develop and maintain deep expertise in the endpoint ecosystem, including hardware, OS, applications, security, and end-user experience considerations

-
Set and monitor MSP standards, SLAs/XLAs, and performance metrics while ensuring adherence to security policies and infrastructure management processes

-
Guide teams on architecture practices and collaborate across teams to drive consistent execution, continuous improvement, and resolution of complex technical issues, including leading major incident response, engaging vendors, and providing on-call support as needed

 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE YOU’LL BRING

-
University Degree and 5+ years of relevant experience

-
5+ years of experience in the Endpoint and Desktop Management space including but not limited to systems design, implementation and support.

  -
Strong understanding of Modern Device Management concepts, the Digital Workspace Industry direction, Enterprise sized Endpoint ecosystem use cases, including Windows OS, Mac OS, and Mobile concepts.

-
Minimum 2 years of demonstrated experience in two or more of the following:

  -
Administration, configuration and design for Modern Endpoint Management (Microsoft Intune, JAMF)

  -
Experience working with at least two of the following: Active Directory, Microsoft Azure AD, SCCM, GPO, or CPC

-
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship for full-time employment.

 PREFERRED EXPERIENCES AND SKILLS

•Transformative experience with Endpoint services in medium to large sized company.

•Experience in mergers and acquisitions work.

•Proven track record of a cross team collaborative approach

•Experience with Microsoft Office 365

•Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to overcome difficult challenges

•Strong interpersonal and team building skills

•Microsoft and/or Intune certifications are a plus

 JOB REQUIREMENTS

-
Full Time- regular schedule for corporate

-
Remote work available once a week after 90-day onboarding period.

-
This role is not eligible for relocation

 BENEFITS AND PERKS

SC Johnson’s total compensation packages are at or above industry levels. In addition to salary, total packages may include bonuses, long-term incentives, matching 401(k) contributions and profit sharing based on company profitability, job level and years of service. As a family company, we’re committed to providing benefits such as subsidized health care plans, maternity/paternity/adoption leave, flexible work arrangements, vacation purchase options, recreation and fitness centers, childcare, counseling services and more.

 Inclusion & Diversity

We’re a global business, with people from every culture, ethnicity, race, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age and ability. We recognize the breadth of human experience, and we work to celebrate it. It is our goal to build a diverse, inclusive and supportive work environment where all people can thrive.

We’re committed to ongoing efforts that help us attract, hire, and retain diverse talent who want to build a positive, inclusive environment. Read more about our ongoing initiatives at https://jobs.scjohnson.com/inclusion .

 Better Together

   At SC Johnson, we believe people achieve their best when they collaborate and work together in person. We value connection to strengthen teamwork, accelerate problem solving, and drive innovation.

 Equal Opportunity Employer

The policy of the Company is to ensure equal opportunity for all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, age, gender identity, gender expression, disability, citizenship, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in any active or reserve component of the U.S. or state military forces, genetic history or information or any other category protected by law.

 Accommodation Requests

If you are an individual with a disability and you need an accommodation or other assistance during the application process, please call our Human Resources department at 262-260-3343 or email your request to SCJHR@scj.com . All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply. Download the EEO Know Your Rights poster for more information.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
Ready to shape the future of the digital workplace and deliver a seamless technology experience for employees around the globe?

IFF is a global leader in food ingredients, flavors, fragrances, and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.

The role is based in St. Louis, Missouri or Union Beach, New Jersey, with consideration for a U.S.-based hybrid work arrangement. Be part of a strategic, solution-oriented, collaborative team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
 Where You'll Make a Difference

- Define and execute the global endpoint management strategy and roadmap supporting approximately 6,000 employees.

- Establish standards, policies, and lifecycle management practices for endpoint technologies.

- Lead Windows 11, Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Manager, Autopilot, and Entra ID environments.

- Drive automation and operational efficiency through PowerShell and modern management practices.

- Own the strategy and effectiveness of the Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) platform.

- Partner with security, infrastructure, service management, and regional IT teams.

- Oversee vendor relationships, service level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).

- Lead endpoint modernization, refresh programs, and business transformation activities.

- Govern enterprise mobile device management and print services globally.

 What Makes You the Right Fit

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.

- 8+ years of experience managing enterprise endpoint technologies.

- Deep expertise in Windows endpoint engineering and device management.

- Advanced knowledge of Intune, Endpoint Manager, Autopilot, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365.

- Experience supporting Citrix Virtual Desktop Infrastructure environments.

- Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance, and Zero Trust principles.

- Experience managing iOS and Android mobile device platforms.

- Demonstrated success managing vendors and outsourced providers.

- Strong communication, stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

 How Would You Stand Out?

- Experience with Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop.

- Knowledge of ITIL service management practices and enterprise print solutions.

- Experience leading large-scale workplace transformation initiatives.

 Why Choose Us?

- Competitive Benefits (US): Competitive compensation, annual incentive opportunities, and comprehensive health and wellness programs. Our benefit package includes medical, dental, vision, 401(k), vacation, holidays, 16 weeks paid parental leave (maternity/paternity), and an annual bonus plan. IFF was also recognized by Newsweek as one of America's Greatest Workplaces for Perks & Benefits.

- Diversity & Inclusion (US): IFF has been recognized previously in the US on the Disability Equality Index® – Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion

- Innovation: Gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies and trailblazing advancements in food ingredients solutions and protection. Meaningful work helping advance solutions for the food ingredients industry.

- Global Collaboration: Be part of a global organization that values innovation, creativity, and collaborating amongst our diverse, cross-functional teams.

- Sustainability: Contribute to solutions that support a safer, healthier, and more sustainable world. IFF was recognized on the Forbes Net Zero Leaders 2026 list within the chemicals/materials sector.

 For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is currently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions. ​ The Food Ingredient business unit will remain part of IFF until close and, at such time, will transition to CVC Capital Partners. By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge awareness that the role is part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.

We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.

Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Radisson Hotel Group is one of the world's largest hotel groups with ten distinctive hotel brands, and more than 1,660 hotels in operation and under development in 100+ countries. The Group's overarching brand promise is Every Moment Matters with a signature *Yes I Can!* service ethos. People are at the core of our business success and future. Our people are true Moment Makers and together we bring the culture, spirit, environment and opportunities that empower you to be your best, every day, everywhere, every time. Together, we make Every Moment Matter.

Job Description
- --------------

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Master Data Management Intern to join our Data Governance and MDM team. This role offers hands-on experience in managing, analysing, and improving enterprise data, while supporting key business processes and digital transformation initiatives.

++Key responsibilities include:++

- Assisting in data collection, cleansing, and validation activities to maintain high data quality

- Supporting master data creation, updates, and enrichment across systems (ERP, CRM, etc.)

- Helping with data quality analysis and reporting using tools like Excel, SQL, or Power BI dashboards

- Documenting data processes, workflows, and governance standards

- Collaborating with business users and IT teams to resolve data-related issues

- Participating in MDM-related projects, including testing and process improvement initiatives

**Start date**: October

**Duration**: 6 months

Qualifications
- -------------

- Eligibility to sign an internship agreement with an academic institution

- Proficiency in English

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or related field

- Basic understanding of databases, data management concepts, or data analytics

- Proficiency in MS Excel; exposure to SQL, Python, or Power BI tools is a plus

- Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a structured, process-driven environment

- Good communication and collaboration skills

Additional Information
- ---------------------

Why Join Radisson Hotel Group?

Live the Magic of Hospitality - Be part of a team that creates exceptional experiences and memorable moments every day. Let your Yes I Can! spirit shine as you bring hospitality to life.

Build a Great Career - No matter your background or experience, we invest in your growth, learning, and career development---helping you reach your full potential.

Experience the Team Spirit - Join a workplace that's inclusive, fun, and meaningful. We celebrate diversity, support one another and foster a sense of belonging through our Employee Resource Groups and inclusion initiatives.

Lead with Your Ambition - Your ideas, passion and drive matter! We empower you to make a difference---in hospitality, your community and beyond.

Enjoy Global \& Local Perks - No matter where you're located, you'll enjoy exclusive global benefits - like special hotel rates for you and your loved ones at our hotels worldwide. Plus, you'll have access to local perks and rewards tailored to your country, making your experience even more rewarding!

Enjoy benefits such as - up to 53% off your stay as a Team Member at over 1,500 Radisson Hotels worldwide

Guaranteed minimum of 30% off for your Friends \& Family

Exclusive Discounts on Breakfast, Food \& Beverage, Spa and more

Join us in shaping the future of hospitality! If you're ready to bring your talent, energy, and passion, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let's make every moment matter.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. If you need any adjustments during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.summary: Descripción del Puesto: El Client Executive Endpoint apoya a los socios en sus iniciativas a nivel nacional y global, identificando, desarrollando y gestionando relaciones con clientes de múltiples marcas a nivel directivo corporativo. Su objetivo es...
jobs.description: Descripción del Puesto: El Client Executive Endpoint apoya a los socios en sus iniciativas a nivel nacional y global, identificando, desarrollando y gestionando relaciones con clientes de múltiples marcas a nivel directivo corporativo. Su objetivo es posicionar el valor global de TD SYNNEX, al tiempo que brinda a la dirección local orientación estratégica y acompañamiento en la ejecución de planes orientados a maximizar la participación de mercado. ¡Lleva tu carrera al siguiente nivel como Client Executive ! Lo que harás: Diseña, estructura y gestiona el plan de negocio y el modelo de precios para los clientes, incluyendo: La definición de la propuesta de valor y el portafolio de soluciones del socio. El diseño del mapa de cobertura geográfica para maximizar alcance y penetración de mercado. El desarrollo de un plan de marketing integral que abarque nuevos clientes, la base instalada y el negocio recurrente (renovaciones y cuotas anuales). El establecimiento de objetivos de ventas trimestrales y anuales, así como el seguimiento, análisis y reporte de resultados frente a dichos objetivos. La planificación del calendario de participación en programas de formación, certificación y adopción de Solutions Path. La realización de revisiones mensuales de desempeño comercial, definiendo planes de acción correctivos y de mejora. La ejecución de revisiones trimestrales de negocio junto con la dirección de la unidad de negocio y los equipos de proveedores correspondientes. Disponibilidad para viajar hasta un 75 % del tiempo Amplía la cobertura de cuentas para fortalecer relaciones estratégicas y acelerar el crecimiento del negocio, mediante: Desarrollo de relaciones a nivel directivo con clientes, socios estratégicos e ISVs. Incremento de la cuota de mercado a través de nuevas líneas de negocio y una mejor experiencia del cliente con TD SYNNEX, apoyada en servicios y soluciones de valor. Identificación de oportunidades comerciales a nivel corporativo y liderazgo de planes para posicionar las capacidades de TD SYNNEX ante la alta dirección del cliente. Comunicación proactiva con clientes para detectar problemas de satisfacción, analizar causas raíz y prevenir incidencias. Diseño y coordinación de planes de acción correctivos con los equipos internos correspondientes (incluyendo Services). Gestión de la estrategia global del cliente. Promoción del trabajo colaborativo entre áreas para maximizar el valor de TD SYNNEX y apoyar los objetivos del cliente. Lo que estamos buscando: Nivel académico requerido: Profesional en Ingenieria de Sistemas o Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o afines 3+ años de experiencia en roles como Product Manager o Business Development Manager. Conocimientos técnicos requeridos: en el sector de Tecnología Conocimientos o habilidades: Comerciales; Proyección presupuestal; Desarrollo de Negocios; Responsabilidad de Cuota; Conocimientos en soluciones Endpoint Competencias: Orientación a los resultados - Comunicación - Impacto e influencia comercial -- Proactividad Capacidad de organización, Estructuración. Desarrolla soluciones a problemas complejos donde el análisis de situaciones o datos requiere una evaluación profunda de variables. Determina el mejor método para lograr resultados y puede hacer sugerencias para mejorar las políticas y los procedimientos. El trabajo se realiza sin una dirección apreciable usando criterio y discreción independientes. Ejerce una libertad considerable para determinar los objetivos y enfoques de las asignaciones. El trabajo puede ser revisado a un alto nivel. Representa a la organización como contacto principal en proyectos o contratos. Interactúa con frecuencia con los profesionales senior y la gerencia y, a menudo, tiene que coordinar el trabajo entre departamentos u organizaciones. Las acciones impactan en la organización. La falta de cumplimiento del trabajo o las decisiones erróneas darán como resultado la incapacidad de alcanzar objetivos organizacionales cruciales y pueden tener un efecto prolongado, además de resultar en el gasto de recursos sustanciales. Otra Educación / Certificaciones: Especialización o Maestría en Negocios, Mercadeo (Deseable) Certificaciones en la industria (Deseable) Competente en inglés (nivel B2 o superior) Deseable Las condiciones de trabajo: Entorno Profesional de Oficina (Híbrido). Horas de trabajo no estándar, según lo requiera el negocio. Tú qué sacas de esto? Aprovecha al máximo nuestra Organización Global: establece contactos con otros nuevos compañeros de trabajo dentro de sus primeros 30 días a través de nuestro programa de incorporación. Haz crecer tu carrera: nuestra primera prioridad es contratar internamente y ayudar a nuestra gente a crecer. Como compañero de trabajo, tendrás más oportunidades profesionales disponibles. También puedes acelerar su camino hacia el éxito con programas formales sobre liderazgo y desarrollo profesional, y muchos más cursos a pedido. Trabaja con proveedores de clase mundial: nuestros representantes de televentas actuales están trabajando con algunas de las marcas más importantes en tecnología. Eleva tu bienestar personal: aumenta tu bienestar financiero, físico y mental a través de seminarios, eventos y nuestro Programa global de asistencia para el empoderamiento de la vida (LEAP por sus siglas en Inglés). Diversidad, equidad e inclusión: no es solo una frase para nosotros; valorando cada voz es cómo tenemos éxito. Únete a nosotros para celebrar nuestra diversidad global a través de educación inclusiva, conversaciones significativas entre pares y oportunidades equitativas de crecimiento y desarrollo. ¿No cumples con todos los requisitos? Aplica de todos modos: En TD SYNNEX, estamos orgullosos de ser reconocidos como un excelente lugar para trabajar y líder en la promoción y práctica de la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión. Si está entusiasmado por trabajar para nuestra empresa y cree que es un buen candidato para este puesto, lo alentamos a que presente su solicitud. ¡Puedes ser exactamente la persona que estamos buscando! At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact. What's In It For You? Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle. Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses. Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program. Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion: It's not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities. Make the Most of our Global Organization: Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program. Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives. Don't meet every single requirement? Apply anyway. At TD SYNNEX, we're proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you're excited about working for our company and believe you're a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we're looking for! At TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX), we're proud to share an unwavering passion for bringing compelling technology products, services and solutions to the world. We're an innovative partner that helps our customers maximize the value of IT investments, demonstrate business outcomes and unlock growth opportunities. With diverse backgrounds, expertise and experiences, our co-workers make us who we are. When we seek to understand one another and recognize the power of the individual, we demonstrate respect and dignity; we learn, evolve and unlock potential to achieve outstanding results for our customers and win together. This broad perspective is integral to our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion. To learn more, visit www.TDSYNNEX.com or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook

jobs.summary: Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint...
jobs.description:
Dexian has an immediate opportunity available for a detail-oriented and motivated Endpoint Administrator with MS Intune experience to manage, maintain, and optimize a unified endpoint management environment for our premier aerospace customer. The Endpoint Administrator will be the primary point of contact for the deployment, configuration, compliance, and security of all corporate-owned and BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) endpoints. Utilizing the Microsoft 365 stack-specifically Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Entra ID-you will ensure seamless, secure hardware and software lifecycles across Windows and iOS platforms.

A typical workday may consist of the following duties as directed by the client:

Policy & Profile Management: Build, test, and deploy Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines to standardize client environments.Application Packaging & Deployment: Package, test, and distribute internal and third-party software updates, web links, and store apps across the enterprise.Modern Provisioning: Administer and monitor modern device deployment systems, such as Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager, ensuring a zero-touch or minimal-touch provisioning pipeline for new hires.Identity & Access Control: Collaborate with identity teams to manage device registration, primary user changes, group memberships, and targeted Conditional Access enforcement.Troubleshooting & Escalations: Act as the Tier 2/3 escalation point for device enrollment failures, application installation blocks, and profile synchronization issues.Reporting & Governance: Monitor Intune reporting dashboards daily to identify non-compliant devices, update patch status deficiencies, and remediate systemic configuration drift.Documentation: Maintain clear, concise documentation outlining deployment processes, app packaging standards, and device lifecycle flows.
 REQUIREMENTS AND SKILLS:
 To be successful in this role, you should possess the following skills:

Security Stack Exposure: Familiarity integrating Intune with security tools like Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or implementing data protection via MAM (Mobile Application Management) without full device enrollment.Problem-Solving & Analytical Rigor: A structured, logical approach to debugging deployment failures, policy conflicts, and log file analysis.Cross-Functional Communication: The ability to explain technical enrollment steps or security restrictions clearly and empathetically to non-technical business professionals.Adaptability: Curiosity and willingness to stay current with Microsoft's continuous cloud release notes, feature changes, and best-practice evolutions.
 To be eligible for this position, you must meet or exceed each of the following:

Experience: Four to six (4 - 6) years of progressive experience in IT systems administration, with a minimum of 2-3 years dedicated specifically to managing and deploying policies within Microsoft Intune (Cloud-only or Hybrid/co-management configurations).Technical Ecosystem Knowledge: Solid foundation in Microsoft 365 workloads, including Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure Active Directory), Conditional Access policies, and Group Policy Objects (GPOs). Ability to install, configure, monitor and troubleshoot Microsoft and third-party enterprise applications across large endpoint environments.Maintain desktop and application packaging of standard, engineered, and tested configurations for remote distribution utilizing Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Intune.Managing endpoint configuration, compliance, and automation through enterprise tools such as MECM/SCCM, Intune, or similar technologies.OS Support: Demonstrated experience configuring, enrolling, and troubleshooting Windows 10/11 endpoints. Basic exposure to managing mobile operating systems (iOS) via MDM (Mobile Device Management) profiles.Scripting Essentials: Basic proficiency with PowerShell for writing, editing, and deploying automated scripts or application wrappers to endpoints. Performing post deployment remediation and cleanup patching using PowerShell or similar scripting tools to automate updates, enforce configuration baselines, and resolve inconsistent patch states.Core Infrastructure: Solid understanding of core networking and identity concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and modern identity provisioning.
 This position requires an active Department of Defense security clearance at the SECRET level or ability to obtain and maintain this clearance.
 U.S. citizens ONLY are eligible for a security clearance and this position.

LOCATION:

This is an on-site position, and the successful candidate may be based in one of the following locations: El Segundo, CA, Chantilly, VA or Colorado Springs, CO.
 EDUCATION and CERTIFICATIONS:

Associate's degree or higher requiredPossession of or progress toward the Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) certification.
 COMPENSATION:

Dexian reasonably expects to offer $38.00 - $45.00 per hour for this position based on location, skills and experience. Additional benefits include generous time off, health, vision and dental insurance and matching 401k.
 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

Submit/Pass a 10-year background check, criminal history, drug screening, and fingerprints.Valid driver's license/Real-ID with clean driver's history.Applicants must have a strong work ethic, be extremely organized and detail-oriented, be a self-starter with excellent time management, problem solving, and multitasking skills.Excellent face-to-face customer service skills - at least 1 year experience in a customer service position, such as: call center, retail, or other customer facing role.Demonstrated problem solving skills with ability to research, resolve and complete tasks within pre-determined deadlines and schedules.Able to process work quickly and accurately despite interruptions, changing timelines and priorities, on a regular basis.Strong command of Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Excel, and Word programs.Working knowledge of app/database ticketing systems. Knowledge of ServiceNow, a plus.Position may require dexterity and ability to sit, stand, walk extended distances.Keywords: Intune, Endpoint, MECM, SCCM

Desired Skills and Experience

Intune, Endpoint, MECM, SCCM

Dexian stands at the forefront of Talent + Technology solutions with a presence spanning more than 70 locations worldwide and a team exceeding 10,000 professionals. As one of the largest technology and professional staffing companies and one of the largest minority-owned staffing companies in the United States, Dexian combines over 30 years of industry expertise with cutting-edge technologies to deliver comprehensive global services and support.

Dexian connects the right talent and the right technology with the right organizations to deliver trajectory-changing results that help everyone achieve their ambitions and goals. To learn more, please visit https://dexian.com/.

jobs.title: Virtual Desktop Engineer/Desktop Engineer
jobs.summary: Company Description Join us and make YOUR mark on the World! Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability. Our...
jobs.description:
Company Description
Join us and make YOUR mark on the World!
Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) has turned bold ideas into world-changing impact advancing science and technology to strengthen U.S. security and promote global stability.
Our mission spans four critical national security areas nuclear deterrence, threat preparedness, energy security, and multi-domain defense empowering teams to take on the toughest challenges of today and tomorrow. With a culture built on innovation and operational excellence, LLNL is a place where your expertise can make a real impact.
Job Description
We have an opening for a
Virtual Desktop Engineer/Desktop Engineer
. Working closely with the Desktop Services engineering team, you will operate and support enterprise class desktop management systems used to support the mission of the lab. This position is in the Information Technology Solutions Division (ITSD) within the Computing Directorate, in support of the LivIT Program.
This position requires full-time on-site presence due to the nature of the work.
This position will be filled at either level based on knowledge and related experience as assessed by the hiring team. Additional job responsibilities (outlined below) will be assigned if hired at the higher level.
You will
Recommend, justify, and implement operational service level improvements using an accepted change control methodology.
You will interface directly with end users and work with the engineering team in the performance of root cause analysis of reported problems.
You will work with Engineering and management in the planning of project milestones and staff expansion.
Design and deliver creative solutions and resolve problems in a timely and proactive manner while collaborating within a diverse group.
Ensure service levels are met and highest levels of service reliability are maintained.
Define and maintain support documentation and procedures.
Be a team player, maintain appropriate technology, computer security, and safety knowledge.
Lead and mentor junior operations team members in best practices and procedures.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Additional Job Responsibilities, At The 393.2 Level
Manage multiple complex parallel tasks and priorities of customers and stakeholders, ensuring deadlines are met, while leveraging team member’s skills.
Leverage tools and develop procedures to improve windows configuration management services and automate various complex tasks.
Qualifications
Ability to secure and maintain a U.S. DOE Q-level security clearance which requires U.S. citizenship.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or related field, or the equivalent combination of education and related experience.
Proficiency supporting VDI environments required; VMware Horizon experience preferred.
Experience effectively working in a dynamic, technical team environment with competing priorities.
Strong experience working with Active Directory Group Policy Objects (GPOs).
Strong PowerShell scripting skills with experience automating Windows desktop administration, configuration, software deployment, troubleshooting, reporting, or routine operational tasks.
Broad experience with SCCM/MECM application deployment.
Proficient written and verbal communication and strong interpersonal skills, ability to interact with all levels of management and staff as well as outside vendors, contractors, service providers and consultants.
Additional Qualifications At The 393.2 Level
Substantial experience architecting and administering highly redundant and fault tolerant enterprise Windows server environments.
Advanced ability to provide innovative approaches and apply new technologies to broadly defined tasks and projects.
Ability to troubleshoot complex network environments.
Qualifications We Desire
Significant experience automating Windows Desktop builds.
Knowledge of thin client administration and support.
Pay Range
$125,310 - $153,444 Yearly at the 393.1 level
$151,620 - $185,640 Yearly at the 393.2 level
This is the lowest to highest salary we in good faith believe we would pay for this role at the time of this posting; pay will not be below any applicable local minimum wage. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, specific competencies, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.
Additional Information
Position Information
This is a Career Indefinite position, open to Lab employees and external candidates.
Why Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory?
Included in 2026 Best Places to Work by Glassdoor!
Flexible Benefits Package
401(k)
Relocation Assistance
Education Reimbursement Program
Flexible schedules (*depending on project needs)
Our values - visit https://www.llnl.gov/inclusion/our-values
Security Clearance
This position requires a Department of Energy (DOE) Q-level clearance. If you are selected, we will initiate a Federal background investigation to determine if you meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information or matter. Also, all L or Q cleared employees are subject to random drug testing. Q-level clearance requires U.S. citizenship.
Pre-Employment Drug Test
External applicant(s) selected for this position must pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test. This includes testing for use of marijuana as Federal Law applies to us as a Federal Contractor.
Wireless and Medical Devices
Per the Department of Energy (DOE), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory must meet certain restrictions with the use and/or possession of mobile devices in Limited Areas. Depending on your job duties, you may be required to work in a Limited Area where you are not permitted to have a personal and/or laboratory mobile device in your possession. This includes, but not limited to cell phones, tablets, fitness devices, wireless headphones, and other Bluetooth/wireless enabled devices.
If you use a medical device, which pairs with a mobile device, you must still follow the rules concerning the mobile device in individual sections within Limited Areas. Sensitive Compartmented Information Facilities require separate approval. Hearing aids without wireless capabilities or wireless that has been disabled are allowed in Limited Areas, Secure Space and Transit/Buffer Space within buildings.
How To Identify Fake Job Advertisements
Please be aware of recruitment scams where people or entities are misusing the name of Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL) to post fake job advertisements. LLNL never extends an offer without a personal interview and will never charge a fee for joining our company. All current job openings are displayed on the Career Page under “Find Your Job” of our website. If you have encountered a job posting or have been approached with a job offer that you suspect may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend you do not respond.
To learn more about recruitment scams: https://www.llnl.gov/sites/www/files/2023-05/LLNL-Job-Fraud-Statement-Updated-4.26.23.pdf
Equal Employment Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer that is committed to providing all with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, protected veteran status, age, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.
Reasonable Accommodation
Our goal is to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates applying and interviewing at the Laboratory. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please use our online form to submit a request.
California Privacy Notice
The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) grants privacy rights to all California residents. The law also entitles job applicants, employees, and non-employee workers to be notified of what personal information LLNL collects and for what purpose. The Employee Privacy Notice can be accessed here.

jobs.title: 100% remote - MDM /Data Engineering Only W2
jobs.summary: We are seeking a mid-level Data Engineer for a fully remote contract position focused on Master Data Management (MDM). The primary purpose of this role is to support and enhance MDM initiatives, ensuring data integrity and quality across systems. The...
jobs.description: We are seeking a mid-level Data Engineer for a fully remote contract position focused on Master Data Management (MDM). The primary purpose of this role is to support and enhance MDM initiatives, ensuring data integrity and quality across systems. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical skills and experience working with MDM solutions. In this role, you will engage in day-to-day data engineering tasks utilizing technologies such as Spring Boot, Reltio MDM, Java, and AWS. You'll work with APIs and leverage Workato for integration solutions while applying Python for data manipulation and transformation. Your contributions will directly impact our MDM projects, requiring a hands-on approach to problem-solving and collaboration. As part of a dynamic team, you'll have opportunities for professional growth, collaborating with experts in the field and gaining exposure to innovative data solutions. We value continuous learning and provide an environment where you can enhance your skills and advance your career. What makes this role unique is the emphasis on MDM within a remote setting, allowing you to work from anywhere while contributing to impactful projects. This is an excellent opportunity to deepen your expertise in data engineering and MDM technologies.

jobs.title: Senior Desktop Support Engineer (Microsoft Intune & Autopilot)
jobs.summary: Na EY, estamos comprometidos em moldar seu futuro com confiança. Nós ajudaremos você a ter sucesso em um ambiente globalmente conectado, repleto de equipes diversas, e a levar sua carreira para onde você desejar. Venha para EY e ajude-nos a construir um...
jobs.description:
Na EY, estamos comprometidos em moldar seu futuro com confiança.

Nós ajudaremos você a ter sucesso em um ambiente globalmente conectado, repleto de equipes diversas, e a levar sua carreira para onde você desejar.

Venha para EY e ajude-nos a construir um mundo de negócios melhor.

Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) **Desktop Support Technician** para atuar em projetos de modernização do ambiente de trabalho, sendo responsável pelo suporte aos usuários durante processos de migração de notebooks, configuração de dispositivos e administração do ambiente Microsoft.

O profissional será responsável por garantir uma experiência fluida para os usuários finais durante todo o processo de implantação de novos equipamentos, atuando em conjunto com equipes de infraestrutura, Service Desk e Identity Management. A posição exige perfil hands-on, excelente atendimento ao usuário e domínio das ferramentas Microsoft para gerenciamento de endpoints.

Você assumirá as seguintes responsabilidades

* Suportar projetos de migração de notebooks e refresh de dispositivos.
* Configurar equipamentos utilizando Microsoft Intune e Windows Autopilot.
* Realizar instalação e configuração de Windows 10 e Windows 11.
* Fazer troubleshooting de hardware, software, rede, VPN e Microsoft 365.
* Suportar usuários durante migrações, onboarding e substituição de equipamentos.
* Configurar Outlook, OneDrive, Teams, impressoras e MFA.
* Registrar incidentes e solicitações no ServiceNow.
* Atualizar inventário de ativos e informações na CMDB.
* Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de Infraestrutura, Service Desk, IAM e Projetos.
* Garantir excelente experiência ao usuário final durante todo o processo de migração.

**Requisitos e habilidades que buscamos:**

* Inglês Avançado (B2/C1)
* Formação em Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
* Sólida experiência em Desktop Support, Deskside Support ou End User Support.
* Forte experiência com:

* Microsoft Intune

* Windows Autopilot

* Windows 10 e Windows 11

* Microsoft 365

* Active Directory / Entra ID (Azure AD)

* ServiceNow
* Experiência com troubleshooting de:

* Hardware

* VPN

* Citrix

* Redes

* Aplicações Microsoft
* Vivência com gerenciamento de endpoints.
* Excelente atendimento ao usuário final.
* Perfil organizado, comunicativo e voltado à resolução de problemas.

**Será considerado um diferencial:**

* Participação em grandes projetos de migração de notebooks.
* Experiência em grandes empresas multinacionais.

jobs.description:
Job Summary
- ----------

We are seeking an experienced Endpoint and Server Security Engineer with expertise in the CrowdStrike Falcon platform to strengthen our global endpoint and server security posture. This role will focus on deploying, configuring, and optimizing Falcon sensors across endpoints and servers, ensuring real-time threat detection, prevention, and response. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with the CrowdStrike platform.

Responsibilities
- ---------------

**Deployment \& Configuration**

· Support infrastructure teams to deploy and configure CrowdStrike Falcon sensors on Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints and servers.

· Align endpoint and server security policies with organizational security standards and compliance requirements.

· Manage / support various Falcon modules.

**Platform Management**

· Investigate and remediate issues with the platform

· Provide support to SOC teams during incidents / escalation

· Tune detection rules and prevention policies to reduce false positives and improve detection efficacy.

· Produce reporting for operational visibility and compliance tracking.

**Server \& Endpoint Security**

· Maintain security baselines for Windows and Linux systems.

· Ensure all endpoints are protected with Falcon EDR policies.

**Governance \& Reporting**

· Maintain detailed documentation of configurations and operational runbooks.

· Generate executive-level reports on EDR performance, threat trends, and compliance posture.

· Support audit and regulatory requirements by providing evidence of endpoint and server security controls.

Skills and Experience
- --------------------

**English B2 or Higher**

**Experience**

· 3--5 years in endpoint and server security, with 2 years hands-on experience with CrowdStrike Falcon EDR and CrowdStrike NG-SIEM management.

Technical Skills

· Proficiency in CrowdStrike Falcon modules

**Certifications (Preferred)**

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA).

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Responder (CCFR).

· Industry certifications such as CISSP, CEH, GCFA, or equivalent.

**Preferred Attributes**

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to operate in a global environment.

· Excellent communication and documentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences.
